scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
You have a heavy load. Maybe you're a peddler? No peddlers in this area.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
您背的东西好重啊。难道您是货郎？
不过这一带没有货郎。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Ohh!
You've come here to ask about investing?
You've come to the right place.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
哦！
您是来咨询投资事宜的吗？
您来对地方了。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
I am here to invest in the Cat Paw Merchant Association.
Err-- I mean I'm here to help honest people like you.
Hehehe~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
我是来投资猫爪商会的。
呃——我是说，我是来帮助您这些正人君子的。
嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
I can't remember everything because I've been here talking to you humans.
But I want to know first... Hold on.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
因为一直和你们人类说话，我记性不太好。
不过我想先确认一下……请稍等。

scripts.text: smell... smell...
scripts.translation: 闻闻... 闻闻...

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Ah?!
You don't know much about the Cat Paw Merchant Association, do you?
Hmm, you do not really smell like a cat.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
啊？！
看来您对猫爪商会了解不多嘛。
嗯，您身上确实没有猫的味道。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Good!!
You made the right decision to be here to invest in the Cat Paw Merchant Association~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
很好！！
您决定来投资猫爪商会，真是明智之举~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
First, you need to have ten pieces of Malangdo cans if you want to open an account.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
首先，如果您想开户，需要持有10个马朗多罐头。

scripts.text: Open an account
scripts.translation: 开户

scripts.text: Ask about benefits
scripts.translation: 询问福利

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Hmm!
I'd love to give you account for
free but as you know, this is for
advertising investers of the trader group, sorry.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
嗯！
我很想免费给您开户，
但正如您所知，这是为了宣传商人团体的投资者，抱歉了。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Good!
Write down here~ and
print your palm there,
ah!~ what's your name?
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
好的！
请在这里签字~
然后在那里按上手印，
啊！~ 请问您贵姓？

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
{0} you are~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
原来是{0}大人~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Name: {0}
Number of accounts: 10
OK! Registered!
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
姓名：{0}
账户数量：10
好的！注册成功！

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
You have an account now.
Will get an investment of a certain nunber of cans next time.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
您现在已经有账户了。
下次您将获得一定数量的罐头投资。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
I wish to get lots of investments
so you can have many services as well.
And, I also hope that we, the Cat Paw Merchant Association, will make much money.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
我希望获得大量投资，
这样您也能享受更多服务。
而且，我也希望我们猫爪商会能赚大钱。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
See you next investment~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
下次投资时再见~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
You want to know the benefits of investing?
Actually, we are a small group of cats and we don't think like humans.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
您想了解投资的福利吗？
其实，我们只是一群小猫，我们的想法和人类不太一样。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
There are lots of benefits based on how much you've invested in our services.
These include more warps, extra storage locations and price reductions of goods and services.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
根据您对我们服务的投资额度，会有不同的福利。
包括更多的传送、额外的仓库空间，以及商品和服务的价格折扣。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
I promise that if our trade is growing you will benefit from it as well.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
我向您保证，随着我们贸易的增长，您也会从中受益。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Ahh~ You're just going to leave?
T_T~ Please open an account.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
啊~您就要走了吗？
T_T~ 请开个账户吧。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
I can't remember everyone since I meet so many people...
But I want to check first... Hold on.
Excuse me!
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
我见的人太多，记不住每个人...
但我想先确认一下...请稍等。
打扰一下！

scripts.text: smell... smell...
scripts.translation: 闻闻... 闻闻...

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
This is a familiar smell!!
If it's so...!!
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
这是熟悉的气味！！
如果是这样...！！

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
You are here to invest!!
Good!~~ Good to see you~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
您是来投资的！！
太好了~~ 很高兴见到您~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
From your smell~ you are below 10,000 accounts.
Until then, you can get an account by investing ten cans.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
从您的气味来看~ 您的账户数还不足10,000。
在那之前，您可以投资10罐来开设账户。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Such a stong smell!!
Then it must be!!
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
好浓的气味！！
那一定是...！！

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
A VIP invester!!!!!!
You're here to invest? Welcome!
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
VIP投资者！！！！
您是来投资的吗？欢迎！

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
A VIP invester with over 10,000 accounts
can get another account with 20 cans.
A good investment!
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
拥有超过10,000个账户的VIP投资者
可以用20罐再开设一个账户。
这是一笔不错的投资！

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
What will you do?
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
您想做什么？

scripts.text: Invest
scripts.translation: 投资

scripts.text: Check the number of accounts
scripts.translation: 查看账户数量

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Ohh~ thank you for investing~
You can get a maximum of 10 accounts at one time.
Isn't it lovely?
How many will you invest in? Enter 0 to cancel.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
哦~ 感谢您投资~
您一次最多可以开设10个账户。
是不是很可爱？
您要投资多少个？输入0取消。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Please invest next time~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
下次请再来投资~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
You can get a maximum of 10 accounts~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
您最多可以开设10个账户~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Total {0} accounts, right?
The number of cans you need is {1} pieces.
Do you want to go through with this?
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
总共{0}个账户，对吗？
您需要{1}罐。
您确定要进行此操作吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Oh? Is that wrong? Weird.
Please check again~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
哦？不对吗？真奇怪。
请再检查一下~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Ahhh!
You don't have enough cans.
I'm a busy cat, you know.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
啊！
您的罐数不足。
我可是很忙的猫哦。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
{0} accounts were invested in.
Thank you for your help~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
已投资{0}个账户。
感谢您的支持~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Once we get more investments of cans,
our trader group will grow even more.
And you can get services as well~
A win-win strategy?
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
随着罐数投资的增加，
我们的商队也会发展壮大。
您也能享受更多服务~
这是双赢的策略吗？

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
You can have 20,000 accounts max
according to the trader policy...
{0}'s accounts increase to 20,000.
Thank you so much for your investment~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
根据商队政策，
您最多可以拥有20,000个账户...
{0}的账户数已增加至20,000。
非常感谢您的投资~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Now, {0}, you can't invest further
but you can still donate some of your cans to the trader group.
Thank you so much~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
现在，{0}，您无法继续投资，
但您仍可以向商队捐赠一些罐子。
非常感谢~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
{0} accounts have been invested in.
Thank you for your help~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
已投资{0}个账户。
感谢您的支持~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
With your big investment in cans,
this will help us meet our goals earlier.
Thank you again.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
感谢您投入大量罐子，
这将帮助我们更早达成目标。
再次感谢您。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
You want to check the number of accounts? Hmm, let's see~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
您想查看账户数量吗？嗯，让我看看~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Got it?
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
You've made many investments. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
您进行了许多投资。谢谢您。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Please invest next time~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
下次请再来投资~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
{0}, welcome~
{1}~ I felt something upon your arrival.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
{0}，欢迎~
{1}~ 感觉到您到来时，我似乎有所感应。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Want to donate?
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
想要捐赠吗？

scripts.text: Donate
scripts.translation: 捐赠

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Hehe~ then have fun in here~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
呵呵~ 那么请在这里玩得开心~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Wow, thank you, {0}~!
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
哇，谢谢你，{0}~！

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
{0}~ with your help
the cans will be distributed to cats
in the Midgard area with honor~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
{0}~ 多亏您的帮助，
这些罐子将带着荣耀分发给米德加尔特地区的猫咪们~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
The can donation can range from a minimum of 20 to a maximum of 10,000.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
罐子捐赠的数量范围是最低20个，最高10,000个。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
The can donation can range from a minimum of 20 to a maximum of 10,000.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
罐子捐赠的数量范围是最低20个，最高10,000个。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Hmm? You don't have enough cans.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
嗯？您的罐子不足。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Ohh! Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
噢！谢谢~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Dear {0} ~
I have only Increase AGI
and Blessing to give you.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
亲爱的{0} ~
我只有敏捷提升
和天使之赐福可以送给您。
谢谢您。

scripts.text:
[Storekeeper]
Hey, looks like you might be looking to unload some of your stuff from your pack.
Want to open storage? For free?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
嘿，看起来您可能想清理一下背包里的东西。
想打开仓库吗？免费的哦？

scripts.text:
[Storekeeper]
Hahaha~ Just kidding, of course it isn't free.
What do you take me for?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
哈哈哈~ 开玩笑的，当然不是免费的。
您把我当什么了？

scripts.text: Pay with Can ----- 1 unit
scripts.translation: 用罐子支付 ----- 1个

scripts.text: Pay with Zeny ------- 1,500z
scripts.translation: 用Zeny支付 ------- 1,500z

scripts.text: Pay with Can ----- 2units
scripts.translation: 用罐子支付 ----- 2个

scripts.text: Pay with Zeny ------- 3,000z
scripts.translation: 用Zeny支付 ------- 3,000z

scripts.text:
[Storekeeper]
Ah, hold on!!
You need to have ^FF0000Basic Skill level 6^000000 to use the storage service!!
scripts.translation:
[店主]
啊，等等！！
您需要拥有^FF0000基本技能等级6^000000才能使用仓库服务！！

scripts.text:
[Storekeeper]
You don't have enough cans...
scripts.translation:
[店主]
您的罐子不够...

scripts.text:
[Storekeeper]
You don't have enough zeny...
scripts.translation:
[店主]
您的Zeny不够...

scripts.text:
[Storekeeper]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Ah, you mean the ad... well, you mean our village chief?
You'd better not bother him, since he's always busy.
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
啊，你是说那个广告...不，你是说我们的村长？
你最好别去打扰他，因为他总是很忙。

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
^0000FFBut it'd be impossible to talk without bothering him anyway......^000000
He is simply always busy.
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
^0000FF但无论如何，不通过打扰他是没法交谈的......^000000
他总是很忙。

scripts.text: Village chief?
scripts.translation: 村长？

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Ah, there was an admiral of this ship before settling in here~
Shining golden eyes like the sun!!!
Silvery beard fluttering with a rough sea breeze!!!
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
啊，在这定居之前，这艘船有一位船长~
有着如太阳般闪耀的金色眼睛！！！
银色的胡须在粗糙的海风中飘扬！！！

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Kha~ It was nice!!!!
I was fascinated by that attraction and took the ship, Navi!
This thing is called the romance of a guy. Hoo hoo~
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
哈~ 那真是太好了！！！！
我被那种魅力迷住了，于是接过了这艘船，Navi！
这就是所谓的男人的浪漫。呼呼~

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Well... His cuticle seems to have gone bad a bit with his village chief duty, since he settled in Malangdo. But his eyes are still the same.
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
嗯...自从他在马拉格多定居并担任村长以来，他的皮肤似乎有点变差了。但他的眼睛依然如故。

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Umm, since it is Malangdo, will it be the Malangdo chief...?!
No, though it will be funny...
Malangdo village... umm... this... this is also not......
Well, this stuff is not that important.
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
嗯，既然是马拉格多，那会是马拉格多的村长...？！
不，虽然这样听起来很有趣...
马拉格多村...嗯...这个...这个也不对......
好吧，这些都不重要。

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Although there are many differences between admiral and village chief for sure, it feels like it won't be without Admiral Tomas anyhow.
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
虽然船长和村长之间肯定有很多不同，但感觉无论如何都离不开托马斯船长。

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
All would think the same, not just me.
He's having a hard time thanks to this.
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
大家都会这么想，不仅仅是我。
他因为这件事过得很辛苦。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Ummm... Who are you?
Don't you think it's too early to come here?
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
嗯...你是谁？
你觉得现在来这里太早了吗？

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Samuel!
Are you coming to an end there?
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
塞缪尔！
你那边结束了吗？

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Yes, Admiral!
Moved all 3 thousand boxes, including the one I just received, to the storage. The next boxes are expected to be delivered in 5 hours!
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
是的，船长！
我已经把包括刚收到的那个在内的3000个箱子都搬到了仓库。下一批箱子预计5小时后送达！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Samuel!
How many times should I tell you to call me Village Chief, not Admiral!
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
塞缪尔！
我要告诉你多少次，叫我村长，不要叫船长！

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Sorry! Village Chief!
I will correct myself!
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
抱歉！村长！
我会注意的！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Hmm, hmm!
Get them sorted out and arrange them over there. Before the next boxes are here you must finish the work there!
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
嗯，嗯！
把它们整理好，摆到那边去。在下一批箱子到来之前，你必须完成那里的工作！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Sea cucumbers, sea squirts, sea anemones to the right! Seaweed and kelp downstairs, and send anchovies and drums to the gathering place. Let the rest stack assortatively in the corner!
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
海参、海鞘、沙漠向日葵放右边！海草和海带放楼下，鳀鱼和铜锣鼓送到集合点。剩下的按种类堆在角落！

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Yes! Village Chief!
Seaweed, Sea cucumbers, sea squirts, sea anemones to the right! Seaweed and glasses downstairs! Send anchovies and drums to the gathering place! Let the rest stack assortatively in the corner!
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
是！村长！
海草、海参、海鞘、沙漠向日葵放右边！海草和玻璃杯放楼下！鳀鱼和铜锣鼓送到集合点！剩下的按种类堆在角落！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
It it not.
Sea cucumbers, sea squirts, sea anemones to the right. Seaweed and kelp downstairs. Anchovies and drums to the gathering place. Let the rest stack assortatively in the corner.
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
不是这样的。
海参、海鞘、沙漠向日葵放右边。海草和海带放楼下。鳀鱼和铜锣鼓送到集合点。剩下的按种类堆在角落。

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Yes!!
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
是！！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Huuu...
It doesn't seem to end.
There are still piles of paperwork to do... I will be in trouble unless I finish them up before the next boxes arrive.
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
呼...
看起来没完没了。
还有一堆文件要处理... 如果下一批箱子到来前没做完，我就麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
So, the amount of the next boxes is 1300....
And the next, the 700 boxes downstairs to load up the ship...
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
所以，下一批箱子的数量是1300个....
还有楼下那700个箱子要装上船...

scripts.text: Try to talk to him.
scripts.translation: 试着和他谈谈

scripts.text: Stop since he seems busy.
scripts.translation: 既然他看起来很忙，就先不打扰了

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Hmm, who are you?
You are not familiar. Sorry, but will you come again if it is not that urgent?
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
嗯，你是谁？
我不认识你。抱歉，如果不急的话，你稍后再来好吗？

scripts.text: It's my first time to Malangdo.
scripts.translation: 我是第一次来马拉甘多

scripts.text: Another cat told me to come over here.
scripts.translation: 另一只猫让我来这里

scripts.text: I will come around again later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
...So I told you your face was not familiar.
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
...所以我才说我不认识你的脸。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Hmm... Sorry, but as I told you before, would you talk to the other cats if it's not that urgent, since I have plenty of work left undone and no time to talk with you.
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
嗯... 抱歉，就像我之前说的，如果不急的话，请去和其他猫谈谈吧，因为我还有很多工作没做完，没时间和你说话。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
...Anyway all are always good to leave me with the work.
Pitiless ones...
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
...反正大家总是把活儿留给我。
真无情...

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Umm... Having said that, would you talk to the other cats if it's not that urgent, since I got plenty of work to do left undone and no time to talk with you?
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
嗯... 话虽如此，如果不急的话，请去和其他猫谈谈吧，因为我还有很多工作没做完，没时间和你说话？

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Sorry for that.
Please come back to me again, though I don't know when I could be free.
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
抱歉。
请再回来找我，虽然我不知道什么时候能空闲下来。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
These days I feel I'm pressed with work, although it's good to trust and rely on me as a village chief...
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
最近我觉得工作压得我喘不过气来，虽然作为村长被大家信任和支持是好事...

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
It is too much, since they send all visitors to me.
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
真是太多了，毕竟大家都把访客推给我。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
You're just in time. Go to the ^0000FFregular meeting^000000 being held now.
The meeting place is ^0000FFat the end of the corridor^000000.
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
你来得正好。现在正在举行^0000FF例会^000000。
会议地点在^0000FF走廊尽头^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Sorry for that.
Please come back to me again though I don't know when I could be free.
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
抱歉。
请再回来找我，虽然我不知道什么时候能空闲下来。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
So, the next 1000 boxes to move to the upper side...
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
所以，接下来要把1000个箱子搬到上面去...

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
400 boxes to give out as supplies....
And also...
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
还有400个箱子要分发作为物资...
而且...

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Admiral!
Sea bass, sea jelly, sea sponge are well arranged on the right!
Seaweed and kiwi downstairs! Anchovies and cod to the gathering place! Let the rest stack assortatively in the corner?
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
指挥官！
鲈鱼、海蜇、海绵都整齐地摆在右边了！
海草和猕猴桃在楼下！鳀鱼和鳕鱼送到集合点！剩下的在角落按种类堆好吗？

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
....
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
....

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
....
.....

[Tomas, Village Chief]
....
.....
......

[Tomas, Village Chief]
You!!
How many times did I tell you! Mew~
Huh?!
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
你！！
我说过多少次了！喵~
什么？！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Sea cucumbers, sea squirts, sea anemones to the right. Seaweed and kelp downstairs. Anchovies and drums to the gathering place. Let the rest stack assortatively in the corner.
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
海参、海鞘、沙漠向日葵放右边。海草和海带放楼下。鳀鱼和铜锣鼓送到集合点。剩下的在角落按种类堆好。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Huh?! If you really want to put Sea bass to the right that much, let yourself stand there all day long! Mew~
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
什么？！如果你真那么想把鲈鱼放右边，就让你自己在那站一整天吧！喵~

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
I'm busy enough without you. You're getting on my nerves! Mew~
What about getting on the ship over there? Mew!
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
没你的时候我都忙不过来。你真让我心烦！喵~
去那边上船怎么样？喵！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Ooops!!!
!!!!!!

[Tomas, Village Chief]
Hmm, hmm...
Well... what are you still doing here?
Go to the regular meeting being held now at the end of the corridor.
Ahem....
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
嗯，嗯...
好吧... 你还在这里做什么？
去走廊尽头参加正在举行的例会吧。
咳...

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Hmm, hmm...
Well... what are you still doing here?
Go to the regular meeting being held now at the end of the corridor.
Ahem....
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
嗯，嗯...
好吧... 你还在这里做什么？
去走廊尽头参加正在举行的例会吧。
咳...

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
How is the meeting going on?
It's been a long time since I visited, since I'm busy... Tsk...
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
会议进行得怎么样？
我很久没去过了，因为我很忙... 啧...

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Hoh!
There have been such issues!
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
哦！
原来发生了这么多事！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
I felt uneasy since I couldn't take care of you, being so busy.
You already got used to Malangdo well enough by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
因为太忙没能照顾你，我心里一直不安。
看来你已经足够适应玛朗多了。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Then, as village chief and the admiral of the cat association, I'd like you to get along with me as well!
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
那么，作为村长兼猫协会指挥官，我希望你也能和我相处融洽！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Ha ha ha!
How are you doing?
Come to me if anything difficult happens.
scripts.translation:
[村长 托马斯]
哈哈！
你过得怎么样？
如果遇到什么困难，就来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Please be silent, the regular meeting is getting started a moment later~
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
请保持安静，例会马上就要开始了~

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Wow~ wow~ Now we're having an incredible sale... well, no, but a meeting.
Please be silent.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
哇~哇~现在正进行着不可思议的大促销...不对，是会议。
请保持安静。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Today's main agenda is as always ^ff99ccStar Candy^000000.
Though I have traveled through numerous areas by now, it's my first time hearing ^0000FFsuch a difficult language to learn^000000.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
今天的议程和往常一样，是关于^ff99cc星星糖^000000的。
虽然我走访过许多地区，但这是第一次听说^0000FF如此难以学习的语言^000000。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
What she cannot communicate with at all is becoming a highly growing issue.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
完全无法沟通的问题，正在成为一个日益严峻的问题。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Please speak if there's any opinion on the next agenda.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
如果对下一项议程有任何意见，请发言。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Umm... Yes. Then, please say first, ^6666ccScottfold^000000.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
嗯...是的。那么，请^6666cc斯科特福德^000000先发言。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Umm... Yes. Please speak first, ^6666ccScottfold^000000.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
嗯...是的。请^6666cc斯科特福德^000000先发言。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Please speak, Koon.... next.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
请库恩...接着发言。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
There will be a presentation by Dr. Devore on his study continuously.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
德沃博士将继续就他的研究进行报告。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Please speak next, Dr. Mali.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
请马利博士接着发言。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Brie!! I understand the situation, but please be calm and tell us, since it is a meeting after all.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
布里！我理解你的心情，但请冷静下来，毕竟这是会议。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Well, let's have a break for a while now.
In time, Samuel brought Seaweed and tuna here.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
好了，我们休息一会儿吧。
准时，塞缪尔带来了宝箱巨鳄海草和金枪鱼。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Huew... It gets you so tired to conduct a meeting.
I used to be called a tireless merchant who ranked 1st in sales...
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
呼...主持会议真让人疲惫。
我以前可是被称为销售排名第一的不知疲倦的商人...

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
I feel really sick sometimes when the meeting is prolonged.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
有时候会议拖得太长，我会觉得很不舒服。

scripts.text:
[Scottfold]
Attending the meeting is an important thing to do.
It is absolutely right that all responsible cats should attend.
scripts.translation:
[斯科特福德]
参加会议是一件非常重要的事。
所有负责任的猫都应该出席，这是绝对正确的。

scripts.text:
[Scottfold]
The meeting is starting soon.
So, shh~~
scripts.translation:
[斯科特福德]
会议马上就要开始了。
所以，嘘~~

scripts.text:
[Scottfold]
Yes, honorable president.
As for the communication with Star Candy, we have Biscuit, don't we?
scripts.translation:
[斯科特福德]
是的，尊敬的主席。
关于与星星糖的沟通，我们有饼干，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Of course, though she is always with ^0000FFBiscuit, who speaks the official language a bit^000000, it seems to be difficult to have a conversation in depth.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
当然，虽然她总是和^0000FF会说一点官方语言的饼干^000000在一起，但似乎很难进行深入对话。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Besides, Star Candy is in a very important position that our Malangdo's existance depends upon. Many others think it's necessary to talk about our future direction directly.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
而且，星星糖处于一个非常重要的位置，玛朗多的存续都依赖于她。许多人认为有必要直接讨论我们的未来方向。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Then for the next... yes, Koon please speak now.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
那么接下来...是的，库恩请现在发言。

scripts.text:
[Scottfold]
Let's quietly listen to the other's presentation.
scripts.translation:
[斯科特福德]
让我们安静地听听别人的发言。

scripts.text:
[Scottfold]
...Though I say so, I also feel like saying something, somehow.
So, I always put my hand up first!
scripts.translation:
[斯科特福德]
...虽然这么说，但我总觉得有话想说。
所以，我总是第一个举手！

scripts.text:
[Koon]
Though I'm busy, I always attend this meeting.
I'd like this to be held at times that don't disturb my work.
scripts.translation:
[库恩]
虽然我工作很忙，但我一直参加这个会议。
我希望会议能安排在不影响我工作的时间。

scripts.text:
[Koon]
I expect what comes up today.
scripts.translation:
[库恩]
我很期待今天会上会出现什么议题。

scripts.text:
[Koon]
Scottfold is the one who participates enthusiastically.
They say that he'll be the next president of this meeting.
scripts.translation:
[库恩]
斯科特福德是那个参与最积极的人。
听说他将成为这个会议的下一任主席。

scripts.text:
[Koon]
Then, how's the study of Dr. Devore going?
scripts.translation:
[库恩]
那么，德沃尔博士的研究进展如何？

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
The language of Starfish is not undertandable even for the linguist, Dr. Devore...
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
海星的语言连语言学家德沃尔博士都无法理解...

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
President! As for that matter, I'd like to speak for myself about the study.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
主席！关于这件事，我想亲自谈谈这项研究。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Yes. Carry on please.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
好的。请继续。

scripts.text:
[Koon]
I hope the study of Dr. Devore comes out soon.
I am very interested in the language as well!
scripts.translation:
[库恩]
希望德沃尔博士的研究能尽快出成果。
我也对这门语言非常感兴趣！

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Most of our cats are especially talented in language.
This has a great effect on the prosperity of our merchants.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
我们的大多数猫在语言方面特别有天赋。
这对我们商人的繁荣有着巨大的影响。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Because... it means you can do business in more areas if you know more foreign languages.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
因为...这意味着如果你懂更多的外语，就能在更多的地区做生意。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Hello everyone.
I am a linguist, Dr. Devore, in charge of the study on the Starfish language.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
大家好。
我是负责海星语言研究的语言学家，德沃尔博士。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Let me say the definite conclusion first. Since ^0000FFthe study on the Starfish language^000000 started from the time we settled in Malangdo, there's been no remarkable outcome yet.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
让我先说明确的结论。自从^0000FF海星语言研究^000000在我们定居玛朗多时开始以来，还没有取得显著的成果。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Of course it is possible to talk with ^6666ccBiscuit^000000 somehow, but this is not close to the result we expected to solve the situation.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
当然，我们可以在某种程度上与^6666cc饼干^000000交流，但这并不是我们期望解决当前局面的结果。

scripts.text:
[Koon]
Then, how's the study on the book we found last time?
scripts.translation:
[库恩]
那么，我们上次发现的那本书的研究进展如何？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
This book we assumed to be written in the Starfish language. But when I asked Biscuit, it turns out that it's a textbook to learn the Starfish language...
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
我们原本以为这本书是用海星语写的。但当我问饼干时，结果发现那是一本学习海星语的教学书...

scripts.text:
[Koon]
Isn't it very helpful for studying the Starfish language, then?
scripts.translation:
[库恩]
那对于研究海星语不是很有帮助吗？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
I surely thought that, but when I tried the conversation as it teaches, we ended up finding they couldn't understand it at all.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
我确实这么认为，但当我尝试按照书上的内容进行对话时，结果发现他们完全听不懂。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
If you see the words on the first page of this book, there's a sentence seeming like short conversation.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
如果你看这本书第一页上的文字，有一句看起来像简短对话的句子。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
It's like this, for the question, ���Ѭ� ���?, it says, ���� ���� �լ�Ҭ��, �ҬݬѬԬ�լѬ��. �� ���ڬ�?
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
就像这样，对于问题“...”，书上写着：“...”。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Though I tried talking to Biscuit like this, there was no feedback.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
虽然我试着像这样和饼干对话，但没有任何回应。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
After that, as for this book, the existence of the book itself has been studied on the other side.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
之后，关于这本书，这本书本身的存在性也在另一边被研究过了。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Ok, we listened well to what Dr. Devore said.
Then, let's wrap up the progress of the language study, and listen to Geologist, Dr. Mali.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
好的，我们认真听取了德沃尔博士的发言。
那么，让我们总结一下语言研究的进展，并听听地质学家 马利博士的意见。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Hoo...
The Starfish language is the hardest matter in my studying life.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
唉...
海星语是我研究生涯中最棘手的问题。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
I should solve the puzzling Starfish language soon.
I'm ashamed to see you all like this as a result.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
我本该尽快解开海星语这个谜团的。
让大家看到这样的结果，我感到很羞愧。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Right...
This language world is so beautiful and mysterious.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
没错...
这个语言世界是如此美丽而神秘。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
There are mysteries like why the same beings use totally different languages, or why very far kinds use similar languages.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
存在着诸如为什么相同的生物使用完全不同的语言，或者为什么相距甚远的种类使用相似语言这样的谜团。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
I joined this group because I thought that traveling all around the world was much more helpful to study, not just reading a book at a desk.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
我加入这个团队，是因为我认为环游世界比坐在桌前读书对研究更有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
But this Starfish is just mysterious.
I cannot understand it at all.
I am rather doubtful to say it's actual 'language'.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
但这只海星太神秘了。
我完全无法理解它。
我甚至怀疑这是否真的是“语言”。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
I have no clue, though I study it in various ways.
Biscuit got used to our language, rather, and short talk is possible, but we cannot say it is conversation yet.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
尽管我尝试了各种方法，但依然毫无头绪。
饼干倒是习惯了我们的语言，可以进行简短的交流，但还不能称之为对话。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
I feel frustrated and more to study like this, but it should be solved to deal with the other matters.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
我感到很沮丧，想要继续深入研究，但为了处理其他事务，这个问题必须得到解决。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
I don't see what's wrong here!
Myself, who used to be called a master of language!
I've never expected to come across this untouchable stuff!
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
我看不出哪里有问题！
像我这样曾经被称为语言大师的人！
我从未想过会碰到这种无法触及的东西！

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Wooaaa wooaaa ahhh!!!!
I don't see what's wrong here!
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
哇啊啊啊 啊啊啊！！！！
我看不出哪里有问题！

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Why are they here and what do they want!
I'd be good enough if I could just know it!
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
它们为什么在这里，想要什么！
只要我能知道这些就足够了！

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Wooaaa wooaaa ahhh!!!!

- 你需要一个修复工具包。 -

scripts.text:
- Ground is a bit cracked. -
- Used a stapler. -
scripts.translation:
- 地面有些裂缝。 -
- 已使用订书机。 -

scripts.text:
- With the crack opening -
- at the center, -
- the ground gets soft -
- and you are instantly -
- sucked into the ground. -
scripts.translation:
- 裂缝在中心处张开 -
- 地面变得松软 -
- 你会瞬间被吸入地下。 -

scripts.text: Repair the gap.
scripts.translation: 修复裂缝

scripts.text: Use the stapler.
scripts.translation: 使用订书机

scripts.text:
- Mix the two colors of -
- adhesives and put it on -
- the crack meticulously. -
scripts.translation:
- 将两种颜色的粘合剂混合 -
- 并小心翼翼地涂抹在裂缝上。 -

scripts.text:
- Use a plump sea squirt -
- for the cracked gap.-
scripts.translation:
- 使用一只饱满的海鞘 -
- 来填补裂缝。 -

scripts.text:
- Use a slithery sea cucumber -
- for the cracked gap.-
scripts.translation:
- 使用一条滑溜溜的海参 -
- 来填补裂缝。 -

scripts.text:
- Used the stapler for the crack -
- and fixed it well. -
scripts.translation:
- 使用订书机处理裂缝 -
- 并修复得很好。 -

scripts.text:
- It seems the crack -
- is well filled. -
scripts.translation:
- 看起来裂缝 -
- 已经被填满了。 -

scripts.text: - Let's get back to report this. -
scripts.translation: - 让我们回去汇报这件事。 -

scripts.text:
- Let's find -
- the other cracks. -
scripts.translation:
- 让我们寻找 -
- 其他的裂缝。 -

scripts.text:
- I can see the crack. -
- It seems there's still -
- not enough supporters yet. -
scripts.translation:
- 我能看到裂缝。 -
- 看来支撑物 -
- 还远远不够。 -

scripts.text:
[Brie]
Sorry, but I don't feel like talking with you. Please leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
抱歉，我现在不想和你说话。请让我一个人待着。

scripts.text:
[Brie]
Sorry, President.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
抱歉，主席。

scripts.text:
[Brie]
Though Star Candy is supporting the ground of Malangdo,
we don't understand its purpose or reason at all.
Should we just expect not to find anything?
scripts.translation:
[布里]
虽然星星糖正在支撑玛朗多的地面，
但我们完全不明白它的目的或原因。
难道我们就只能指望什么也发现不了吗？

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
As Dr. Devore said, it's better to wait for the results, since he's still studying...
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
正如德沃博士所说，既然他还在研究中，最好还是等待结果...

scripts.text:
[Brie]
What would you do if Star Candy left, and you had only waited?
Malangdo may go under. I cannot just wait here like this.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
如果星星糖离开了，而你只是等待，你会怎么做？
玛朗多可能会沉没。我不能就这样一直等待。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
But, Brie, we know there's nothing but waiting.
An enormous crack was made when Star Candy tried to make the support stand last time, as she seemed to be shocked and moved too much.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
但是，布里，我们知道除了等待别无他法。
上次星星糖试图建立支撑柱时，由于她似乎受到太大冲击和震动，产生了一条巨大的裂缝。

scripts.text:
[Geologist Mali]
Besides, since ^0000FFStar Candy's location plays the role of pillar for this island, it seems the center would go down as you even set up pillars around her^000000, mew~
scripts.translation:
[地质学家 玛丽]
而且，由于^0000FF星星糖的位置充当着这座岛屿的支柱，即使你在她周围设置支柱，中心部分似乎也会下沉^000000，喵~

scripts.text:
[Geologist Mali]
Due to the nature of this large basement space, if the center were to collapse, we can't expect what comes next. Our researchers therefore think we should treat it as carefully as we can, mew~
scripts.translation:
[地质学家 玛丽]
由于这个巨大地下空间的特性，如果中心坍塌，我们无法预料接下来会发生什么。因此我们的研究员认为，我们必须尽可能小心地处理，喵~

scripts.text:
[Brie]
...

[President of Meeting]
We know that Rican's injury may affect the trade of Yggdrasil Berry, so don't worry too much.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
我们知道里坎的伤势可能会影响天地树果实的交易，所以不要太担心。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
As for that matter, we're going to plan for it by discussing it with our chief, Tomas.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
至于这件事，我们打算和首领托马商量一下对策。

scripts.text:
[Brie]
Yes...
scripts.translation:
[布里]
是的...

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Well, let's have a break for now.
In time, Samuel brought Seaweed and tuna here.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
好了，我们先休息一下。
不久后，塞缪尔带来了宝箱巨鳄海草和金枪鱼。

scripts.text:
[Brie]
What?!
I won't listen if you are nagging.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
什么？！
你要是唠叨，我可就不听了。

scripts.text: About Rican.
scripts.translation: 关于里坎

scripts.text: I will stop.
scripts.translation: 我要停止。

scripts.text:
[Brie]
As for my father?
He's the master of Yggdrasil Berry in this island.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
至于我父亲？
他是这座岛上天地树果实的师父。

scripts.text:
[Brie]
He can only do little things, like pushing the button of the dry machine, until his legs recover from the earthquake.
The amount of Yggdrasil Berry dramatically decreased.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
在双腿从地震中恢复之前，他只能做些小事，比如按烘干机的按钮。
天地树果实的产量急剧下降了。

scripts.text:
[Brie]
I've been harvesting them instead of him, but...
scripts.translation:
[布里]
我一直代替他采摘，但是...

scripts.text:
[Brie]
Anyhow, I don't know very much about it, since I've just started this. If you want to ask about the Yggdrasil Berry, go to my house in the ^6666ccwest of Malangdo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
总之，我刚开始做这个，所以不太懂。如果你想问关于天地树果实的事，去^6666cc玛朗多西边^000000我家找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Brie]
My father will be staying there saying he's really bored today again...
scripts.translation:
[布里]
我父亲会待在那里，今天大概又会说很无聊...

scripts.text:
[Brie]
Hoo...

[Brie]
Anyhow, I don't know very much about it, since I've just started this. If you want to ask about the Yggdrasil Berry, go to my house in the ^6666ccwest of Malangdo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
总之，我刚开始做这个，所以不太懂。如果你想问关于天地树果实的事，去^6666cc玛朗多西边^000000我家找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Brie]
My father will be staying there saying he's really bored today again...
scripts.translation:
[布里]
我父亲会待在那里，今天大概又会说很无聊...

scripts.text:
[Brie]
Dr. Mali, please let me help to repair the cracks!
You called me more often long ago, but why do you say you can't give me the work now?
scripts.translation:
[布里]
玛丽博士，请让我帮忙修复裂缝！
以前你经常叫我，为什么现在说不能给我工作？

scripts.text:
[Geologist Mali]
No, mew~
Brie, you have to help your father, mew~
scripts.translation:
[地质学家 玛丽]
不行，喵~
布里，你必须去帮你父亲，喵~

scripts.text:
[Brie]
But if this island goes down, all the fuss isn't useful at all!
scripts.translation:
[布里]
但如果这座岛沉没了，那些忙碌就毫无意义了！

scripts.text:
[Geologist Mali]
It's the same as the chicken and egg situation, mew~
If we have any problems selling Yggdrasil Berry, we cannot buy the tools to repair the cracks, mew~
scripts.translation:
[地质学家 玛丽]
这就好比先有鸡还是先有蛋，喵~
如果我们卖不出天地树果实，就无法购买修复裂缝的工具，喵~

scripts.text:
[Brie]
...

[Geologist Mali]
So, go back home and help your father, mew~
scripts.translation:
[地质学家 玛丽]
所以，回家去帮你父亲吧，喵~

scripts.text:
[Brie]
Ok, then I'll come back again if his legs have recovered.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
好吧，等他腿好了我再回来。

scripts.text:
[Geologist Mali]
Good.
I'll wait for you, mew~
scripts.translation:
[地质学家 玛丽]
很好。
我会等你的，喵~

scripts.text:
[Geologist Mali]
Now as I get him back home, I'm going to find the participants, mew~
Cheers!
scripts.translation:
[地质学家 玛丽]
现在我要送他回家了，然后去找参与者，喵~
再见！

scripts.text:
[Brie]
Hew... I think I changed from being fussy, as I felt nervous.
Now I will think of only the harvest of fussy.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
呼...我觉得自己变了，不再那么挑剔了，因为之前我很紧张。
现在我只想着收获那些挑剔的东西。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Woo waa hoohoo...
Woowaa ahhh ahh ahh...
I'm impatient... to stay home like this!!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
呜哇呼呼...
呜哇啊啊啊...
我受不了了...一直待在家里！！

scripts.text:
[Rican]
When will my legs recover, when?!
They should be better soon, so that I can work like before...
But I can hardly move.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
我的腿什么时候才能好，什么时候啊？！
应该很快就会好的，这样我就能像以前一样工作了...
但我几乎动不了。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
All I can do is press the button all day long~
This is not exciting at all~
I'm not willing to do anything more and more~ Doobie dooba~
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
我整天只能按按钮~
这一点也不刺激~
我不想再做更多了~ 嘟嘟嘟~

scripts.text: Excuse me. Is this Rican's house?
scripts.translation: 打扰一下。这里是里坎的家吗？

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Huh?
Who are you!
I am Rican!
It's good to see you, since I'm so bored now...
Tell me what's happening right now! Now!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
咦？
你是谁！
我是里坎！
很高兴见到你，我现在太无聊了...
告诉我现在发生了什么！快说！

scripts.text: Ask about Yggdrasil Berry.
scripts.translation: 询问关于天地树果实的事。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Yggdrasil Berry?
You... you know something!
Umm, hahaha!
Only a few cats know about Yggdrasil Berry!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
天地树果实？
你...你知道些什么！
嗯，哈哈！
只有少数猫知道天地树果实！

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Well, before I traded them with human beings like you, Yggdrasil Berry was not thought to be a very remarkable fruit.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
嗯，在我像你们人类一样交易之前，天地树果实并不被认为是什么特别的水果。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
It used to be spread out here and there in my old town. It doesn't have a good taste and causes indigestion, mew~
Cats need to eat fishes, naturally.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
它曾经散布在我以前的城镇里。味道不好，吃了还会消化不良，喵~
猫当然需要吃鱼。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
But if human beings eat this, it gets you fully recharged.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
但如果人类吃了这个，就能完全恢复精力。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
At first, I'd never thought it could be sold at all!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
起初，我从来没想过它能卖出去！

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Khhh~
It was just awesome at that time...
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
嘻嘻~
那时候真是太棒了...

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Very long ago...
Our group left the town for a new course to trade.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
很久以前...
我们的小组离开城镇，开始了新的贸易路线。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Actually, we dominated the areas around our town, and it was like a challenge to find unexplored areas.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
实际上，我们统治了城镇周围的地区，探索未知区域就像是一种挑战。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
But discovering the unknown is the romance of a man, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
但发现未知事物，不正是男人的浪漫吗？

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Well, the beginning was quite nice, anyway.
After a month or two floating on the sea...
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
嗯，一开始还挺不错的。
在海上漂浮了一两个月后...

scripts.text:
[Rican]
The sea has enough fishes in it, but it made me bored. I wanted to eat seasoning, like radish with chicken the most.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
海里有足够的鱼，但这让我很无聊。我最想吃的是像萝卜配鸡肉这样的调味菜。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Though we drifted for a very long time, we couldn't land on any island. Rather, we met storms.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
虽然我们漂流了很长时间，但无法在任何岛屿登陆。相反，我们遇到了风暴。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
It was my first time seeing such a harsh tornado.
At that time I was out of my mind and thought I would die.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
那是我第一次见到如此猛烈的龙卷风。
当时我吓得魂飞魄散，以为自己会死。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
I don't know the about the other ships, but this ship Navi luckily landed here in this island.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
我不知道其他船的情况，但这艘“纳维”号幸运地停靠在了这座岛上。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Khhh khhh!
Can you believe it?
^0000FFThat enormous ship just flied, vroom~~ like an airship and was dropped here in the middle of this island!^000000
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
呼哧呼哧！
你相信吗？
^0000FF那艘巨大的船就像飞空艇一样“呼”地飞了起来，然后直接掉在了这座岛的中央！^000000

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Anyhow, I survived, but most of the goods in the ship were swept and we were left with only Yggdrasil Berry.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
总之，我活下来了，但船上的大部分货物都被冲走了，只剩下天地树果实。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Huh? Why did we load them, if we don't eat them?
It... it's the secret...
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
咦？既然不吃，为什么我们要装载它们呢？
这...这是秘密...

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Well, it's not important. As we sent reconnaissance groups there, we found out that there's a land where the other kind lives, not like us.
That was the land of you, human beings.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
嗯，这不重要。我们派出了侦察队，发现那里生活着和我们不同的种族。
那就是你们人类生活的土地。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Regardless of the process, we found the new area to trade as we had first intended... we still have a small problem of not knowing how to get back to our howmetown yet...
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
不管过程如何，我们找到了最初打算交易的新区域...不过我们还有一个小问题，就是还不知道怎么回到我们的家乡...

scripts.text:
[Rican]
We cats started selling with powerful viability.
But we had only Yggdrasil Berry, right?
We sold it with no high expectations, but could sell like hot cakes.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
我们猫开始以强大的生命力进行销售。
但我们只有天地树果实，对吧？
我们没抱太大希望，结果却卖得像热蛋糕一样快。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
As rumors went, it was sold at very high prices among human beings and had a remarkable effect on them.
So we finally settled down to sell Yggdrasil Berry with growing profits.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
随着传闻四起，它在人类中间以极高的价格出售，并且对他们产生了显著的效果。
所以我们最终定居下来，以不断增长的利润销售天地树果实。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
But we are selling the dried kind, which is ^0000FFa bit different from what human being originally know, and less effective, and hard to eat raw^000000.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
但我们卖的是干果，这与人类原本认识的那种^0000FF略有不同，效果也较弱，而且很难生吃^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Since it disappears as we prepare, it's definitely the best for our group.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
因为它在准备过程中会消失，所以对我们来说绝对是最好的。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
By the way, as I got injured in this important season, it harms my credibility if I don't meet the deadline to deliver the amount ordered!
Trading is credibility!!!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
顺便说一下，在这个重要的季节我受了伤，如果我不按时交付订购的数量，就会损害我的信誉！
交易就是信誉！！！

scripts.text:
[Rican]
For this reason, would you like to help me?
Though my son is helping me, the amount we can prepare is not enough.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
因此，你愿意帮我吗？
虽然我的儿子在帮我，但我们能准备的数量还是不够。

scripts.text: I'll help him.
scripts.translation: 我会帮他的。

scripts.text: I won't.
scripts.translation: 我不写

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Khhh!
I had a good impression of you from the first time!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
呼！
我第一眼就对你印象很好！

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Harvesting Yggdrasil Berry is very easy.
You can get it when you just dig the ground, mew~
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
采集天地树果实非常简单。
你只要挖挖地面就能得到，喵~

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Huh?
Doesn't it originally come from the ground?
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
咦？
它不是本来就来自地面吗？

scripts.text: Doesn't it grow on trees?
scripts.translation: 它不是长在树上的吗？

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Well, the Yggdrasil Berry in Midgard could do so.
But ^6666ccwe dig our Yggdrasil Berry here from the ground^000000.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
嗯，米德加尔特那里的天地树果实确实是这样。
但^6666cc我们在这里是从地里挖出天地树果实的^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
You can get it on Malangdo Island easily. Bring me about 30.
Ah! Keep the secret to my son for sure~
Then please^ff99cc!!!^000000 please^ff99cc!!!^000000 please~~~
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
你在绵绵岛很容易就能找到。请给我带大约30个。
啊！一定要对我儿子保密哦~
拜托了^ff99cc！！！^000000 拜托了^ff99cc！！！^000000 拜托~~~

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Oh? Then it's okay, if you can't help it.
My injured leg feels so bad... -groaning-
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
哦？那就算了，如果你帮不了我的话。
我受伤的腿好难受... -呻吟声-

scripts.text:
[Rican]
You can get it on Malangdo Island easily. Bring me about 30.
Ah! Keep the secret to my son for sure~
Then please^ff99cc!!!^000000 please^ff99cc!!!^000000 please~~~
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
你在绵绵岛很容易就能找到。请给我带大约30个。
啊！一定要对我儿子保密哦~
拜托了^ff99cc！！！^000000 拜托了^ff99cc！！！^000000 拜托~~~

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Oh, oh!!
This fresh smell!!!
Haaa~ How fresh, good job!
You're good at harvesting Yggdrasil Berry?
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
哦，哦！！
这股新鲜的味道！！！
哈~ 真新鲜，干得好！
你很擅长采集天地树果实吗？

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Then would you put it in the machine in front of me?
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
那么，你能把它放进我面前的机器里吗？

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Oh, oh!!
This fresh smell!!!
Haaa~ How fresh, good job!
You're good at harvesting Yggdrasil Berry?
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
哦，哦！！
这股新鲜的味道！！！
哈~ 真新鲜，干得好！
你很擅长采集天地树果实吗？

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Then would you put it in the machine in front of me?
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
那么，你能把它放进我面前的机器里吗？

scripts.text:
- Notice !! -
 - Since you have too many items - 
 - you cannot get the item. - 
 - Let your body lighten - 
 - and try this again. -
scripts.translation:
- 告示 !! -
- 由于物品栏已满 -
- 无法获得物品。 -
- 请减轻身体负担 -
- 然后再次尝试。 -

scripts.text:
- Notice !! -
 - Since your items are too heavy - 
 - you cannot get the item. - 
 - Let your body lighten - 
 - and try this again. -
scripts.translation:
- 告示 !! -
- 由于物品过重 -
- 无法获得物品。 -
- 请减轻身体负担 -
- 然后再次尝试。 -

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Hoo hoo~ I feel at ease thanks to your help.
I had doubted if it was too much suddenly, but it turned out just right!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
呼~ 多亏你的帮忙，我松了一口气。
我本来还担心一下子要这么多是不是太多了，结果刚刚好！

scripts.text:
[Rican]
By the way, no news from my son yet, as he said he went to a meeting.
I hope he's not bothering Dr. Mali again...
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
顺便说一下，我儿子还没消息，他说他去开会了。
希望他没有再去打扰马利医生...

scripts.text:
[Rican]
He seems to have visited Dr. Mali more often since my legs got injured.
The study will get longer if he does so...
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
自从我腿受伤后，他似乎更频繁地去找马利医生了。
如果他这样下去，研究时间会变得更长...

scripts.text:
[Rican]
If you see my son, please tell him to get back soon~
And this is for you to buy something delicious with, since you did hard work.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
如果你见到我儿子，请告诉他尽快回来~
这是给你的，既然你辛苦了，就拿去买点好吃的吧。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
He seems to have visited Dr. Mali more often since my legs got injured.
The study will get longer if he does so...
If you see my son, please tell him to get back soon~
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
自从我腿受伤后，他似乎更频繁地去找马利医生了。
如果他这样下去，研究时间会变得更长...
如果你见到我儿子，请告诉他尽快回来~

scripts.text:
[Rican]
You need exactly 30 to get a set!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
你需要正好30个才能凑齐一套！

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Very reliable!
Don't you want to do your business with Yggdrasil Berry?
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
非常可靠！
你不想要用天地树果实做点生意吗？

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Would you like to take a rest for a while?
It hasn't been a day yet since you last worked~
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
你想休息一下吗？
距离你上次工作还不到一天呢~

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Hehe~
You came here to help me again?
You're so faithful!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
呵呵~
你又来帮我了？
你真是很忠诚啊！

scripts.text: I'll help.
scripts.translation: 我会帮忙的。

scripts.text: I won't.
scripts.translation: 我不写

scripts.text:
[Rican]
It's the same task to do as before.
30 Yggdrasil Berry. You can easily find it in Malangdo!!
Ah! Keep the secret to my son for sure~
Then please^ff99cc!!!^000000 please^ff99cc!!!^000000 please~~~
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
和之前一样的任务。
30个天地树果实。你在绵绵岛很容易就能找到！！
啊！一定要对我儿子保密哦~
拜托了^ff99cc！！！^000000 拜托了^ff99cc！！！^000000 拜托~~~

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Yeah? Then play around here, since you are visiting~
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
是吗？既然你来了，就在这里玩一会儿吧~

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Woo waa hoohoo...
Woowaa ahhh ahh ahh...
I'm impatient... to stay home like this!!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
呜哇呼呼...
呜哇啊啊啊...
我受不了了...一直待在家里！！

scripts.text:
[Rican]
All I can do is press the button all day long~
This is not exciting at all~
I'm not willing to do anything more and more~ Doobie dooba~
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
我整天只能按按钮~
这一点也不刺激~
我不想再做更多了~ 嘟嘟嘟~

scripts.text:
[Rican]
You need exactly 30 to get a set!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
你需要正好30个才能凑齐一套！

scripts.text: Put the fruits in.
scripts.translation: 放入水果

scripts.text: Don't.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Rican]
I'll press the button by myself!!!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
我会自己按按钮的！！！

scripts.text:
- The machine starts operating -
- when he presses the button. -
scripts.translation:
- 当他按下按钮时 -
- 机器开始运转 -

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Ah... you won't put it in?
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
啊...你不打算放进去吗？

scripts.text: - Drrrk Drrrk -
scripts.translation: - 咔哒 咔哒 -

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 您的负重太重，无法继续。请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 您的背包已满，无法继续。请整理背包后再来。

scripts.text:
- As I put my hand in the sand -
- a fresh smell comes out. -
scripts.translation:
- 当我把手伸进沙堆时 -
- 一股新鲜的气味飘了出来。 -

scripts.text:
- As I put my hand in the sand -
- I feel like I'm touching -
- something bad. -
- Ah, ah! Feels bad... -
scripts.translation:
- 当我把手伸进沙堆时 -
- 感觉摸到了 -
- 某种不好的东西。 -
- 啊，啊！感觉不妙... -

scripts.text:
- Seeems suspicious. -
- But it's just sand... -
scripts.translation:
- 看起来很可疑。 -
- 但这只是沙子... -

scripts.text:
- There's something strange. -
- It feels like somehow - 
- you shouldn't make eye contact. -
scripts.translation:
- 有些不对劲。 -
- 感觉似乎 -
- 不应该与它进行眼神接触。 -

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Star Candy sacrifices herself like this, but those fellows are setting the pillars around her for themselves only.
Hewww!!!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
星星糖就这样牺牲了自己，但那些家伙却只顾着为自己树立标杆。
哼！！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
They talk to her, but ignore me when I talk to her.
I don't like them at all!!!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
他们跟她说话，却无视我说的话。
我一点都不喜欢他们！！！

scripts.text: - Unlike the words of Dr. Devore, Biscuit appears fluent in speaking. -
scripts.translation: - 与德沃尔博士的说法不同，饼干似乎很擅长说话。 -

scripts.text: - I think it's better to let Dr. Devore know this soon. -
scripts.translation: - 我觉得最好尽快让德沃尔博士知道这件事。 -

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Umm?
What's this?
Do you have anything to tell me?
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
嗯？
这是什么？
你有什么要告诉我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Well, that fellow is often the one ignoring my words.
He wavers with words to say and makes me uncomfortable.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
嗯，那个家伙经常无视我的话。
他说话吞吞吐吐，让我感到不舒服。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you hear? Dr. Devore?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你听到了吗？德沃尔博士？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Ummm? What do you mean?
I cannot hear anything.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
嗯？你什么意思？
我什么都听不到。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? Biscuit said 'Well, that fellow is often the one ignoring my words. He wavers with words to say and makes me uncomfortable.'?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么？饼干说“嗯，那个家伙经常无视我的话。他说话吞吞吐吐，让我感到不舒服”？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
What? What are you taling about?
I cannot hear anything.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
什么？你在说什么？
我什么都听不到。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
If... if that's the cause!
We may have totally misunderstood!
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
如...如果这是原因的话！
我们可能完全误解了！

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Oh my, we couldn't have known, since we live here only with ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
天哪，我们一直只和自己生活在一起，怎么可能知道呢。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Each living thing has its own area for audibility and vocalization. But we and Biscuit were in slightly different areas!
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
每个生物都有自己的听觉和发声范围。但我们和饼干所在的范围略有不同！

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
In such conditions, we cannot hear any language properly!
This was a matter of sound rather than language...
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
在这种状况下，我们根本无法正确地听到任何语言！
这其实是声音的问题，而不是语言的问题...

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Hu~hu... Despite of many years of study, we couldn't discover this reason...
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
呼~呼...尽管研究了这么多年，我们竟然没能发现这个原因...

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
It's not the time to do this!
I should change the way of studying right now.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
现在不是做这种事的时候！
我应该立刻改变研究方式。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
I'll get back to the meeting and report this.
Then please take care of the next things!
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
我要回去开会并汇报这件事。
接下来就拜托你处理后续事宜了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, Dr. Devore, what on earth is next...?
What should I do...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，德沃尔博士，接下来到底要做什么...？
我该怎么做...？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Hahaha~ You are the kind who can have conversations with Biscuit. Please try to talk with him.
It'll be helpful for my study, no matter what you talk about with him.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家 德沃尔]
哈哈~你是那种能和饼干对话的人。请试着和他聊聊。
不管你们聊什么，对我的研究都有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Hey... Don't look down on me!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
嘿...别看不起我！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
...What are you looking at...
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
...你在看什么...

scripts.text: Ask about Star Candy.
scripts.translation: 询问关于星星糖的事

scripts.text: Ask about Biscuit.
scripts.translation: 询问关于饼干的事

scripts.text: Ask about Malangdo.
scripts.translation: 询问关于马拉贡多(Malangdo)的事

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Star Candy?
Tsk tsk!
It's no go, the lowly fellows.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
星星糖？
啧！
那些低贱的家伙，不行。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
You shouldn've recognized the previous and mysterious feeling from Star Candy!
She's the one who's really gorgeous.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
你不该从星星糖身上认出那种之前神秘的感觉！
她才是真正美丽的人。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
How gorgeous she is that... umm...
Just gorgeous.
She is so gorgeous... but I don't know how to explaing it...
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
她有多美呢...嗯...
就是很美。
她真的很美...但我不知道该怎么形容...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Khummm...
That's why the kinds speaking with sound are irritating.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
嗯哼...
所以那些用声音说话的种类真让人讨厌。

scripts.text: Speaking with sound?
scripts.translation: 用声音说话？

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
The kind who got highly evolved like us talk using our minds, not sound.
As you think in your mind, it goes to the others right away, something like this?
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
像我们这样高度进化的种类，是用心灵而不是声音交流的。
就像你在心里想什么，对方立刻就能知道一样？

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
In other places, it used to be called ultrasonic waves, or telepathy.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
在其他地方，这被称为超声波，或者心灵感应。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
So we haven't needed any more explanation or flowery words...
Woo, it's bothering me so much!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
所以我们不需要更多的解释或华丽的辞藻...
哇，真让人心烦！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Me?
I'm an assistant to Star Candy, a new star in the Starfish race with multi-faceted talents!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
我？
我是星星糖的助手，海星族中多才多艺的新星！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Ah, ah...
When I was her assistant at first, I used to be called a genius, handsome assistant, and so on...
I felt like a shining road of light had come up to me...
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
啊，啊...
刚开始做她的助手时，我还被夸是天才、帅哥助手什么的...
感觉一条光明的道路向我敞开了...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
But if the elderly see this, they'll dry me out in the sun...
It was a life like a flame... Sob sob sob sob
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
但要是被老人家看到这样，他们肯定会把我晒干的...
那是一段如火焰般的生活...呜呜呜呜

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
This island is where the gorgeous Star Candy can take a rest.
The surface is soft and with the high moisture inside, it's the best place for Starfishes.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
这座岛屿是美丽的星星糖可以休息的地方。
表面柔软，内部湿度很高，是海星族最好的栖息地。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Now, those cats already occupied it as they wanted.
It's a problem because Star Candy is too kind...
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
现在，那些猫已经按它们的意愿占领了这里。
因为星星糖太善良了，所以这是个问题...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Hey, you haven't gone back?
Get some jellies for Star Candy to eat if you have time.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
嘿，你还没回去吗？
如果有空的话，去给星星糖弄点果冻吃吧。

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: Why me?
scripts.translation: 为什么是我？

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
You can get the jellies around here.
It's not that difficult, and you should come back before Star Candy's meal time!
About 30 jellies would be okay for a meal.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
你可以在附近找到果冻。
这并不难，但你得赶在星星糖的饭点前回来！
大概30个果冻就够一顿了。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Why you?
I'm busy enough to assist her and the cat fellows who can't hear my voice, that's why I should ask you.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
为什么是你？
我忙着照顾她，还有那些听不见我说话的猫家伙们，所以我才不得不拜托你。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
How rude...
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
真没礼貌...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
You're not my subordinate, so I can't order you by force. But if Star Candy can't have her meal on time, you have to remember that this island will collapse completely.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
你不是我的下属，所以我不能强迫你。但如果星星糖不能按时吃饭，你要记住，这座岛屿会彻底崩塌的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...It's not a request, but a threat...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...这不是请求，而是威胁...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
It's not enough at all~
I need at least 30 Delicious Jelly.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
完全不够~
我至少需要30个可口果冻。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
You got them well.
There won't be any problem to prepare her meal.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
你做得很好。
准备她的餐点应该没问题了。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Though the jelly looks strange, it tastes good...
Star Candy seems to like it a lot as well.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
虽然果冻看起来有点奇怪，但味道很好...
星星糖似乎也很喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Have your meal, Star Candy~
Uhhh, why don't you eat it?
You have no appetite?
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
吃饭吧，星星糖~
唔，你怎么不吃？
没有胃口吗？

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Hooo.. it's natural that you have no appetite...
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
呼...没有胃口也是自然的...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
How come precious Star Candy supports the ground in the basement like this, and it's so dry, though it's in a subterranean cave of an island!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
珍贵的星星糖竟然像这样支撑着地下的地面，而且这么干燥，明明是在岛屿的地下洞穴里啊！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Moreover, the slithery thing is bothering Star Candy.
You cannot avoid the stress.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
而且，那个滑溜溜的东西一直在骚扰星星糖。
这种压力是无法避免的。

scripts.text: Slithery thing?
scripts.translation: 滑溜溜的东西？

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Hmm? What is such a thing like that.
The slithery thing.
With its ugly looks, it bothers Star Candy continuously.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
嗯？那是什么样的东西。
那个滑溜溜的东西。
它长得丑陋，一直不停地骚扰星星糖。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
It tries to come up to the island especially when it's storming like today. I hid here a while. Those cats came and made her bad like this.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
它特别想在像今天这样暴风雨的时候爬上岛来。我躲了一会儿。那些猫来了，把星星糖弄成现在这样。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Thanks to Star Candy, her skin is...
......
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
多亏了星星糖，她的皮肤是...
......

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Woooaaappp!
What's this!!!
Her skin is!!!!
She got an abscess on her skin that used to shine like a jewel!!!!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
哇啊啊啊！
这是什么！！！
她的皮肤是！！！
她原本像宝石一样闪闪发光的皮肤上竟然长了脓肿！！！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
She got in trouble with her dried skin, since she's here!
For our Starfishes, the lack of water means horrible things that lead to death!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
她因为皮肤干裂而陷入困境，因为她在这里！
对我们海星来说，缺水意味着可怕的后果，甚至会导致死亡！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Ah, ah! She's so kind that she sacrifices herself to save such things. Sob sob.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
啊，啊！她真好，为了拯救这些而牺牲自己。呜呜。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Ah, ah...
I can't leave to take care of her, isn't there anybody to help~
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
啊，啊...
我不能离开去照顾她，难道没有人能帮忙吗~

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Isn't there anybody to helpppppp~
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
难道没有人能帮帮忙吗~

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Hey, you there...
Even as I ask like this, will you just ignore me and stand there?
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
嘿，你那边...
我都这样问了，你就打算无视我站在那儿吗？

scripts.text: I'll help.
scripts.translation: 我会帮忙的。

scripts.text: It's unavoidable, so I'll help.
scripts.translation: 这是不可避免的，我会帮忙。

scripts.text: I'll admit this is my destiny, so I'll and help.
scripts.translation: 我承认这是我的命运，所以我会帮忙。

scripts.text: I'll do anything I can for Star Candy.
scripts.translation: 我会尽我所能帮助星星糖。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Good attitude!
Hoo hoo~
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
态度很好！
呼呼~

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Then please find the brush to wash her and get a basket to move water here.
Maybe they're stacked in the storage.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
那么请找到刷子给她清洗，并拿个篮子把水运到这里。
也许它们堆在仓库里。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Oh!
You brought the tools successfully.
Now you can wash the dry skin in the counter-clockwise direction!
Right, then from her left leg...!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
哦！
你成功带来了工具。
现在你可以逆时针方向清洗干裂的皮肤了！
对，然后从她的左腿开始...！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Oh!
You brought the tools successfully.
Now you can fetch sea water from outside.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
哦！
你成功带来了工具。
现在你可以去外面取海水了。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
There's a spot I remember as first rate, in the east of Malangdo.
It's not right to wash her with the water collected in this cave!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
我记得玛朗多东部有一个绝佳的地方。
用这个洞穴里收集的水来清洗她是不对的！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Be careful not to spill the water, as it's heavy to carry.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
小心别把水洒了，因为水很重，很难搬运。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Ummm... It will be hard if you don't have the proper tools...
Though it doesn't matter for someone small like me.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
嗯...如果没有合适的工具，会很困难...
不过对我来说，像我这么小的人没关系。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
For such enormous skin as Star Candy's, it's full of barnacles, oysters, and mussels!!!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
对于星星糖这么大的皮肤来说，上面长满了藤壶、牡蛎和贻贝！！！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Oh!
You brought the tools successfully.
Now you can wash the dry skin in the counter-clockwise direction!
Right, then from her left leg...!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
哦！
你成功带来了工具。
现在你可以逆时针方向清洗干裂的皮肤了！
对，然后从她的左腿开始...！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Well done!
Now I see that her beautiful face has recovered.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
做得好！
现在我看到她美丽的脸恢复了。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
The skin will go bad if you don't clean it every day.
There's a saying... cleansing your skin is much more important than using makeup.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
如果不每天清洁，皮肤会变坏。
有句俗话说...清洁皮肤比化妆更重要。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
You did a good job.
You helped me even though I asked suddenly like this...
To be honest, I thought you'd just leave.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
你做得很好。
虽然我是突然提出请求，但你还是帮了我...
说实话，我以为你会直接离开的。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
It's a kind of reward. Say my words to Dr. Dvor... or Devore, whatever the cat's name is.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
这是一种奖励。请把我的话转告给德沃医生...或者叫德沃，反正就是那只猫的名字。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
There's no need to wait until the study finishes. We can talk through you, and it's better to talk about the current situation...
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
不用等到研究结束。我们可以通过你交流，而且现在讨论当前的情况更好...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
This is not for you... and all of you, either. It's rather for Star Candy to get rest as soon as possible, you know!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
这不是给你的...也不是给所有人的。主要是为了让星星糖能尽快休息，你明白吗！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
I'll call you when I need you, so don't worry!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
需要你的时候我会叫你的，所以别担心！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
It's the time for Star Candy to have a meal.
Get some jellies.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
现在是星星糖吃饭的时间。
去弄些果冻来。

scripts.text: I'll help.
scripts.translation: 我会帮忙的。

scripts.text: I'll stop.
scripts.translation: 我会停下来的。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
You can get the jellies around here.
It's not that difficult, and you should come back before Star Candy's meal time!
About 30 jellies would be ok for a meal.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
你可以在附近找到果冻。
这并不难，而且你应该在星星糖吃饭时间之前回来！
大约30个果冻就够一顿了。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
What, are you talking about you let our Star Candy feel hungry?!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
什么，你在说什么？让我们可爱的星星糖饿肚子吗？！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Star Candy is really good.
She never loses her smile, even though it's so hard to stand...
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
星星糖真的很棒。
即使情况这么艰难，她也从未失去过笑容...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Rude! How come you talk to precious Star Candy!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
无礼！你怎么敢对珍贵的星星糖说话！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
You look different from the fellows that usually comes...
You also look strange, though.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
你看起来和那些通常来的人不太一样...
不过，你看起来也很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
?!
You can talk!

[Biscuit]
What?
You've never seen me talking?
What's the matter with you?
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
什么？
你以前从没见过我说话？
你脑子有问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Since I can talk with you, you seem better than those other foolish ones.
Though I learned to speak in their language, they don't understand.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
既然我能和你对话，看来你比那些愚蠢的家伙强多了。
虽然我学会了用他们的语言对话，但他们根本听不懂。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Our precious Star Candy humbly supports them, and they treat her like this.
They don't know how to express thanks!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
我们珍贵的星星糖谦虚地支持着他们，他们却这样对待她。
他们根本不知道如何表达感谢！

scripts.text: Support?
scripts.translation: 支持？

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Anyway!
It's no use to treat them well.
They don't know how hard Star Candy is trying.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
总之！
对他们好是没有用的。
他们根本不知道星星糖有多努力。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
This island used to be hers, but for the short time while she avoided storms and got here, those cats were suddenly dropped on the island.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
这座岛曾经是她的，但在她躲避风暴并到达这里的短暂时间里，那些猫突然被扔到了岛上。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Since the ground here is so soft, Star Candy was stuck in between, and the situation is now like this.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
因为这里的地面很软，星星糖卡在了中间，现在的状况就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Actually, she can get out regardless of those bad things, but she supports the ground worrying that someone will get hurt.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
实际上，不管那些坏东西如何，她都可以出来，但她担心有人受伤，所以一直支撑着地面。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Ah, ah...
What a beatiful mind...
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
啊，啊...
多么美好的心灵...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Once she moved a bit when she felt uncomfortable, and saw them in panic. She hasn't moved at all since then. I'm worried if she's not well.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
有一次她因为不舒服稍微动了一下，看到他们惊慌失措。从那以后她就再也没有动过。我担心她是不是不舒服。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Star Candy sacrifices herself like this, but those fellows are setting the pillars around her for themselves only.
Hewww!!!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
星星糖就这样牺牲了自己，但那些家伙却只顾着为自己树立标杆。
哼！！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
They talk to her, but ignore me when I talk to her.
I don't like them at all!!!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
他们跟她说话，却无视我说的话。
我一点都不喜欢他们！！！

scripts.text: - Unlike the words of Dr. Devore, Biscuit appears fluent in speaking. -
scripts.translation: - 与德沃尔博士的说法不同，饼干似乎很擅长说话。 -

scripts.text: - I think it's better to let Dr. Devore know this soon. -
scripts.translation: - 我觉得最好尽快让德沃尔博士知道这件事。 -

scripts.text:

You're a really good human being.
scripts.translation:

你真是个好人。

scripts.text:

Since I couldn't move, it was the most difficult thing to stand.
scripts.translation:
[星星糖]
因为我动不了，所以站着是最难熬的。

scripts.text:
[Star Candy]
Ah~ Feels good~
I felt itchy for so long.
scripts.translation:
[星星糖]
啊~舒服~
痒了那么久，终于好了。

scripts.text:
[Star Candy]
Thanks so much.
scripts.translation:
[星星糖]
非常感谢。

[Portali]
I have no business for an immature fellow!
scripts.translation:
[波塔利]
我才没空理不成熟的人呢！

scripts.text:
[Portali]
Hmmm...
You smell like cats even though you're a human being...
scripts.translation:
[波塔利]
嗯...
明明是人类，却有一股猫的味道...

scripts.text:
[Portali]
But... Would you like to go back to my hometown?
I'll let you go to the land of Midgard with the new skill I found!
It's not free. I'll need canned food!
scripts.translation:
[波塔利]
不过...你想回我的家乡吗？
用我新发现的技能，我可以送你去米德加尔特！
当然不是免费的，我需要罐头！

scripts.text: Veins

[Portali]
Okay...
scripts.translation:
[波塔利]
好吧...

3 for Rune-Midgarts!
6 for Schwarzwald, 5 for Arunafeltz.
Schwarzwald is the nation of prohibited magic, and Arunafeltz seems to have a curse!
scripts.translation:
[波塔利]
去卢恩·米德加兹要3个罐头！
去修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德要6个，去阿鲁纳菲兹要5个。
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德是禁止魔法的国家，而阿鲁纳菲兹似乎被诅咒了！
