scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Wow, this is nice weather. Do you like this kind of weather, too? But I need to do my work now.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
哇，天气真好。你也喜欢这种天气吗？不过我现在得去工作了。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I would ask for your help, if you were a stronger advanturer...
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
如果你是个更强的冒险家，我或许会请求你的帮助...

scripts.text: ^770099This cat is working on something, but she asks for help above level 60.^000000
scripts.translation: ^770099这只猫正在研究一些东西，但她希望60级以上的冒险家能来帮忙。^000000

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Would you come here and open your bag for me?
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
你能过来帮我把背包打开吗？

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
There are many beautiful fish around here. So I feel my heart beating standing here.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
这里有很多漂亮的鱼。站在这里，我感到心跳加速。

scripts.text: I think my heart is beating faster...
scripts.translation: 我觉得我的心跳得更快了...

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
How come you only know about eating! My heart doesn't only beat for food.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
你怎么只知道吃！我的心跳不仅仅是为了食物。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I've studied at a human university before and I learned to speak there so don't treat me like some animal.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
我以前在人类大学学习过，在那里学会了说话，所以别把我当成普通的动物。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I am a scholar of fish research.
It's important for cats to research fish.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
我是鱼类研究的学者。
对猫来说，研究鱼是很重要的。

scripts.text: How's your research going?
scripts.translation: 你的研究进展如何？

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I was a good friend of admiral Thomas but our ship hasn't gone back to sea since we arrived here.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
我是托马斯提督的好朋友，但自从我们到达这里，船就没有再出海了。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
The shipmates seem to be pretty lonely.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
船员们似乎很寂寞。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
A scholar from the university came here to research us and thought it was amazing to find a cat that speaks his language already.
So he's been helping me teach the others.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
一位来自大学的学者来这里研究我们，他惊讶地发现竟然有一只猫已经会说人类的语言。
所以他一直在帮我教其他猫。

scripts.text: Is that why I understand all the cats?
scripts.translation: 这就是为什么我能听懂所有猫的话吗？

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Yes, exactly!
I was one of the few cats who could talk to humans before that scholar arrived.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
是的，没错！
在那位学者到来之前，我是少数能与人类对话的猫之一。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Anyways, now I'm collecting specimens to study the monsters here. I hope you can help me.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
总之，我现在正在收集标本，研究这里的魔物。希望你能帮帮我。

scripts.text: How can I help you?
scripts.translation: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: I have to decline.
scripts.translation: 我不得不拒绝。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Oh, okay. If you change your mind, please come again.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
哦，好的。如果你改变主意，请再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
There is a monster called a Pouring who's eating all fish in the Octopus and Culvert dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
有一种叫水滴波利的魔物，正在小章鱼和下水道迷宫里吃掉所有的鱼。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
It suddenly appeared during the winter, so could you collect the specimens of Unidentified Fish after getting rid of it?
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
它是在冬天突然出现的，所以你能在消灭它之后，收集一些未识别的鱼的标本吗？

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
You can get Unidentified Fish from the Pouring monsters, so please collect 30 of them.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
你可以从水滴波利身上获得未识别的鱼，请收集30个。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Oh, thank you! I will take these specimens.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
哦，谢谢你！我会收下这些标本的。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I want to give you something, but the last one is out of stock now so I will just write your name here.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
我想送你点东西，但最后一件已经卖完了，所以我就把你的名字写在这里吧。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I can give you good news even from a distance, but it's only possible if I am really lucky...
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
即使隔着这么远，我也能给你带好消息，不过那得看我运气够不够好...

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I'm sorry, but please collect 30 Unidentified Fish specimens.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
很抱歉，请收集30个未识别的鱼标本。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Oh, you met admiral Tomas... how was it?
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
哦，你见到托马海军上将了...感觉怎么样？

scripts.text: He looks gentle
scripts.translation: 他看起来很温柔

scripts.text: He looks terrible
scripts.translation: 他看起来很糟糕

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Hmm...
Frankly speaking, I was a real fan of Admiral Tomas. Can you take responsibility for your word?
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
嗯...
说实话，我是托马海军上将的忠实粉丝。你能对自己的话负责吗？

scripts.text: Just kidding!
scripts.translation: 开玩笑的！

scripts.text: Oh yes, he was really terrible!
scripts.translation: 是的，他真的很糟糕！

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Is he?
Okay, it really depends on personal taste...
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
是吗？
好吧，这确实很看个人口味...

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Is he?
I knew you would say so.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
是吗？
我就知道你会这么说。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Admiral Tomas is a legendary figure who has led all of us in voyaging to this island. I think it was the happiest moment in my life.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
托马海军上将是一位传奇人物，他带领我们航行到了这座岛屿。我想那是我生命中最幸福的时刻。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Please help him a lot. There are not many people to trust. This is my personal request.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
请多帮助他。可以信任的人并不多。这是我个人的请求。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
And this is a small gift for looking after admiral Tomas.
^0000ffReceived 200 E Class Coins.^000000
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
这是照顾托马海军上将的一点小礼物。
^0000ff获得了200个E级代币。^000000

scripts.text: - Can't go next step due to having too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 物品栏已满，无法进行下一步。-

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Hmm, investigation is not enough.
We need go back to basic point.
Come again tomorrow.
I might be in pain of stomach
like usual.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
嗯，调查还不够。
我们需要回到最基本的地方。
明天再来吧。
我可能又会像往常一样肚子疼。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Are you here to help
or to get help?
You look so weak, haha...
Go and hunt more Porings!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
你是来帮忙的，还是来求帮助的？
你看起来好弱啊，哈哈...
去多打点波利吧！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Will you listen my sorrow?
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
你愿意听我倾诉一下吗？

scripts.text: Sure I will.
scripts.translation: 当然愿意。

scripts.text: No, I won't.
scripts.translation: 不，我不会。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
This is a sad story.
As usual, I unpacked the bag
to see strange cats
to show them.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
这是个悲伤的故事。
像往常一样，我打开袋子，
想给奇怪的猫们看看。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
There were lots of cans.
I thougt it was new due to different shape
but it was bad cans!
I ate too much and
got in bed right away
so I can't do anything...
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
那里有很多罐头。
因为形状不同，我以为是新货，
结果却是劣质罐头！
我吃得太多了，
直接躺到床上去了，
现在什么都做不了...

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
And by the way, you have...
nice colthes.
I can't let you go,
that hurts me so badly!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
顺便说一句，你的
衣服很漂亮。
我不能让你走，
那样我会很痛苦的！

scripts.text: You deserve the pain!
scripts.translation: 你活该痛苦！

scripts.text: Need help?
scripts.translation: 需要帮忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Yes you are!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
没错！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
You know what care is.
Please find the bad provider
and revenge our enemy!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
你知道什么是关怀。
请找到那个不良供应商，
为我们的敌人复仇！

scripts.text: No, I don't want to!
scripts.translation: 不，我不想！

scripts.text: Yes, I'll do it!
scripts.translation: 是的，我答应！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
For the peace in Malangdo,
just lay in bed forever.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为了马拉多的和平，
就永远躺在床上吧。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
I will!
I will have your peace first once I get well!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
我会的！
等我好了，我会先享受你的和平！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Okay, you can do it?
The enemy must be near the dock
where we got the bundle.
We should get them to help
our cats' well-being!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
好的，你能做到吗？
敌人应该就在我们拿到包裹的码头附近。
我们应该让他们
帮助我们的猫健康！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Why are you here!
If I am usual, I will engrave something
with your tear...
Let your bag be here instead!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
你为什么在这里！
如果我正常的话，我会用你的眼泪
刻点什么...
让你的包留在这里代替吧！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
The enemy must be near the dock
where we got the bundle.
We should get them to help
our cats' well-being!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
敌人应该就在我们拿到包裹的码头附近。
我们应该让他们
帮助我们的猫健康！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
I am so tired due to
lack of forbidden bad activity.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
因为缺乏禁止的坏活动，
我累坏了。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Was it from raccoon that made us pain in stomach?
Oh bad raccoon!
I feel stomachache again from this anger!
All right, I will show my power once
I can get out of bed.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
是浣熊让我们肚子疼的吗？
哦，坏浣熊！
这愤怒让我又胃疼了！
好吧，等我下床后，
我会展示我的力量。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
I need time to concentrate on my stomachache.
You can go now!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
我需要时间集中注意力在胃疼上。
你现在可以走了！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
How do you know the source of bad can?
Do you have time to do slow at the moment?
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
你怎么知道劣质罐头的来源？
你现在有时间慢慢做吗？

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
The Patrol Leader wants to go back to
bad world as soon as possible.
I want you to go first to soothe him instead.
How about it?
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
巡逻队长想尽快回到
那个糟糕的世界。
我想让你先去安抚他。
怎么样？

scripts.text: It's troublsome, I quit.
scripts.translation: 太麻烦了，我退出。

scripts.text: Sure I will!
scripts.translation: 当然我会！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Haha, you think it is a bad word.
I want you to be one of our staffs.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
哈哈，你觉得这是个坏词。
我想让你成为我们的职员之一。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Sorry, but you should go now
so that I can concentrate on my stomachache.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
抱歉，你现在该走了，
这样我才能专心治我的胃痛。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
All right, then I will have time
to concentrate on my stomachache.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
好吧，这样我就有时间
专心治我的胃痛了。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Hmm, investigation is not enough.
We need go back to basic point.
Come again tomorrow.
I might be in pain of stomach
like usual.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
嗯，调查还不够。
我们需要回到最基本的地方。
明天再来吧。
我可能又会像往常一样肚子疼。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Go and have fun with the Patrol Leader!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
去和巡逻队长好好玩吧！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Instead of us, you did bad behavior.
Good to hear that?
This is what teacher see best pupil?
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
明明是我们，你却做了坏事。
听到这个你很高兴吗？
这就是老师眼中最好的学生吗？

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
You deserve a reward!
I need to get some more rest,
so let's investigate tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
你值得获得奖励！
我需要多休息一会儿，
所以明天再调查吧！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Come again tomorrow.
I might be in pain of stomach
like usual.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
明天再来吧。
我可能又会像往常一样胃痛。

scripts.text:
[Gobulee]
What a time to show up!
You should come around when we're healthy.
scripts.translation:
[戈布利]
真是时候不凑巧啊！
你应该在我们健康的时候再来。

scripts.text:
[Gobyungee]
I can't even look another cat in the eye since I'm too sick to be doin' crimes properly.
scripts.translation:
[戈比昂吉]
我病得太重，连犯罪都做得不好，
甚至不敢直视其他猫的眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Gosigee]
I wish I had some peppy bistmuth pills...
Meanwhile the Captain only thinks about catching the bad guys and getting revenge!
...
scripts.translation:
[戈西吉]
真希望我有几颗让人精神振奋的铋片...
与此同时，船长只想着抓住坏人并复仇！
...

scripts.text:
[Gosigee]
How can we follow someone so single-minded!
scripts.translation:
[戈西吉]
我们怎么跟得上这么一心一意的人呢！

scripts.text:
[Gonanee]
We are the only violent gang in Malangdo and we are very proud.
I don't feel right just lying in bed.
scripts.translation:
[戈纳尼]
我们是马拉格多唯一的暴力帮派，我们非常自豪。
只是躺在床上让我感觉不对劲。

scripts.text:
[Godoree]
I saw unfamiliar cats around
the dock recently.
Are they tourists?
I should -inspect- their pockets
once I'm better...
scripts.translation:
[戈多里]
最近我在码头附近看到了陌生的猫。
它们是游客吗？
等我好了之后，我要-检查-一下它们的口袋...

scripts.text:
He appears to be listening intently.
Upon hearing you approach, he pretends to be completely oblivious.
scripts.translation:
他似乎正在专心倾听。
听到你走近，他假装完全没注意到。

scripts.text:
[Suspious Dealer]
Oh the pain, oh the pain of it all...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的商人]
哦，好痛，这一切都好痛...

scripts.text:
On listening to the story for
a while, he pretends to be indifferent once hearing someone's noise.
scripts.translation: 听了故事一会儿，听到有人靠近的声音，他假装毫不在意。

scripts.text:
[Suspious Dealer]
Could it BE any smoggier today?
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
今天的雾能再大一点吗？

scripts.text:
[A Foolish Cat]
If you stay here, you
can hear all they're saying.
Don't know exactly what, but
you do hear everything.
Hehehe...
scripts.translation:
[一只笨猫]
如果你留在这里，
就能听到他们说的所有话。
虽然不知道具体是什么，
但你确实能听到一切。
嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text: You hear a conversation between the Suspious Dealers.
scripts.translation: 你听到了可疑商人之间的对话。

scripts.text:
[Suspious Dealer]
Because unexpected robbery at that moment...
our great work has delayed.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的商人]
因为当时发生了意外的抢劫...
我们伟大的工作被延误了。

scripts.text:
[Very Suspious Dealer]
Do not worry about the thing, I placed it near balloon bag where
Ship Navi is in the north, and I hid it perfectly.
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
别担心那件事，我把它放在了北方船导航员附近的袋子旁边，
我藏得很完美。

scripts.text: You need to check a place near north of balloon bag in ship Navi.
scripts.translation: 你需要去检查位于北方气球袋附近的船导航员。

scripts.text: You still hear a suspicious conversation.
scripts.translation: 你依然能听到可疑的对话。

scripts.text:
[Suspious Dealer]
But near the balloon bag is still
worrying so much!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的商人]
但是气球袋附近的情况
还是很让人担心！

scripts.text:
[Very Suspious Dealer]
Oh how cowardly you are!
I hid it in ship Navi perfectly.
Relax!
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
你真是胆小如鼠！
我把它完美地藏在船导航员那里了。
放心吧！

scripts.text:
[Suspious Dealer]
The rest of part is in staffs.
We should believe.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的商人]
剩下的部分在职员那里。
我们应该相信他们。

scripts.text:
We need to investigate Navi first.
Let's see other guys in ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
我们需要先调查导航员。
让我们看看船导航员那里的其他人。

scripts.text: You still hear a suspicious conversation.
scripts.translation: 你依然能听到可疑的对话。

scripts.text:
[Suspious Dealer]
Star candy is still healthy,
what happens?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的商人]
星星糖还安然无恙，
发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Very Suspious Dealer]
No way...
We should get more bad cans.
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
不可能...
我们得弄更多坏罐头。

scripts.text: There's a memo.
scripts.translation: 有一张备忘。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Here is not what we wanted, huh!
scripts.translation:
[备忘]
这里不是我们想要的地方，对吧！

scripts.text: ...do listen the conversation of merchant.
scripts.translation: ...去听听商人的对话。

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
We quit selling them, find another merchant!
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
我们停止出售这些了，去找别的商人吧！

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
Bad cans?
Due to lots of work in here
can't have a short time to talk?
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
坏罐头？
这里工作太忙了，
没空跟你闲聊？

scripts.text: Look suspicious?
scripts.translation: 看起来可疑？

scripts.text: I knew all things here!
scripts.translation: 我都知道这里的情况！

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
I have a same boat with you!
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
我们是一条船上的人！

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
...
You searched the lounge of ship Navi?
...
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
...
你搜查了船导航员的休息室？
...

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
It looks wrong place~
Go and do other things~!
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
看起来找错地方了~
去干点别的吧~！

scripts.text: You need to search lounge of ship Navi?
scripts.translation: 你需要搜查船导航员的休息室？

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
A thought to search Gozangee around ship Navi
is like to ride a skill
with frying pan, it is idiot things.
I do not recommend.
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
想要搜查船导航员周围的戈赞吉，
就像拿着平底锅去骑马一样，
简直是蠢事。
我不推荐。

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
You searched the lounge of ship Navi?
But still nothing in hand.
I told you there's nothing.
...
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
你搜查了导航员船的休息室？
但还是一无所获。
我早就告诉过你那里什么都没有。
...

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
...there must be something...
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
...那里肯定有什么东西...

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
Oh! That's ^0000FFa sack of bad cans^000000, isn't it?
Where did you get it? Amazing!
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
哦！那是^0000FF一袋坏罐头^000000，对吧？
你从哪弄来的？太厉害了！

scripts.text: Do not pretend not to know!
scripts.translation: 别装不知道！

scripts.text: Need to show them our general!
scripts.translation: 需要向它们展示我们的首领！

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
It just looks wonderful.
There's nothing more to have?
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
看起来很不错。
没有别的东西了吗？

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
Relax!
Let's have smile and fun with only ours.
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
放轻松！
让我们只属于我们自己的微笑和乐趣。

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
To be honest, I am a member of raccoon hurray team.
A homeless community of raccoons
became a black market group.
I will make headquater of raccoon hurray team here
after kick out group of cats.
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
说实话，我是浣熊欢呼队的一员。
一群无家可归的浣熊
组成了一个黑市团伙。
在赶走那群猫之后，
我会把这里变成浣熊欢呼队的大本营。

scripts.text: Are you the leader?
scripts.translation: 你是首领吗？

scripts.text: Let me clear the usage of bad can.
scripts.translation: 让我解释一下坏罐头的用途。

scripts.text: Can it be worked as you want?
scripts.translation: 它能按你的意愿运作吗？

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
This is thankful misunderstanding,
I am just little staff.
I don't know who the leader is.
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
这是一个令人感激的误会，
我只是个小职员。
我不知道首领是谁。

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
That is...
for food...
Don't ask me more, please!
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
那是...
用来吃的...
请别再问了！

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
You look down out raccoon hurray team?
Look more! To my star candy who stands island
I will make them have stomachache
with lots of bad cans.
Aren't you expecting?
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
你看不起浣熊欢呼队？
看好了！对于站在岛上的星星糖，
我会用大量的坏罐头让它们肚子疼。
你不期待吗？

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
I can't make him eat with my hand,
to creature in shining coral area that is basic food of star candy
I am still feeding them with bad cans.
You must see amazing reaction, just wait!
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]
我无法用手喂它，
对于在发光珊瑚区以星星糖为基本食物的生物，
我还在用坏罐头喂它们。
你一定会看到惊人的反应，等着瞧吧！

scripts.text:
The situation is serious.
Once the cats figure out,
you might be confused.
Let's withdraw the bad cans first,
located in the shining coral area.
scripts.translation:
情况很严重。
一旦猫发现了，
你可能会陷入混乱。
让我们先撤回坏罐头，
它们位于发光珊瑚区。

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
Plese forget what I have told you.
Please...
After you got 30 pcs of bad cans
in shining coral area
do not tell the cats
or report this fact!
scripts.translation:
[极其可疑的商人]

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Even though I have no time to spare, I usually serve a plate of soup gladly, but now!
The ingredient is infested with worms cause of one stupid's carelessness!
scripts.translation:

虽然我平时没空，但通常都乐意端上一盘汤，但现在！
因为某个蠢货的疏忽，食材里长满了虫子！

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Therefore, when my blaze of anger becomes quiet like a calm sea, come back again!
By the way, where is that stupid!
scripts.translation:

所以，等我的怒火像平静的海面一样平息下来后，再来找我！
顺便问一下，那个蠢货在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
I'm a unique chef in entire fleet.
Do you want something from me?
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
我是整支舰队里独一无二的厨师。
你需要我做什么吗？

scripts.text: Show the cat's ship biscuit.

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Hm? is this cat's ship biscuit?
Specially, I can feel the flow of time from this biscuit.
By the way, how can you have this?
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
嗯？这是猫饼干？
特别的是，我能从这块饼干中感受到时间的流动。
顺便问一下，你怎么会有这个？

scripts.text:
He is telling the story that place where he found cat's ship biscuit and
Explain the Cleanyang's story.
scripts.translation:
他正在讲述发现猫饼干的地方，
并解释清洁羊的故事。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Why that stupid?
Are you trying to make a thunder storm in the calm sea?!
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
为什么是那个蠢货？
你是想在平静的海面上掀起雷暴吗？！

scripts.text:
Pacify an angry chef
Explain a misunderstanding about Cleanyang and tell whole story of cat's ship biscuit.
scripts.translation:
安抚愤怒的厨师
解释关于清洁羊的误会，并讲述猫饼干的全部故事

scripts.text:

So this is happening because of cat buscuit?

scripts.translation:

所以这一切都是因为这猫饼干？
没错，这就是那个故事吗？

scripts.text: You are quick understand.

scripts.translation:

..........他真是个混蛋！
而且，什么？在船长室又找到了一块？！

scripts.text:

Thomas......
He has position that should take the lead to sailors, but he got a wrong?
Ududuk.
scripts.translation:

托马斯......
他本应带领水手们，却犯了这样的错？
真是的。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
This cat's ship biscuit was! Always thankful food to help our starvation during a long sailing!
No matter what taste, It always saves us at crossroads of life and death!
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
这块猫饼干！在漫长的航行中，它总是帮助我们度过饥饿的珍贵食物！
无论味道如何，它总是在生死关头救了我们！

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Although the situation is not able to use fire for a month, two month even 1000 days!
This is blessed food to guarantee on open sea!
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
虽然情况不允许使用火，哪怕是一个月、两个月，甚至一千天！
这是保证在公海上生存的神圣食物！

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
How many chef cats have difficult time to make a cat's ship biscuit!
The military discipline has been relaxed because we settled down on island! Already forget the dangerous situation?!
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
有多少厨师猫在制作猫饼干时感到困难！
因为我们在岛上定居，军纪已经松懈了！难道已经忘记了危险的处境吗？！

scripts.text:
Chef is outraged and very upset.
He mumbled and made a threatening sound with grind his teeth.
Come back later when he calms down.
scripts.translation:
厨师非常愤怒，情绪很不稳定。
他低声嘟囔着，咬牙切齿地发出威胁的声音。
等他冷静下来后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
There you are? I made a bad break.
I made a big decision when you are out for me.
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
你来了？我做了个糟糕的决定。
在你不在的时候，我做了个大决定。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
After settled down on Island, depraved mindset cause of plentiful foods.
Therefore, I'll change the menu that cat's ship biscuit is provided for one meal a day!.
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
在岛上定居后，因为食物充足，心态变得颓废了。
因此，我将改变菜单，每天只提供一顿猫饼干！

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
That ingredient is needed to make cat's ship biscuit.
There is no wheat on this island, so I need to get your help.
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
制作猫饼干需要这种食材。
这个岛上没有小麦，所以我需要你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Anything is possible to grind flour and knead dough.
Please bring that kind of ^4d4dff10 Grain^000000 and ^4d4dff 1 Plain Sauce^000000.
Replace salt with seawater..
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
任何东西都可以磨成面粉并揉成面团。
请带来那种^4d4dff10谷物^000000和^4d4dff 1普通酱汁^000000。
用海水代替盐...

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Could we get them easily on land?
I'll get the rest what I need.
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
我们在陆地上能轻松得到它们吗？
剩下的我会自己准备。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
I'll fix their taste that is crazy for canned food.
He approached like a calm sea that has horrible thunder storm
I'll give a pain like a god of sea's anger! Kmeow~~!!
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
我会修正那些罐头食品疯狂的味道。
他像平静的海面下隐藏着可怕的雷暴一样靠近
我会给你像海神愤怒一样的痛苦！喵呜~~！！

scripts.text:
A look of chef is quite serious.
Let me tell Cleanyang about the result first.
scripts.translation:
厨师的表情相当严肃。
让我先告诉清洁羊结果。

scripts.text:
Chef is still trying to soothe his anger.
Maybe need more time.
scripts.translation:
厨师仍在努力平息他的愤怒。
也许需要更多时间。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Finally here. Wow, this land is pretty different.
That is enough to process.
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
终于来了。哇，这片土地很不一样。
这就足够了，可以处理了。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
If you are ok, I want to get these food everyday.
If you don't mind, just come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
如果你没问题，我想每天获取这些食物。
如果你不介意，明天再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
That ingredient is needed to make cat's ship biscuit.
There is no wheat on this island, so I need to get your help.
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
制作猫饼干需要这种食材。
这个岛上没有小麦，所以我需要你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Anything is possible to grind flour and knead dough.
Please bring that kind of ^4d4dff10 Grain^000000 and ^4d4dff 1 Plain Sauce^000000.

scripts.translation:

请带来那种^4d4dff10谷物^000000和^4d4dff 1普通酱汁^000000。
用海水代替盐...

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
There you are.
It's not mealtime... Why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
你来了。
现在不是用餐时间... 你为什么在这里？

scripts.text: What's today's work?
scripts.translation: 今天的工作是什么？

scripts.text: Food Delivery
scripts.translation: 食物配送

scripts.text: Just bored...
scripts.translation: 只是无聊...

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Now, cat's ship biscuit is being baked in this oven.
It's all for your delivery food.
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
现在，猫饼干正在这个烤箱里烘烤。
这都是为了你的配送食物。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Quiet wave with a little salty and savory smell.
The food of sea is coming to make sailor's heart flutter.
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
安静的波浪带着一丝咸味和香味。
海上的食物即将让水手的心怦怦直跳。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
I've got enough ingredients of cat's ship biscuit today.
Let me order next time.
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
今天的猫饼干材料已经备齐了。
下次再让我下单吧。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Um? You are dull.
You already took my order list?
Just take care of them.
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
嗯？你反应真慢。
你已经接过我的订单清单了吗？
那就好好处理一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Here you are.
I need ingredients for cat's ship biscuit now. Fortunately, you are here at the right moment.
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
给你。
我现在需要猫饼干的原料。幸好你来得正是时候。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Could you bring some ingrediednts for cat's ship biscuit from land?

[厨师 尼亚斯]
你能从陆地上带一些猫饼干的原料来吗？
如果你同意的话，我还有件事想拜托你...

scripts.text: I'm busy today.
scripts.translation: 我今天很忙。

scripts.text: Sure, what are you need?
scripts.translation: 当然，你需要什么？

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
That is sad news.
However, it's ok. Cat's ship biscuit is originally prepared food.
Anyway, today's biscuit wll be provided when the second moon is full.
scripts.translation:

真是遗憾的消息。
不过没关系。猫饼干本来就是预制食品。

Kmeow!!

你想从我这里听到什么？！
喵呜！！
猫饼干的硬度就像在海上坚守的贵族意志一样！

Only idiot who does not take care of preserving says like that.
Dry enough and seal it in cool dry place. Tut-tut.

只有不注重保存的傻瓜才会这么说。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Anyway Is that all about protein?

scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
总之，关于蛋白质就到此为止了吗？
如果让你在意，为什么不在晚上吃呢！

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Never throw food!
When you are hit by cat's ship biscuit, you will get bruise or bleeding but
It is not that reason!!!
Do not play with food!
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
绝不浪费食物！
被猫饼干击中时，你可能会淤青或流血，
但这不是原因！！！
不要拿食物开玩笑！

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
The ingredients of cat's ship biscuit are 10 Grain and 1 Plain Sauce as usual.
And I'd like to study food of human, so bring one of them.
scripts.translation:

猫饼干的原料通常是10个谷物和1个普通酱汁。

^4d4dff {0} ^000000 .

我好奇的料理是...
^4d4dff {0} ^000000。

^ff0000I will refuse the instant food.^000000
scripts.translation:

你必须用新鲜食材制作的料理带过来。
^ff0000我会拒绝即食食品。^000000

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Hey my friend, you have a bad memory.
Did you already take my order list?
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
嘿，我的朋友，你的记性真差。
你已经接过我的订单清单了吗？

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Do you remember what I ask to bring?
I have no idea.
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
你记得我让你带什么吗？
我完全没印象。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
What did I say to bring?
I don't remember?
Did you get something wrong to come here?
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
我让你带什么来着？
我不记得了？
你是不是搞错了才来这里的？

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Is that ingredients of cat's ship biscuit and the food of human?
Let me check what you brought...
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
那是猫饼干的食材，还有人类的料理吗？
让我看看你带了什么...

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Great.
This is that food!
It will be good reference. Well done.
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
很好。
这就是那种料理！
这会是不错的参考。干得好。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Alright, could you come tomorrow?
When the time to you coming, I'm very excited.
Nyahuh Nyahuh
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
好的，明天能来吗？
当你来的时候，我非常期待。
喵呜 喵呜

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Yummm...
Did I overestimate your ability?
Double check what is short and bring them properly.
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
美味...
我是不是高估你的能力了？
仔细检查还缺什么，并正确地带来。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
There is not different from undiscerning young cat.
scripts.translation:
[厨师 尼亚斯]
这和没见识的小猫没什么两样。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
You are quite bold like a killer whale.
If you don't have any business, don't touch vegetable and go away.
scripts.translation:

你像虎鲸一样大胆。
如果没有事，别碰蔬菜，快离开。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed in this quest. -

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Seems like a visitor.
How does this island look?
It is hard to believe, but this ground is very soft, so we named this island Malangdo.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
看起来像是访客。
这座岛看起来怎么样？
虽然难以置信，但这地面非常柔软，所以我们把这座岛命名为马拉贡多。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
If you were a more professional adventurer, I'd ask you one thing...
Well, I won't do it.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
如果你是个更专业的冒险者，我会问你一件事...
算了，我不问了。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Hey there.
I am Rato, do you have a moment?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
嘿，你好。
我是拉托，你有空吗？

scripts.text: Yeah, sure I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，我有空。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I'm busy right now.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我现在很忙。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Well, nothing special, but could you do me a favor?
Did you see the kids gathered on your way here?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
嗯，没什么特别的事，但你能帮我个忙吗？
你在来的路上看到聚集的小孩们了吗？

scripts.text: Kids?
scripts.translation: 小孩？

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Yes yes, baby kids.
They are the youngest kids among the merchants and crews.
They feel anxious that they might not be able to go back home.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
是的，是的，小宝宝们。
他们是商人和船员中最年幼的孩子。
他们担心自己可能无法回家，感到很焦虑。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
And they are getting bored of living on this small island.
They already tasted sea and adventure...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
而且他们厌倦了在这座小岛上生活。
他们已经尝过了大海和冒险的滋味...

scripts.text:
[Rato]
They used to play with making things, but seem tired of that also...
If it's okay, would you play with them for a while?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
他们以前喜欢玩制作东西的游戏，但似乎也玩腻了...
如果不介意的话，你能陪他们玩一会儿吗？

scripts.text: Uh, sure...
scripts.translation: 嗯，好吧...

scripts.text: I don't have enough time for that.
scripts.translation: 我没有足够的时间做那件事。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Oh, thank you!
Then, where are they?
Maybe near Beginning Compass...?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
哦，谢谢你！
那么，他们在哪里？
也许在起始罗盘附近...？

scripts.text:
[Rato]
They are so active that I am not sure where they are now.
If you meet them, please spend time with them.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
他们太活泼了，我不确定他们现在在哪里。
如果你遇到他们，请陪他们玩一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Oh, really?
It's okay even though you cannot do this right now.
If you meet them, please spend time with them.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
哦，是吗？
虽然你现在没空也没关系。
如果你遇到他们，请陪他们玩一会儿。

scripts.text: If you meet them, please spend time with them.
scripts.translation: 如果你遇到他们，请陪他们玩一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
The youngest one is Charo, with gold fur.
Roku has black fur, and Rosy has white fur.
Please take care of them.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
最小的是查罗，有着金色的毛发。
罗库是黑色的毛发，罗西是白色的毛发。
请照顾好他们。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Oh, really?
I am sorry for disturbing you.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
哦，是吗？
抱歉打扰你了。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
The youngest one is Charo, with gold fur.
Roku has black fur, and Rosy has white fur.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
最小的是查罗，有着金色的毛发。
罗库是黑色的毛发，罗西是白色的毛发。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
We can look forward to the moment we can go back home if these children grow up nicely.
For that reason, please take care of them.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
如果这些孩子能好好长大，我们就能期待回到家的日子了。
所以，请照顾好他们。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Do kids disturb you too much?
What... adventurer group? Did you play with toys from the adventurer group?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
孩子们太吵了吗？
什么...冒险者团体？你是用冒险者团体的玩具玩的吗？

scripts.text:
[Rato]
I really worried about them the first time we were shipwrecked to this island...
They thought the first voyage was huge adventure...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
第一次被冲到这个岛上时，我真的很担心他们...
他们觉得第一次航行就是一场巨大的冒险...

scripts.text:
[Rato]
They look excited, like they got a fever.
It seems like yesterday that I made toys for them and soothed them...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
他们看起来兴奋得像是发烧了一样。
感觉就像昨天我才给他们做玩具安抚他们...

scripts.text: Rato seems to be in brown study.
scripts.translation: 拉托似乎在沉思。

scripts.text:
You didn't bring the pieces of the painting.
Please take it with you.
scripts.translation:
你没有带来画作的碎片。
请把它带走。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
What's going on?
It should be very hard to take care of the kids even though I asked you, isn't it?
I am sorry, I should take care of them...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
怎么了？
虽然是我拜托你的，但照顾孩子一定很困难吧？
对不起，我应该自己照顾他们的...

scripts.text: You hand Rato a piece of painting.
scripts.translation: 你把画作的碎片递给拉托。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Oh, this is a piece of painting?
Ah!!!
Has this painting been torn up already?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
哦，这是画作的碎片？
啊！！！
这幅画已经被撕碎了吗？

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Did they say this is a gift for me?
Huhhuh, a piece of painting?
HAHAHAHAHA!
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
他们说这是送给我的礼物？
呼呼呼，画作的碎片？
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Okay, I will patch up this painting by myself.
They are still the same.
I think I should worry about myself first...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
好吧，我会自己修补这幅画的。
他们还是老样子。
我觉得我应该先担心一下自己...

scripts.text:
[Rato]
It's very kind of you to play with the kids.
This is for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
谢谢你陪孩子们玩。
这是给你的。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
I owe you a big favor!
Let's drink today!
Miaow~
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
我欠你一个大人情！
今天一起喝酒吧！
喵呜~

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Hey, how's it going? If you have time please look at it.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
嘿，最近怎么样？如果有时间的话请看一下这个。

scripts.text: Look at a picture.
scripts.translation: 看看画

scripts.text: Don't look at a picture.
scripts.translation: 不看画

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Yes, they drew this picture full of happiness.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
是的，他们画了这幅充满幸福的画。

scripts.text: Appreciate the picture in the frame.
scripts.translation: 欣赏相框里的画。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Why don't you look at such a nice picture?
I'm disapointed.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
这么好看的画你都不看吗？
真让人失望。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed in this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品栏太满了，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text:
There are cats who seem younger than the other crew.
They are having a serious conversation about the weird machine in front of them.
scripts.translation:
有几只猫看起来比其他队员年纪小。
他们正在严肃地讨论面前那台奇怪的机器。

scripts.text:
There are cats who seem younger than the other crew.
They are having a serious conversation about the weird machine in front of them.
They look like the kids that Rato told me about.
scripts.translation:
有几只猫看起来比其他队员年纪小。
他们正在严肃地讨论面前那台奇怪的机器。
他们看起来就像拉托跟我说的那些小孩。

scripts.text: Just watch them without a word.
scripts.translation: 默默地看着他们

scripts.text: Busy right now.
scripts.translation: 现在很忙

scripts.text: You try to listen to the conversation without disturbing them.
scripts.translation: 你试图在不打扰他们的情况下偷听他们的谈话。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
When will it be fixed? When it will be done?
Isn't this the last one?
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
什么时候能修好？什么时候能完工？
这不是最后一个吗？

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Um... you don't even get tried of it?
Anyway, we are in trouble.
The glass bead is broken.
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
嗯...你们难道不觉得烦吗？
总之，我们遇到麻烦了。
玻璃珠碎了。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Don't we have an extra glass bead?
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
我们有没有备用的玻璃珠？

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
No, we don't have any.
We can't fix this without it, right?
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
没有，我们一个都没有。
没有它，我们修不了这个，对吧？

scripts.text: The cats look your way at the same time.
scripts.translation: 那些猫同时看向了你。

scripts.text: I have a spare Glass Bead!
scripts.translation: 我有备用的玻璃珠！

scripts.text: Why are you guys staring at me?
scripts.translation: 你们为什么盯着我看？

scripts.text:
[Roku]
There is no glass bead.
Don't lie to us.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
没有玻璃珠。
别骗我们。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Really? Oh, really?
It's a bead! And a shining glass bead as well!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
真的吗？哦，真的吗？
是珠子！而且是一颗闪闪发光的玻璃珠！

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Hmm. This is enough to replace it.
Like this...
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
嗯。这个足够用来替换了。
就这样...

scripts.text:
[Roku]
And then here, this?
Done.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
然后，这里呢？
完成了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Exciting!!!
Okay, adventurer! We'll give you the right to use this machine!
Try this whenever you want to!!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
太棒了！！！
好了，冒险者！我们授予你使用这台机器的权利！
随时都可以来试试哦！！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Advanturer! This is a delicious can.
You can get whatever you want with cans in this island. It is tradable.
Rosy, Roku and I collected them.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
冒险者！这是一罐美味的罐头。
在这个岛上，罐头可以买到你想要的任何东西。它是可以交易的。
罗西、罗库和我收集了它们。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
And adventurer!
If you were a real adventurer,
you would clear all Nyadventures
made by the Meow Bravery Team!
Challenge it whenever you want to!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
还有，冒险者！
如果你是一个真正的冒险者，
你一定会完成由喵勇队制作的所有喵冒险！
随时都可以来挑战哦！

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
We are just looking at you as you stand there.
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
我们就只是看着你站在那里。

scripts.text: I'll come again later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
We fixed the Duruduru compass, we only need a visitor now...
Hey, do you want to be a visitor?
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
我们修好了嘟嘟罗盘，现在只需要一位访客了...
嘿，你想当访客吗？

scripts.text: A visitor?
scripts.translation: 访客？

scripts.text:
[Charo]
This is an adventure course made by the Meow adventure team.
Especially we have added studying course this time.
It's simple to solve, you only need to find compass in this island according to order.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
这是由喵冒险队制作的冒险课程。
这次我们特别加入了学习课程。
解题很简单，你只需要按照顺序在这个岛上找到罗盘即可。

scripts.text: I'll give it a try.
scripts.translation: 我试试看。

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Here is your Adventure Card.
This is the Duruduru Compass which we fixed with the glass bead you gave us.
And this is the Beginning Compass.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
这是你的冒险卡。
这是我们用你给我们的玻璃珠修好的嘟嘟罗盘。
还有这个，是起始罗盘。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The game will start if you put the Adventure Card in here!
This machine is for testing essential ingredients of adventure.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
把冒险卡插在这里，游戏就会开始！
这台机器是用来测试冒险必备要素的。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Don't forget the destination for successful adventure.
And you should find a way to get to your destination as fast as possible.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
别忘了成功冒险的目的地。
而且你应该尽快找到到达目的地的方法。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You will be good, as you are a good person for giving us the glass bead.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你会做得很好的，毕竟你是个好人，还给了我们玻璃珠。

scripts.text:
Got Adventure Card from the yellow cat Charo.
It seems to work if I put this card in the slot in the Beginning Compass.
scripts.translation:
从黄猫查罗那里拿到了冒险卡。
看起来把这张卡插进起始罗盘的插槽里就能用了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The game will start if you scratch Adventure Card to the Beginning Compass!
The Beginning Compass will let you know where you should go.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
把冒险卡在起始罗盘上刮一下，游戏就会开始！
起始罗盘会告诉你该去哪里。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
^4d4dffIf you go through all the compasses, you will see Meowbell from the ship Navi at last!
Ring the New bell!^000000
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
^4d4dff如果你通过了所有的罗盘，最后你会看到来自“纳维”号船的喵铃！
敲响新铃铛！^000000

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Ah... you are not going to do it...
Um...
Sob~
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
啊...你不打算做吗...
嗯...
呜~
喵~

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Hey, adventurer. Don't make kids cry!
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
嘿，冒险者。别让孩子哭！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Oh? Isn't this failed stamp from Bubi?
I'm really disappointed.
Try again~ you can make it!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
哦？这不是布比失败的印章吗？
我真的很失望。
再试一次~ 你能做到的！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The game will start if you scratch Adventure Card to the Beginning Compass!
The Beginning Compass will let you know where you should go.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
把冒险卡在起始罗盘上刮一下，游戏就会开始！
起始罗盘会告诉你该去哪里。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
^4d4dffIf you go through all the compasses, you will see Meowbell from the ship Navi at last!
Ring the New bell!^000000
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
^4d4dff如果你通过了所有的罗盘，最后你会看到来自“纳维”号船的喵铃！
敲响新铃铛！^000000

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Where is your Adventure Card?
You should bring it with you.
You can't be serious that you threw it away with your other trash!!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你的冒险卡在哪里？
你应该随身带着它。
你不会真的把它和你的其他垃圾一起扔了吧！！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
I heard it!
I heard sound of Meowbell!
You are great!
The next will be a big case!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
我听到了！
我听到了喵铃的声音！
你太棒了！
接下来将是一桩大案子！

scripts.text: The next?
scripts.translation: 接下来？

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You are member of the Meow Bravery Team while you have the card with you.
We need an adventurer like you anyways, since this is a big case.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
只要带着这张卡，你就是喵勇者小队的成员。
反正我们需要像你这样的冒险者，毕竟这是一桩大案子。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
It's for the cuff.
It seems a bomb is planted in this island.
The detective has went for this case already.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
这是为了手铐。
似乎这座岛上被安置了炸弹。
侦探已经去处理这个案子了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You should go there too!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你也应该去那里！

scripts.text: Why do I have to go there?
scripts.translation: 我为什么要去那里？

scripts.text: What an adventure! I'll take it!
scripts.translation: 多么刺激的冒险！我接了！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
This is a big case!
And this island could explode!
Oh, you might shut your eyes to the fact.
Give the Adventure Card back!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
这是一桩大案子！
而且这座岛可能会爆炸！
哦，你竟然想视而不见。
把冒险卡还给我！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You have great capabilities as an adventurer!
Please help detective and his friend who got in trouble and also save this island!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你作为冒险者的能力非常出色！
请帮助陷入困境的侦探和他的朋友，同时也拯救这座岛！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
But be sure this should be done undercover!
Therefore you need to take this certification.
It shouldn't happen that the detective misunderstands you as an enemy!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
但请务必秘密行动！
因此你需要领取这个证件。
不能让侦探误会你是敌人！

scripts.text: - Changed Adventure Card A into Adventure Card B. -
scripts.translation: - 将冒险卡A 变更为冒险卡B。-

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The great detective and his friend will be around the ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
伟大的侦探和他的朋友会在“纳维”号船附近。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Do you feel a disposition to help the detective and his friend?
Don't you?
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你有想要帮助侦探和他朋友的意愿吗？
难道没有吗？

scripts.text: Yes I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，我有。

scripts.text: No I don't.
scripts.translation: 不，我没有。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You have great capabilities as an adventurer!
Please help detective and his friend who got in trouble and also save this island!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你作为冒险者的能力非常出色！
请帮助陷入困境的侦探和他的朋友，同时也拯救这座岛！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
But be sure this should be done undercover!
Therefore you need to take this certification.
It shouldn't happen that the detective misunderstands you as an enemy!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
但请务必秘密行动！
因此你需要领取这个证件。
不能让侦探误会你是敌人！

scripts.text: - Changed Adventure Card A into Adventure Card B. -
scripts.translation: - 将冒险卡A 变更为冒险卡B。-

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The great detective and his friend will be acound ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
伟大的侦探和他的朋友会在“纳维”号船附近。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Oh my god, the great detective and the ship Navi...
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
天哪，伟大的侦探和“纳维”号船...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The great detective and his friend will be around the ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
伟大的侦探和他的朋友会在“纳维”号船附近。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
I have been waiting for you...~
Oh, I am short of breath from coming here in a hurry.
Hmph... Meow...
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
我一直在等你...~
哦，我急匆匆赶过来，有点喘不过气了。
哼...喵...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Don't you have anything to show me?
Let me see it quickly!
Take it out!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你没有什么东西要给我看吗？
快点让我看看！
拿出来！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
What? You don't have it?
It can't be true.
Surely you took this with you...
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
什么？你没有带？
这不可能。
你肯定把它带在身边了...

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
How come it happened?
This painting is very important for us.
Please give it back to us.
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
怎么会发生这种事？
这幅画对我们来说非常重要。
请把它还给我们。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Yes, this is it!
This is our...
But, how do we put the broken pieces together?
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
没错，就是这个！
这是我们的...
但是，该怎么把碎片拼回去呢？

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
We need a board and glue as well to put it together.
That's too troublesome to just give it away!
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
我们需要一块板和胶水才能把它拼好。
光是这样送出去太麻烦了吧！

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Rato, looks like he is happy.
He will understand.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
拉托，看起来他很高兴。
他会明白的。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Really...?
There is no Meow team and us without Rato.
I feel a little bad to give only pieces of painting but...
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
真的吗...？
没有拉托，就没有喵队和我们。
只送画片过去，我觉得有点过意不去...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
We have no other way!
Rato treated this by himself!
No, it's better to ask Rato to put this back together.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
我们别无他法！
拉托自己会处理好的！
不，还是让拉托自己把它拼回去比较好。

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Good idea.
That's really a good idea.
I was getting tired of it.
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
好主意。
真是个好主意。
我都快被它烦死了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You are a member of the Meow Bravery Team.
Please give these pieces of painting to Rato.
And tell him to treat it preciously as our treasure...
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你是喵勇队的成员。
请把这些画片交给拉托。
并告诉他，请像对待我们的宝物一样珍视它...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
We couldn't make the Bravery Team without Rato.
Please.
Tell him we didn't forget our home island.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
没有拉托，我们就组不成勇队。
拜托了。
告诉他，我们没有忘记我们的家乡岛屿。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Please give this pating to Rato.
We drawed this painting to show Rato.
Please.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
请把这幅画交给拉托。
我们画这幅画是为了给拉托看的。
拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Here you are! Our emeritus member of the new Bravery Team!
Where did you go for adventure today?
Are these adventure stories?!
If not, then...
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
给你！新勇队的荣誉成员！
你今天去哪里冒险了？
这些是冒险故事吗？！
如果不是，那么...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You might have come here for the compass race like huge tuna from our Meow Bravery Team!!
Meow!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你可能是像我们喵勇队的大金枪鱼一样，来参加指南针比赛的吧！！
喵！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Well, Homnya and Nyangson are too difficult for me.
...?
I meant the book is difficult for me.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
嗯，霍姆尼亚和喵森对我来说太难了。
...？
我是说这本书对我来说太难了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Do you know how much Rato loves the painting which you have found?
He put framed the painting on the wall!
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你知道拉托有多喜欢你找到的那幅画吗？
他把画框起来挂在墙上了！
喵~

scripts.text:
[Charo]
I miss my hometown.
But Malangdo is also my hometown as well.
I am okay with us all together in here~
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
我想念我的家乡。
但马拉格多也是我的家乡。
我们大家在一起在这里，我就很好~

scripts.text:
A young cat with white fur tries so hard with the weird machine.
The machine might be broken.
scripts.translation:
一只白毛小猫正努力摆弄着那个奇怪的机器。
机器可能坏了。

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Um? The adventurer who brought us the glass bead?
I really thank you for that.
We could fix the compass with that glass bead.
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
嗯？是给我们带来玻璃珠的冒险者吗？
真的非常感谢你。
我们靠那颗玻璃珠修好了指南针。

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Adventure Card? Will you do the Duruduru race?
It's hard to say it's fun even though we made it.
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
冒险卡片？你要参加嘟嘟鲁比赛吗？
虽然是我们做的，但很难说它有趣。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Oh, it's fun! Perfectly fun!
I have remodeled it this time!!
It will be really fun!!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
哦，很有趣！非常有趣！
这次我重新改装了它！！
一定会很好玩的！！

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Yes. It's fun, as Charo said.
Maybe.
...
It is.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
是的。就像查罗说的那样，很有趣。
也许吧。
...
确实如此。

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Meow...
I feel sleepy today.
I've had sore throat these day because I talked too much...
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
喵...
我今天好困。
这几天话太多，嗓子都疼了...

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Don't you agree with me, friend?
...?
Oh, I didn't even realize...
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
朋友，你同意我的说法吗？
...？
哎呀，我都没注意到...

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Forget about it!
Doesn't this machine ever break?
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
算了！
这台机器怎么老是坏？

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed in this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品栏太满了，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text:
A young black cat helps the busy white cat.
Maybe the machine is broken.
scripts.translation:
一只小黑猫正在帮忙碌的白猫。
也许机器真的坏了。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Oh? You are the one who gave us the glass bead.
Thanks a lot.
I am happy, too, because Charo looks happy.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
哦？是给我们玻璃珠的那位。
非常感谢。
我也很高兴，因为查罗看起来很开心。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Charo likes it.
It will be fun.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
查罗很喜欢它。
一定很好玩。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Charo has been waiting for so long.
To Charo...
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
查罗已经等了很久了。
给查罗...

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Do you have something to tell me?
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
你有什么要告诉我的吗？

scripts.text: Report results of the race.
scripts.translation: 汇报比赛结果

scripts.text: Challenge the race.
scripts.translation: 挑战比赛

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Bubi, no confirmation stamps and card.
You will be in trouble if you are like this.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
布比，没有确认印章和卡片。
你这样会惹麻烦的。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Good job.
You are very smart.
This is a gift for you.
Please come tomorrow again.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
做得好。
你很聪明。
这是给你的礼物。
请明天再来。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Charo likes you so much.
He will be happy if you come.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
查罗很喜欢你。
如果你来，他会很高兴。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Failed...
...is it too difficult for you?
But the race is available only once a day.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
失败了...
...这对你来说太难了吗？
但比赛每天只能参加一次。

scripts.text: Give me one more chance!
scripts.translation: 再给我一次机会！

scripts.text: Okay.I will try tomorrow.
scripts.translation: 好的。我明天再试。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Um... Um... Well...
If you bring a Malangdo Can,
I will give you one more chance.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
嗯...嗯...好吧...
如果你带来一罐Malangdo Can，
我会再给你一次机会。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Okay. Do you want to exchange 1 Malangdo Can for a Adventure Card?
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
好的。你想用1罐Malangdo Can兑换一张冒险卡吗？

scripts.text: Exchange for Adventure Card A.
scripts.translation: 兑换冒险卡A

scripts.text: Stop it.
scripts.translation: 停下

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You have it already?
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
你已经有了吗？

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Here is your Adventure Card.
Beginning Compass, start!
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
这是你的冒险卡。
起始罗盘，出发！

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Okay, come again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
好的，明天再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Okay, come again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
好的，明天再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You have reported the result for today already.
Right?
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
你今天已经报告过结果了，
对吧？

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You are too hasty.
You didn't even finish the race.
It's still going.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
你太心急了。
你甚至还没跑完比赛。
比赛还在进行中。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
The result is little weird, but...
This is neither a complete race nor incomplete race.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
结果有点奇怪，但是...
这既不是完整的比赛，也不是不完整的比赛。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Is this because of the machine?
Let's make void for this race.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
这是因为机器的问题吗？
让我们把这次比赛作废吧。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You have failed?
Do you want to try again?
I will delete the report of the failed result.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
你失败了？
你想再试一次吗？
我会删除失败的结果报告。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
No, not yet.
Duruduru race is only once for a day.
If we do it more often, the machine will break.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
不，现在还不行。
嘟嘟罗盘比赛一天只有一次。
如果太频繁，机器会坏掉的。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
I know that you will try the Duruduru race.
I deleted your last report.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
我知道你会尝试嘟嘟罗盘比赛。
我已经删除了你上次的报告。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You need a Adventure Card to challenge again.
Do you want to exchange 1 Malangdo Can for a Adventure Card?
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
你需要一张冒险卡才能再次挑战。
你想用1罐Malangdo Can兑换一张冒险卡吗？

scripts.text: Buy Adventure Card.
scripts.translation: 购买冒险卡

scripts.text: Just stop it.
scripts.translation: 停下

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You have it already?
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
你已经有了吗？

scripts.text:
[Roku]
There is nothing for free.
You need a Malangdo Can.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
没有免费的东西。
你需要一罐Malangdo Can。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Here is your Adventure Card.
Beginning Compass, start!
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
这是你的冒险卡。
起始罗盘，出发！

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Okay.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
好的。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You are the weird one.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
你才是那个奇怪的人。

scripts.text:
There is a strange machine.
The kids said this was the ride called Duruduru compass of the Meow Bravery Team.
scripts.translation:
有一台奇怪的机器。
孩子们说这是喵之勇气队的嘟嘟罗盘。

scripts.text:
An iron pot contains a map of Malangdo with a card inserter.
After inserting your card, a red button and the map inside the pot light up.
It seems to start after pressing the button.
scripts.translation:
一个铁锅里装着Malangdo的地图和卡片插槽。
插入卡片后，红色按钮和锅内的地图会亮起。
似乎按下按钮后就会开始。

scripts.text: Start it right now.
scripts.translation: 现在就启动

scripts.text: Start it later.
scripts.translation: 稍后再启动

scripts.text: The card has come out with lights on the map after pressing the button.
scripts.translation: 按下按钮后，卡片随着地图上的灯光亮了起来。

scripts.text: The game has started already!
scripts.translation: 游戏已经开始了！

scripts.text: The game has started already!
scripts.translation: 游戏已经开始了！

scripts.text: Challenge it a little later.
scripts.translation: 请稍后再来挑战。

scripts.text:
The destination displays with pressing the button after inserting the card.
It's above the deck in the middle of the island!
scripts.translation:
插入卡片并按下按钮后，目的地就会显示出来。
它在岛屿中央的甲板上！

scripts.text:
Beginning Compass among the Duruduru compass.
The Duruduru race starts from this compass.
scripts.translation:
这是嘟嘟罗盘中的起始罗盘。
嘟嘟比赛将从这个罗盘开始。

scripts.text:
After inserting the card and pressing the red button, the path to the destination lit up.
The order will be {0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
插入卡片并按下红色按钮后，通往目的地的路径亮了起来。
顺序是{0}^000000。

scripts.text: The order will be {0}^000000.

There is a strange machine.
This is the Duruduru compass from the Meow Bravery Team.
scripts.translation:
有一台奇怪的机器。
这是喵之勇气队的嘟嘟罗盘。

scripts.text:
Delicate {0} lights surround the {1}.
After inserting the card and pressing the button, characters appear on the screen.
scripts.translation:
精致的{0}色灯光环绕着{1}。
插入卡片并按下按钮后，屏幕上出现了字符。

scripts.text: Delicate {0} lights surround the {1}.
scripts.translation: 精致的{0}色灯光环绕着{1}。

scripts.text: ^00FF00This is a card that didn't start the game yet. Please go back to the Beginning Compass.^000000
scripts.translation: ^00FF00这张卡片还没有开始游戏。请回到起始罗盘。^000000

scripts.text:
Welcome to the exciting number world!
Enter the exact answer after reading the question!
scripts.translation:
欢迎来到刺激的数字世界！
读完题目后，请输入正确答案！

scripts.text:
The card slides out with a sound after entering the number.
^4d4dffYou have passed the {0}! Run to the next destination!^000000
You should run for the next destination.
scripts.translation:
输入数字后，卡片伴随着声音滑了出来。
^4d4dff你通过了{0}！快跑向下一个目的地！^000000
你应该跑向下一个目的地。

scripts.text:
You've got wrong answer!
You can not pass here without exact answer!
Enter exact answer after read question!
scripts.translation:
你答错了！
没有正确答案就无法通过这里！
读完题目后请输入正确答案！

scripts.text:
The compass needle turns around in the middle of map.
You should run for the next destination.
scripts.translation:
罗盘的指针在地图中央转动。
你应该跑向下一个目的地。

scripts.text: ^FF0000You are going the wrong way! The paths in the card and compass don't line up!^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000你走错方向了！卡片和罗盘上的路径不匹配！^000000

scripts.text:
There is a fancy bell which doesn't fit in with the ship.
This bell is used in a game by the Meow Bravery Team.
scripts.translation:
有一个华丽的铃铛，与这艘船格格不入。
这个铃铛是喵之勇气队在游戏中使用的。

scripts.text:
There is a one more little bell beside the huge notice bell in the deck.
This is the Meowbell from the Meow Bravery Team.
scripts.translation:
甲板上的巨大通知铃旁边还有一个小铃铛。
这是喵之勇气队的喵铃。

scripts.text:
This is last bell to ring if you have the card for the game.
Nothing to say for now.
scripts.translation:
如果你持有游戏卡片，这是最后一个需要敲响的铃铛。
目前没什么要说的。

scripts.text:
This is the Meowbell.
You insert your card into the middle slot.
Knock Meowbell!!
scripts.translation:
这是喵铃。
将卡片插入中间的插槽。
敲响喵铃！！

scripts.text:
This is the Meowbell.
You insert your card into the middle slot.
-- Beep --
The card has out with a warning sound.
scripts.translation:
这是喵铃。
将卡片插入中间的插槽。
-- 哔 --
卡片伴随着警告声滑了出来。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
Oh, I'm suprised.
You rang the Meowbell in a short time.
I think you have the talent to be an adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手 布比]
哦，我很惊讶。
你在这么短的时间内敲响了喵铃。
我觉得你有成为冒险者的天赋。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
People say...
The purpose of this Duruduru game
is to find and go to a destination quickly and accurately.
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手 布比]
人们说...
这个嘟嘟游戏的目的
是快速且准确地找到并前往目的地。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
Go to Charo with that Adventure Card.
I will give you a confirmation stamp for success.
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手 布比]
拿着那张冒险卡片去找查罗。
我会给你盖一个成功的确认章。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
Oh, you've really gotten used to it.
You succeeded again.
I've put my paw stamp here.
Run to Rato now.
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手 布比]
哦，你真的已经熟练了。
你又成功了。
我在这里盖了我的爪印章。
现在去找拉托。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
You didn't ring the Meowbell within time.
Well, it's out of my hands now.
I will give you the fail stamp!!
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手 布比]
你没有在规定时间内敲响喵铃。
好吧，这不在我的控制范围内了。
我会给你盖一个失败的章！！

scripts.text:
[Bubi]
Hey, human adventurer, what are you here for?
Yeah~ this is a beautiful view.
scripts.translation:
[布比]
嘿，人类冒险者，你来这里做什么？
嗯~ 这里的风景真美。

scripts.text:
[Bubi]
Are you one of the people who came here to ring the Meowbell?
I am not a member of the Meow Team, but I can give you the confirmation stamp.
scripts.translation:
[布比]
你是那些来这里敲喵铃的人之一吗？
我不是喵之队的成员，但我可以给你盖确认章。

scripts.text:
[Bubi]
Um, my work?
Oh, that is only for when I am not on a voyage.
I am free these days.
scripts.translation:
[布比]
嗯，我的工作？
哦，那只是在我不出航的时候做的。
这些天我很空闲。

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
Um? What is the matter?
Hey, here is a suspicious guy.
scripts.translation:
[猫侦探]
嗯？怎么了？
嘿，这里有个可疑的家伙。

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
I can surely tell he is drunk by the smell of liquid.
I am so sad that I can not.
scripts.translation:
[猫侦探]
我肯定能通过液体的气味判断出他喝醉了。
真遗憾我不能。

scripts.text:
[Friend of Detective]
Oh, I am so sorry to hear that you have such genius analytical skills!
He is not drunk...
scripts.translation:
[侦探的朋友]
哦，听到你有如此天才的分析能力，我很抱歉！
他没有喝醉...

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
Drunks always smell of liquid.
But he is not, therefore he is not drunk, friend.
scripts.translation:
[猫侦探]
醉汉总是有液体的气味。
但他没有，所以他没有喝醉，朋友。

scripts.text: Then what is your identity?
scripts.translation: 那么你的身份是什么？

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
Well... You are everything except drunk!!!
scripts.translation:
[猫侦探]
嗯... 你除了不喝醉之外，什么都不是！！！

scripts.text: The voice of the cats sounded shaky.
scripts.translation: 猫的声音听起来有些颤抖。

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
What did I say?
Didn't I tell you that someone will come here soon?
scripts.translation:
[猫侦探]
我说了什么？
我是不是告诉你很快会有人来这里？

scripts.text:
[Friend of Detective]
Great.
I can only admire your deduction.
scripts.translation:
[侦探的朋友]
太好了。
我只能佩服你的推理能力。

scripts.text:
[Detective Homnya]
Haha, Nyangson, this is nothing for me.
Before that, let's listen to the stories from the visitor first.
scripts.translation:
[侦探 霍姆尼亚]
哈哈，喵森，这对我来说不算什么。
在那之前，让我们先听听来访者的故事吧。

scripts.text: Charo? Rosy?
scripts.translation: 查罗？罗西？

scripts.text: Are you guys detectives?
scripts.translation: 你们是侦探吗？

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
No... Who are they?
Nyangson, do you know them?
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
不... 他们是谁？
喵森，你认识他们吗？

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
I... I don't know either?
I don't know Charo and Rosy!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我... 我也不认识？
我不认识查罗和罗西！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes. Yes.
We are the detective and friend!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
是的。是的。
我们是侦探和朋友！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, I am the detective, Homnya.
And this is my friend, Nyangson. He reports my cases.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
是的，我是侦探，霍姆尼亚。
这位是我的朋友，喵森。他负责报道我的案件。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Anyways, that's not important for now!
We should focus on current situation.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
总之，现在这不重要！
我们应该关注当前的情况。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Yes, that's right, friend.
We think........
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
是的，没错，朋友。
我们认为........

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes! This is a bomb for sure!
I am so sorry, I have only analytical and detective skills but don't have the skill to dispose of a bomb!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
是的！这肯定是个炸弹！
非常抱歉，我只有分析和侦探技能，但没有拆除炸弹的技能！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
What do you mean by that?
It doesn't make any sense!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
你这是什么意思？
这完全说不通！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, we shout when it changed from the peak of hope into the peak of sorrow.
Peak!
Meow!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
是的，当它从希望的顶峰变成悲伤的顶峰时，我们会大喊。
顶峰！
喵！

scripts.text: I don't get the meaning of this, but they seem to be in hurry.
scripts.translation: 我不明白这是什么意思，但他们似乎很着急。

scripts.text: Continue to humor them.
scripts.translation: 继续配合他们。

scripts.text: Stop playing around.
scripts.translation: 别胡闹了。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Oh, if you give us a hand, I will take it. How do you think about it, friend?
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
哦，如果你能帮把手，我会接受的。你觉得怎么样，朋友？

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
I don't really care about it. What I want to do is only to report this case.
One of the cases will be open to the public among the most strange and weird cases ever.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我其实不太在意。我想做的只是报道这个案件。
在那些最奇怪、最离奇的案件中，有一起将会向公众公开。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
I knew this visitor had the skill to dispose of a bomb.
He is totally prepared to escape from danger.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
我知道这位来访者有拆除炸弹的技能。
他完全做好了从危险中逃脱的准备。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Oh, I heard of it. I heard they use fly wings and butterfly wings as well.
I've never thought I could meet a person who used these thing for real.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
哦，我听说过。我听说他们也会使用苍蝇翅膀和蝴蝶翅膀。
我从没想过我会遇到一个真正使用这些东西的人。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, I believe this visitor will solve our mystery.
Then please stop this damn machine!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
我相信这位访客能解开我们的谜团。
那么请停下这台该死的机器！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Yes, the damn machine!
It is loud and useless!
And it will be blown up.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
没错，就是那台该死的机器！
它又吵又没用！
而且它会被炸掉的。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Well, stop this machine!!!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
好了，停下这台机器！！！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Please don't...
Please act according to the script.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
请别这样...
请按照剧本行动。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Charo. Where is the script?
No, Homnya. My friend...
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
查罗。剧本在哪里？
不，霍姆尼亚。我的朋友...

scripts.text: Two young cats are sweating a lot.
scripts.translation: 两只年轻的猫流了很多汗。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Stop this noisy machine!
This is the moment that your memory can be coming through!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
停下这台吵闹的机器！
这是你的记忆即将浮现的时刻！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Yes. Yes.
This is the sort of training where you dispose of and breach all the traps.
Yes, this is.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
是的，是的。
这就是拆除并突破所有陷阱的训练。
没错，就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
It was a scary moment.
This machine is still fine anyways!
Stop it again.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
刚才真是惊险。
不过这台机器还是好好的！
再停一次。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, you need Adventure Card B to operate this machine.
Do you want to buy a new one?
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]

......

......

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:
