scripts.text:
[Picky Crew]
Is that you who scratched all the pillars in here?!
Meow~~~~!!
Get off from that pillar!
scripts.translation:
[皮奇船员]
是你把这里的柱子都抓花了？！
喵~~~~！！
从柱子上下来！

scripts.text:
I can see the trace of a scratch.
Pillars made from trees are originally good to hang, but scratched by nails.
scripts.translation:
我能看到抓痕。
木头做的柱子本来很适合攀爬，但被指甲抓花了。

scripts.text: I can see the crack where a piece of the painting was hidden.
scripts.translation: 我能看到曾经藏有画作碎片的裂缝。

scripts.text:
There are windows for ventilation on the floor.
A cold wind comes from these windows.
Why are ventilation windows set up on the floor?
scripts.translation:
地板上有一些通风窗。
冷风从这些窗户里吹进来。
为什么通风窗要装在地板上？

scripts.text:
There are windows for ventilation on the floor.
A piece of the painting was hung in there.
Why are ventilation windows set up on the floor?
scripts.translation:
地板上有一些通风窗。
画作碎片曾挂在里面。
为什么通风窗要装在地板上？

scripts.text:
[Neat Crew]
Please clean up your stuff by yourself.
Especially you guys getting dirty after we came to this island!
Please throw the trash into the trash can.
scripts.translation:
[整洁的船员]
请自己收拾好你的东西。
特别是你们，来到这座岛之后弄得一团糟！
请把垃圾扔进垃圾桶。

scripts.text:
[Neat Crew]
And you plucked every crop.
Hmph. Please, let's leave it in its natural state.
scripts.translation:
[整洁的船员]
还有你们把作物都摘光了。
哼。拜托，请让它们保持自然状态。

scripts.text:
[Neat Crew]
What are you looking at?
Will you mess up here too?
Meow?!
scripts.translation:
[整洁的船员]
你在看什么？
你也要在这里搞破坏吗？
喵？！

scripts.text:
[Scary Crew]
I try to be nice these days, and kids just take liberties with me.
Will you too?
scripts.translation:
[吓人的船员]
我最近试着对人好一点，结果小孩们就对我为所欲为。
你也是吗？

scripts.text:
[Scary Crew]
They just come in and out, even the other person's room...
It causes harm for sure.
scripts.translation:
[吓人的船员]
他们随意进出，甚至进别人的房间...
这肯定会造成伤害。

scripts.text:
[Picky Crew]
Do not run in the hall!
My fur falls out because of someone who
scratches everywhere!
scripts.translation:
[皮奇船员]
不要在走廊里奔跑！
有人到处抓挠，我的毛都掉光了！

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 您的负重太重，无法继续。请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 您的背包已满，无法继续。请整理背包后再来。

scripts.text: A gentle looking cat is whispering to himself.
scripts.translation: 一只看起来温和的猫正在自言自语。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello... Mr. Cat...
The cat takes a glance at you and goes back to his whispering as if he didn't even see you.
scripts.translation: 那只猫瞥了你一眼，然后继续自言自语，仿佛根本没看到你。

scripts.text: It seems you are not being considered worth talking to.
scripts.translation: 看来你觉得他不值得交谈。

scripts.text: A gentle looking cat is whispering to himself.
scripts.translation: 一只看起来温和的猫正在自言自语。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Man! 10 losses in a row...
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
天哪！十连败了...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
We are the 'Cat Gamers' Association.
But, we still keep on losing and we have no idea why!
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
我们是“猫玩家”协会。
但是，我们一直在输，而且不知道为什么！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
We've got to find out the reason for this losing streak.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
我们必须找出连败的原因。

scripts.text: You are getting interested in the cat's story. Let's hear more.
scripts.translation: 你对这只猫的故事产生了兴趣。让我们听听更多。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
The reason, yes!
This can be one of them.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
原因，是的！
这可能是其中之一。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
^DD2234Giving up so many points!^000000
That's right. No matter how much you score,
we will still lose if we give up so many points.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
^DD2234让出这么多分数！^000000
没错。无论我们得多少分，
如果我们让出这么多分，还是会输。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
For the other reason. Hmm!
This could be related with the previous reason.
No ^DD2234aggresive point betting^000000 at all.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
至于另一个原因。嗯！
这可能与之前的原因有关。
完全没有^DD2234激进的分数投注^000000。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Other teams bet on games that they think will win, and bet low when they are not confident.
I guess we didn't know that.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
其他队伍会投注他们认为会赢的比赛，并在不自信时投注较低。
我想我们不知道这一点。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Hmm, can this be a reason?
For some reason there were ^DD2234players disappearing right before the match up^000000 and I guess this could have effected our game spirit.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嗯，这能是一个原因吗？
不知为何，在^DD2234比赛前玩家会消失^000000，我想这可能影响了我们的比赛精神。

[猫玩家总监]
嗯...所以导致我们连败的原因，
是让出太多分数；
激进的分数投注；
以及玩家消失？

scripts.text: It seems like the gentle looking cat has finished thinking. Let's interrupt the conversion.
scripts.translation: 看起来这只温和的猫已经思考完毕。让我们打断这场对话。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Now that I know the reason,
there should be a solution to that.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
既然知道了原因，
应该就有解决办法了。

scripts.text: Umm... Mr. Cat...
scripts.translation: 那个...猫先生...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Who's there? Human? You are a human?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
谁在那里？人类？你是人类？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
... ... ... ...

[Cat Gamers Director]
Oh! Yes! Right!
I remember hearing that
humans have started passing through here recently.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
哦！是的！没错！
我记得最近听说
人类开始经过这里了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
So good to see you!!
What is your name by the way?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
见到你真好！！
顺便问一下，你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
My name is {1}, Mr. Cat.

[Cat Gamers Director]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
哦，^0000FF{0}^000000。
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually I wanted to help you out since I heard that you've lost 10 games in a row...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实我想帮帮你们，因为我听说你们已经连输10场了...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Well, you didn't really have to point it out like that...
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
哎呀，你不用特意指出来吧...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A weakness is no longer a weakness when you say it out loud.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一旦说出口，弱点就不再是弱点了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Hahahaha I like that phrase.
I should remember it and
tell it to my kids. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
哈哈哈，我喜欢这句话。
我应该记住它，
然后告诉我的孩子们。嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I like you, {0} {1}. Will you help us get out of this 10 game losing streak? Ehehe~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
我喜欢你，{0} {1}。你愿意帮我们摆脱这10连败吗？嘿嘿~

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm a stupid {0}.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我是个愚蠢的{0}。

scripts.text: Sure, I'm a cool {0}.
scripts.translation: 当然，我是个很酷的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Guess I was wrong about you~
How can a person call themself stupid.
Now I can see how stupid you are.
Good bye~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
看来我看错你了~
一个人怎么能自称愚蠢呢。
现在我看出来你有多蠢了。
再见~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Wow. I respect you, {0}.
Let me ask you a favor.
Please meet the hard working Manager Cat and ask about our team's attitude these days.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
哇。我很尊重你，{0}。
让我求你个忙。
请去见见辛勤工作的管理员猫，问问我们团队最近的态度。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
The Manager Cat must be around here somewhere~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
管理员猫应该就在这附近~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please meet the hard working
Manager Cat, and ask about our team's attitude these days.
The Manager Cat must be around here somewhere~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
请去见见辛勤工作的管理员猫，问问我们团队最近的态度。
管理员猫应该就在这附近~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Ok Ok. So what did the manager cat say about the atmosphere these days?~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
好的好的。那么管理员猫怎么说最近的气氛的？~

scripts.text: You tell him exactly what the Manager Cat said.
scripts.translation: 你原原本本告诉他管理员猫说了什么。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The manager cat said...

[Cat Gamers Director]
Do not hesitate... Just tell me everything~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
不要犹豫... 把一切都告诉我~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umm... the player cats are afraid of you...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯... 玩家猫们都很怕你...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
What... What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
什... 你说什么？

scripts.text: Cat Gamers Director seems to be in shock. Let's give him some time to calm down.
scripts.translation: 猫玩家总监似乎受到了冲击。让我们给他一点时间冷静一下。

scripts.text: Cat Gamers Director seems to be in shock. Let's give him some time to calm down.
scripts.translation: 猫玩家总监似乎受到了冲击。让我们给他一点时间冷静一下。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
That is impossible!
There is no other cat that's nicer than I am!
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
这不可能！
没有比我更和蔼的猫了！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Am I really that scary?
Are those players who bailed on the practice afraid of me too?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
我真的那么可怕吗？
那些因为太累而逃跑的玩家，也是怕我吗？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
It can't be, right? ehehehehe~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
不会吧，对吧？嘿嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text: - He laughs nervously. -
scripts.translation: - 他紧张地笑了起来。 -

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Is that the truth?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
这是真的吗？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
{0}, will you help me out?
There are 4 players who ran away from practice saying they were too tired.
Could you check if they ran away because of me? ehehehe~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
{0}，你能帮帮我吗？
有4名玩家说太累了，从练习中逃跑了。
你能查查他们是不是因为我才逃跑的吗？嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Their names are Eryu, Stew, Ketchup, and Eff.
They've got to be somewhere around here.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
他们的名字是埃留、斯图、番茄酱和埃夫。
他们应该就在这附近。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please find them all~
But, don't ask too directly! Ok?
Just ask them gentle questions~
Ok? Be! Gentle!
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
请把他们全都找到~
但是，不要问得太直接！好吗？
只是温柔地问一些问题~
好吗？要！温柔！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I appreciate your help, {0}. heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
谢谢你的帮助，{0}。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It seems some humans are scamming cats around this town.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 看来有些人类在骗这个城镇里的猫。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
What good is it to scam innocent cats?~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
骗无辜的猫有什么好处呢？~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I think that you're right.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我觉得你说得对。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Oh, so you met Eryu, Stew, Ketchup, and Eff.
It is so good to see you again. Heh~
Thank you very much for your effort~. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
哦，原来你见到了埃留、斯图、番茄酱和埃夫。
很高兴再次见到你。嘿~
非常感谢你的努力~。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
So what did they say?
They really think I am scary?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
那他们怎么说？
他们真的觉得我很可怕吗？

scripts.text: You tell the Cat Gamers Director what Eryu, Stew, Ketchup, and Eff said.
scripts.translation: 告诉猫玩家总监埃留、斯图、番茄酱和埃夫说了什么。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They think you push them too much through the practices. So they are scared.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们觉得你训练时逼得太紧了。所以他们很害怕。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
What? Really?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
什么？真的吗？

scripts.text: The Cat Gamers Director seems to be shocked once again. Better give him more time to calm down.
scripts.translation: 猫玩家总监似乎再次受到了冲击。最好给他多一点时间冷静下来。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Their names are Eryu, Stew, Ketchup, and Eff.
They've got to be somewhere around here.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
他们的名字是埃留、斯图、番茄酱和埃夫。
他们应该就在这附近。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please find them all~
But, don't ask too directly! Ok?
Just ask them gentle questions~
Ok? Be! Gentle!
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
请把他们全都找到~
但是，不要问得太直接！好吗？
只是温柔地问一些问题~
好吗？要！温柔！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I appreciate your help, {0}. heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
谢谢你的帮助，{0}。嘿~

scripts.text: Cat Gamers Director seems to be in shock once again. Better give more time to calm down.
scripts.translation: 猫玩家总监似乎再次受到了冲击。最好给他多一点时间冷静下来。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Ok, I understand.
I was a scary cat after all.
This can't be right!! Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
好吧，我明白了。
看来我确实是一只可怕的猫。
这不对啊！！嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I need to change my scary cat image. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
我需要改变我可怕猫的形象。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
This is my mission now,
so our team can improve
game performance. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
这是我现在的使命，
这样我们的队伍才能
提升游戏表现。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please go meet our manager cat,
and find out how can I change
this scary cat image of mine. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
请去见见我们的管理员猫，
问问怎样才能改变
我这只可怕猫的形象。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I would much appreciate your help, {0}~.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 我会非常感激你的帮助，{0}~。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please ask our manager cat how can I change this scary cat image.
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
请问问我们的管理员猫，怎样才能改变我这只可怕猫的形象。
嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Please help me out,
{0}! Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 请帮帮我，
{0}！嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
You came back!! Heh~
So, what did our manager cat say?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
你回来了！！嘿~
那么，我们的管理员猫怎么说？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Manager cat asked to prepare a box.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
管理员猫让我准备一个盒子。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
A box? Heh~ Sure, why not?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
一个盒子？嘿~ 当然，没问题。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you going to ask me what is it for?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你难道不问问这是用来做什么的吗？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Well, I kind of was eavesdropping when {0} and Manager Cat were talking together. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嗯，刚才{0}和管理员猫说话的时候，我有点在偷听。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Now I need to check with our players, see how they really feel.
Heh~ Why don't you come back tomorrow?
Heh~ Let me decide what to do after checking their honest petition letters. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
现在我需要问问我们的玩家，看看他们真实的感受。
嘿~ 你明天再来吧？
嘿~ 等我看完他们真诚的请愿信后再决定怎么做。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Still receiving petition letters. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
还在接收请愿信呢。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I wonder what they really want to say~ Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
不知道他们到底想说什么呢~ 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ All done with collecting petition letters~
Heh~ Let's see what they wrote here?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 请愿信收集完毕~
嘿~ 来看看他们都写了什么吧？

scripts.text: Reading...~
scripts.translation: 正在阅读...~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Let me see... 'Stupid Cat lea...de...'
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 让我看看...“愚蠢的猫...莉亚...de...”

scripts.text:
- Crumpling the paper -
Cat Gamers Director has crumpled the paper and thrown it away.
scripts.translation:
- 揉皱纸张 -
猫玩家总监把纸揉成一团扔掉了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Wrong paper.
Let's read another one... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 拿错纸了。
换一张看看... 嘿~

scripts.text: ~Reading~
scripts.translation: ~正在阅读~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Here we go.
'I don't like playing with the same team members over and over.
Please pick new team members,
or get me a practicing partner.'
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 来了。
“我不喜欢总是和同一批成员组队。
请给我换新的队友，
或者找个练习搭档。”

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I see.
I can take this positively.
Heh~ Let's move on to another one.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 明白了。
这点我可以积极看待。
嘿~ 继续看下一封。

scripts.text: ~Reading~
scripts.translation: ~正在阅读~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~
'We need more snacks~ Get us some more snacks~'
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~
“我们需要更多零食~ 多给我们点零食~”

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ This one also sounds productive.
Heh~ Petition letters are good, I guess... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 这一封也很有建设性。
嘿~ 看来请愿信还挺有用的... 嘿~

scripts.text: Reading...~
scripts.translation: 正在阅读...~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~
'Elders are bullying me. Help me...'
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~
“长老们在欺负我。帮帮我...”

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Our team is absolutely
like a family here~ Someone is
playing here, you know. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 我们的队伍
绝对像一家人一样~ 毕竟有人
在这里玩耍嘛。嘿~

scripts.text: Reading...~
scripts.translation: 正在阅读...~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ There are only 4 letters!
Including a prank one...
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 只有4封信！
其中还有一封恶作剧的...
嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Everyone seems to have a satisfied team life~ Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
大家似乎都很满意现在的队伍生活~ 嘿~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not... Really...
There are tons of letters piled in the back of the box, but Cat Gamers Director doesn't want to admit the problem.
scripts.translation: 盒子后面堆着成堆的信，但猫玩家总监不想承认这个问题。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~
Hey, {0}. What did you say? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~
喂，{0}。你刚才说什么？嘿~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nothing! Please carry on.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没什么！请继续。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Because of what these players want,
I have a favor to ask you, {0}...
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 为了满足这些玩家的要求，
我有个忙想请你帮一下，{0}...
嘿~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is it?

[Cat Gamers Director]
Will you be our players' practicing partner?
Heh~ I feel strongly that you, {0}, can be trusted for this. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
你愿意成为我们玩家的练习搭档吗？
嘿~ 我坚信你可以胜任，{0}。嘿~

scripts.text: No thanks, buddy!
scripts.translation: 不用了，朋友！

scripts.text: Ok, I'll do it!
scripts.translation: 好的，我答应！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Are you rejecting me? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 你是在拒绝我吗？嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I'm sad. Sad~ Heh~
I didn't expect a refusal from a person like you, {0}.
But still, here's some coins for you~
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
我好难过。难过~ 嘿~
没想到会遭到像您这样的人的拒绝，{0}。
不过，还是给您一些金币吧~
嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
We will always welcome you, {0}, as a guest member of the Cat Gamers.
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
我们永远欢迎您，{0}，作为猫玩家的贵宾成员。
嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Please come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 如果您改变主意了，请随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Good choice.
I knew you would help us Cat Gamers... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 好选择。
我就知道您会帮助我们的猫玩家... 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Thank you for your help.
Heh~ Here are some coins as a small gift... Heh~
Get yourself some goodies. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 感谢您的帮助。
嘿~ 这里有一些金币作为小礼物... 嘿~
去买点好吃的吧。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Since you will be our team's practicing partner, please come back in an hour.
Then I will give you our '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000'.
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
既然您将成为我们队伍的练习搭档，请一小时内回来。
届时我会给您'^0000FF猫玩家证书^000000'。
嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Ok, {0}. I will see you in an hour. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 好的，{0}。一小时后见。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~
Aren't you {0}?
Have you changed your mind yet?
Are you willing to be our team's practicing partner?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~
您是{0}吗？
您改变主意了吗？
您愿意成为我们队伍的练习搭档吗？

scripts.text: No, I'm just passing through.
scripts.translation: 不，我只是路过。

scripts.text: I accept your offer.
scripts.translation: 我接受您的提议。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I see.
But, let me tell you once again, {0}.
You are always welcome to be one of our 'Cat Gamers Honorable Members'.
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 我明白了。
但是，让我再告诉您一次，{0}。
您随时都可以成为我们的'猫玩家荣誉成员'。
嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ At last!!
{0} will become our honorable member!!
I shall make a '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000' right away. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 终于！！
{0}将成为我们的荣誉成员！！
我马上为您制作'^0000FF猫玩家证书^000000'。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Come back in an hour and I will get you a '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000'.
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
请一小时内回来，我会给您'^0000FF猫玩家证书^000000'。
嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ You want to get the '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000' faster. Heh~ It's not really easy to get such a certificate easily.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 您想尽快拿到'^0000FF猫玩家证书^000000'。嘿~ 这种证书可不是那么容易拿到的。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
So, it's a bit tricky... Heh~ Please come later. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
所以，有点麻烦... 嘿~ 请稍后再来。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I got a message from the workshop that their work on the certificate is done. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 我收到工坊的消息，说证书已经做好了。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
This is not some ordinary certificate. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
这可不是普通的证书。嘿~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你这是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ This is...
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 这是...

scripts.text: The Cat Gamers Director's eyes are shining with pride.
scripts.translation: 猫玩家总监的眼睛里闪烁着自豪的光芒。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ The pure essence of the 'Cat Gamers' tech team's effort!!
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 这是'猫玩家'技术团队努力的精华所在！！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Equip this item, then all of your game playing records will be saved. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 装备这个物品，你所有的游戏记录都会被保存下来。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Take this and show us what you've got.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 拿着这个，让我们看看你的实力。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I may be worrying too much... But, please wear this '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000', and play the game. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 我可能有点多虑了... 但是，请佩戴'^0000FF猫玩家证书^000000'，然后继续游戏。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
This is not possible. Please contact an administrator.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
这不可能。请联系管理员。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Hello, {0}. How is it going practicing with the players?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 你好，{0}。和玩家们的练习进展如何？

scripts.text: How are the players doing?
scripts.translation: 玩家们的情况如何？

scripts.text: Just stopped by to say hi~
scripts.translation: 只是顺路打个招呼~

scripts.text: Here's the current status...
scripts.translation: 这是目前的情况...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Wow, {0}! I'm so touched by your care for the players.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 哇，{0}！你对玩家的关心让我很感动。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ For 13 years of my life, I've never seen anyone like you, {0}. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 在我13年的生命里，我从未见过像你这样的人，{0}。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ {0}, which player's condition are you interested in?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ {0}，你关心哪位玩家的情况？

scripts.text: Rock Paper Scissors players
scripts.translation: 猜拳玩家

scripts.text: ChamChamCham players
scripts.translation: ChamChamCham玩家

scripts.text: KongNyangKong players
scripts.translation: KongNyangKong玩家

scripts.text: Flag Game players
scripts.translation: 夺旗游戏玩家

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Rock Paper Scissors players are missing practices occasionally, but they are still getting better. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 猜拳玩家虽然偶尔会缺席训练，但他们的实力还是在稳步提升的。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
ChamChamCham players are actually complaining about the practice because you are doing so well with them, very hard to remember the winner. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
ChamChamCham玩家其实一直在抱怨训练，因为您跟他们配合得太好了，赢的人很难记清楚。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ KongNyangKong players are so happy with the practice. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ KongNyangKong玩家对训练感到非常满意。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Flag Game players are always nervous since you make them work so much. Heh~ But, they are really getting better. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 夺旗游戏玩家总是很紧张，因为您让他们练得太辛苦了。嘿~ 不过，他们的进步确实很大。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Please keep up the good work, {0}. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 请继续保持这样的表现，{0}。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Hello there~ {0}. You have such good manners~ Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 你好呀~ {0}。您的礼仪真是好极了~ 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ These days, there are so many cats and humans without proper manners. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 最近，有很多猫和人类都不懂得基本的礼仪。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
We also have some of thme in our 'Cat Gamers'. They are so arrogant every time we win the game... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
我们“猫玩家”队伍里也有这样的人。每次赢了比赛，他们就变得非常傲慢... 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ There should be more people like you, {0}. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 像您这样有礼貌的人，{0}，应该再多一些才好。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Please practice with our players more often~ Heh~ So they can learn some manners from you, {0}. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 请多跟我们的玩家一起训练~ 嘿~ 这样他们就能向您学习一些礼仪了，{0}。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Keep up the good work~ Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
请继续保持这样的表现~ 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ What happened to your face, {0}? Guess you lost from the practice, right? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ {0}，您的脸怎么了？看来是在训练中输了吧？嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I saw players puting notes in the 'Petition box'. Heh~ Guess that was your work. Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 我看到有玩家在“请愿箱”里留了纸条。嘿~ 想必是您做的吧。让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It's not like I didn't feed them right... Heh~ I hope it was not too much for you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 我并没有亏待他们啊... 嘿~ 希望这些对您来说不算太麻烦，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Hmm, 50 Marses, and 30 Milk Bottles... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 嗯，50个乌贼，还有30瓶牛奶... 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Our team must have some grudge over Team 'Dog n Waltz', enough to ask you for this kind of favor...
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 看来我们队伍对“狗与华尔兹”队伍很有意见，才会让您帮忙办这种事...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Ah, quickness training. It's good to see our players trying their best on training.
Heh~ Yes, nothing is better than mouse catching for improving quickness.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 敏捷训练。看到我们的玩家如此努力训练，真是好事。
嘿~ 没错，没有什么比抓老鼠更能提升敏捷度了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ '50 Peco Peco please!! Let's party.' Hmm... Heh~ 50 Pecos can feed all of our neighbors.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ “请给我们50只大嘴鸟！！我们要组队。” 嗯... 嘿~ 50只大嘴鸟够喂饱我们所有的邻居了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Hmm... let me see... Heh~ That's right, I was worrying about our team getting so nervous before the actual game... But, they won't even talk to me about it.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 嗯... 让我看看... 嘿~ 没错，我一直担心大家在正式比赛前会太紧张... 但他们甚至都不愿意跟我谈论这件事。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ The note says, get me 30 Rat Tails for a snack.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 纸条上写着，给我30根鼠尾当零食。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says 5 on the note... 5 of what? What?! Lemons?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 纸条上写着5... 5个什么？什么？！柠檬？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Give us 10 Ice Pieces or 10 Ice Creams!! Heh~ I personally prefer Ice Cream, just so you know.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 给我们10个冰碎片或者10个冰淇淋！！嘿~ 顺便告诉你，我个人更喜欢冰淇淋。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Here, I found the note from our team. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 这里，我找到了我们队伍留下的纸条。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh?! There's no favor note for you, {0}. Heh~ What do you want to report? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿？！{0}，我这里没有你的委托纸条。嘿~ 你想报告什么？嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says in the note to bring 30 Phens and 10 Fish Tails. Heh~ Maybe you didn't catch enough Phens, or forgot some Fish Tails? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 纸条上写着要带30只剑鱼和10条鱼尾。嘿~ 也许你抓的剑鱼不够，或者忘了带鱼尾？嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ But, where are 50 Marses and 30 Milk Bottles? Heh~ Please see if you haven't missed them...
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 可是，50只乌贼和30瓶牛奶在哪里？嘿~ 请检查一下是不是漏掉了...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says on the note, harass 30 Kobold Archers. Heh~ Please check if you have harassed 30 of them already.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 纸条上写着要骚扰30只犬妖弓箭手。嘿~ 请确认一下你是否已经骚扰了30只。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh? Where are those 10 Cramps you promised? Heh~ You didn't eat them... did you?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿？你承诺的那10只蓝鼠在哪里？嘿~ 你不会...把它们吃了吧？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Where are those Peco Pecos? Still not ready? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 那些大嘴鸟在哪里？还没准备好吗？嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Where are those 20 yarns? It says 20 on the note, right...? Please check if you have lost them somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 那20团毛线在哪里？纸条上写着20，对吧...？请检查一下是不是弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Where are those 30 Rat Tails? Please check and come back later.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 那30根鼠尾在哪里？请检查一下，之后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Let's just get 5 Lemons for them, will you? Heh~ I am still not sure where they want to use them...
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 那就给他们拿5个柠檬，好吗？嘿~ 我到现在还不确定他们想拿柠檬做什么...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Where are the Ice Pieces or Ice Creams? You should get them before they melt...
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 冰碎片或冰淇淋在哪里？你应该在它们融化之前拿到...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says 'We will meet Eryu together.'. Heh~ Have you met Eryu already? I don't think so... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 上面写着“我们将一起会见埃留”。嘿~ 你已经见过埃留了吗？我不觉得... 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says 'We will meet Stew together.'. Heh~ Have you met Stew already? I don't think so... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 上面写着“我们将一起会见斯图”。嘿~ 你已经见过斯图了吗？我不觉得... 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says 'We will meet Ketchup together.'. Heh~ Have you met Ketchup already? I don't think so... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 上面写着“我们将一起会见番茄酱”。嘿~ 你已经见过番茄酱了吗？我不觉得... 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says 'We will meet Eff together.'. Heh~ Have you met Eff already? I don't think so... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 上面写着“我们将一起会见埃夫”。嘿~ 你已经见过埃夫了吗？我不觉得... 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh?! There's no favor note for you, {0}. Heh~ What do you want to report? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿？！{0}，我这里没有你的委托纸条。嘿~ 你想报告什么？嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
{0}
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
{0}

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Thanks for coming by, {0}. Heh~ Keep up the good work. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家总监]
嘿~ 谢谢你来，{0}。嘿~ 继续保持。嘿~

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 您的负重太重，无法继续。请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 您的背包已满，无法继续。请整理背包后再来。

scripts.text:
[Strange Cat]
Meow~ Meo~ Ow Ow~ Meow Meo~ Eow Eow~
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的猫]
喵~ 喵呜~ 嗷嗷~ 喵呜喵呜~ 嗷嗷~

scripts.text: Some strange cat is here.
scripts.translation: 这里有一只奇怪的猫。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Meow~ Meo~ Ow Ow~ Meow Meo~ Eow Eow~
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
喵~ 喵呜~ 嗷嗷~ 喵呜喵呜~ 嗷嗷~

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
你想干什么？

scripts.text: Ask about the team's attitude...
scripts.translation: 询问团队的态度...

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Do not lie to me! How can I trust you and reveal our team secret? Aren't you a spy from the doggy team?
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
别骗我！我怎么能信任你并透露我们团队的秘密？难道你是狗队派来的间谍吗？

scripts.text: Aww, come on...
scripts.translation: 哎呀，别这样...

scripts.text: You play with a foxtail nearby and then ask again.
scripts.translation: 你在附近玩弄猫尾草，然后再问一次。

scripts.text: Cat Gamers Director says...
scripts.translation: 猫玩家总监说...

scripts.text: The Manager Cat seems to be interested in the foxtail and starts answering.
scripts.translation: 管理员猫似乎对猫尾草很感兴趣，开始回答你的问题。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Players are afraid of the Cat Gamers Director. When they see Cat Gamers Director at the game, they get nervous.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
玩家都很怕猫玩家总监。当他们在游戏里看到猫玩家总监时，都会变得紧张。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Can you give me that?
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
你能把它给我吗？

scripts.text: You hand the foxtail to the Manager Cat. Go back to the Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation: 你把猫尾草递给管理员猫。回到猫玩家总监那里。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Don't lie to me!
Why should I trust you,
and give our team information?
Aren't you a spy from doggy team...?
Go away.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
别骗我！
我为什么要信任你，
并给出我们团队的信息？
难道你是狗队派来的间谍...？
走开。

scripts.text: This cat might hit you.
scripts.translation: 这只猫可能会攻击你。

scripts.text:
The Manager Cat is playing with the foxtail you gave him.
He seems to be liking it...
scripts.translation:
管理员猫正在玩你给他的猫尾草。
他似乎很喜欢...

scripts.text:
The Manager Cat is playing with the foxtail you gave him.
He seems to be liking it...
scripts.translation:
管理员猫正在玩你给他的猫尾草。
他似乎很喜欢...

scripts.text: Help~ Fire~
scripts.translation: 救命~ 着火了~

scripts.text: Hey~!
Do you want to hear something?
scripts.translation: 你想听点什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Don't lie~ We don't use fire that much~
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
别骗人~ 我们不太用火~

scripts.text: The Manager Cat ignores you, and keeps on playing with the foxtail.
scripts.translation: 管理员猫无视了你，继续玩着猫尾草。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Meow~ I want to tell you a story~ Follow me meow~ Let talk over there, meow~
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
喵~ 我想给你讲个故事~ 跟我来喵~ 我们去那边聊，喵~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Haha, I was just kidding. I actually need to tell you that the Cat Gamers Director has an issue...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哈哈，我开玩笑的。其实我需要告诉你，猫玩家总监遇到了一些麻烦...

scripts.text: You explain the story to the Manager Cat.
scripts.translation: 你把事情经过讲给了管理员猫听。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Scary image... Meow, I understand... Cat Gamers Director should feel peace by giving up things.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
可怕的景象... 喵，我懂了... 猫玩家总监应该通过放弃某些东西来获得内心的平静。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Meow! Go tell him this, meow~ Prepare a box, meow~
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
喵！去告诉他这个，喵~ 准备一个箱子，喵~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A box?

[Manager Cat]
Petition it is, meow!! There is some place where humans do such things, I think it will help us~
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
就是请愿箱，喵！！我记得人类有个地方是这么做的，我觉得这能帮到我们~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok, I will go tell it to the Games Director~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我会去告诉游戏总监~

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You tell the Cat Gamers Director to prepare a Box for sure!~ I will tell this to my team, meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
你务必告诉猫玩家总监准备一个箱子！~ 我会把这个消息告诉我的团队，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
The players are excited and writing a bunch of things for the petition box... I wonder what they are writing.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
玩家们很兴奋，正在往请愿箱里写很多东西... 我猜他们在写什么呢。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You won't help practice? If you help, the Cat Gamers Director will give you food cans... Please reconsider!
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
你不帮忙练习吗？如果你帮忙的话，猫玩家总监会给你罐头吃的... 请再考虑一下！

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Meow~ Aren't you {0}? I heard Cat Gamers Director ordered a special certificate, meow~
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
喵~ 你不是{0}吗？我听说猫玩家总监订购了一种特殊的证书，喵~

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
When practicing, you must equip the '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000' item~ Don't forget, meow~
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
练习时，你必须装备'^0000FF猫玩家证书^000000'这个物品~ 别忘了，喵~

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
This is not possible. Please contact an administrator.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
这不可能。请联系管理员。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
What do you want meow?
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
你想做什么喵？

scripts.text: Hi.
scripts.translation: 你好。

scripts.text: Any news?
scripts.translation: 有什么新闻吗？

scripts.text: Help me with playing.
scripts.translation: 帮我玩游戏。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Oh, hi meow~
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
哦，你好喵~

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
I tell you this meow~ You don't know Cat Gamers Director's feeling meow~.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
我告诉你喵~ 你不知道猫玩家总监的感受喵~。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
lol? >> Curious, Admire
Heh~ >> Normal
lol Heh~ >> Happy
lol lol Heh~ >> Crazy meow
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
哈哈？>> 好奇，羡慕
嘿嘿~ >> 普通
哈哈 嘿嘿~ >> 开心
哈哈 哈哈 嘿嘿~ >> 疯狂喵

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
But, why are you asking me meow? Strange meow...
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
但是，你为什么问我喵？真奇怪喵...

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Some cats use 'meow meow' like me when talking, but some don't.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
有些猫像我一样说话时会用“喵喵”，但有些猫不会。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Cats don't have an honorific phrase, so don't get us wrong as looking down on you meow.~
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
猫没有敬语，所以请不要误会我们是在轻视你喵~

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You should walk around many places and ask for information meow... But, don't bother me please meow~
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
你应该去很多地方打听消息喵... 但是，请不要打扰我喵~

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
No easy way for that... I just breathe meow...
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
没有什么简单的办法... 我只是呼吸喵...

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
What game do you want to play?
'Cat Gamers' has players for 4 types of games meow~
The Cat Gamers Director said he will challenge other games later~
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
你想玩什么游戏？
“猫玩家”有4种游戏的玩家喵~
猫玩家总监说之后会挑战其他游戏~

scripts.text: Rock Paper Scissors
scripts.translation: 石头剪刀布

scripts.text: KongNyangKong
scripts.translation: KongNyangKong

scripts.text: ChamChamCham
scripts.translation: ChamChamCham

scripts.text: Flag Game
scripts.translation: 旗子游戏

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Rock Paper Scissors meow? Nothing special...
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
石头剪刀布喵？没什么特别的...

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Scissor beats Paper, meow.
Rock beats Scissors, meow.
Paper beats Rock, meow.
These are basic rules.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
剪刀赢纸张，喵。
岩石赢剪刀，喵。
纸张赢岩石，喵。
这些是基本规则。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You play 5 Rock Paper Scissors games with player cats meow.
You play again when you are even meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
你和玩家猫进行5局石头剪刀布喵。
平局时重新进行喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You can get a present after 3 times of winning meow.
And you get a big present when you win all 5 matches, meow!!
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
赢3次可以获得礼物喵。
赢下全部5局，可以获得大礼物，喵!!

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Find Paa or Ser if you want to play the Rock Paper Scissors game.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
如果你想玩石头剪刀布游戏，去找帕阿或塞尔。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
KongNyangKong is not an easy game meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
KongNyangKong不是简单的游戏喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
When attacking, face your hand the same direction as the opponent meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
攻击时，手的方向要与对手相同喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
When defending, you should face your hand the opposite direction from the opponent meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
防御时，手的方向要与对手相反喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
If the attack is a success, you can keep on attacking.
But, if you fail, you have to defend meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
如果攻击成功，你可以继续攻击。
但是，如果失败，你就必须防御喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
If you be careful, you can win without getting hit at all meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
如果你小心一点，完全可以做到毫发无伤地获胜喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Once you make your opponent's HP 0, you win meow.
Of course there will be a present meow.
Good luck meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
一旦将对手的HP降为0，你就赢了喵。
当然会有礼物喵。
祝你好运喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Oh~ right meow~!! Find KungKung if you want to play KongNyangKong.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
哦~对了喵~！！如果你想玩KongNyangKong，去找孔孔。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
ChamChamCham is a high level mind game meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
ChamChamCham是一款高难度的心理博弈游戏喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
The rules are simple, but you need to think a lot meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
规则很简单，但需要动很多脑筋喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You should direct your hand to where the cat turns its face meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
你应该将手伸向猫脸转过去的方向喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
A present is given for 3 wins in a row meow.
The more wins, the more presents meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
连续获胜3次即可获得礼物喵。
获胜次数越多，礼物越多喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Kuka is smart, and remembers players with many wins meow.
There will be more presents when you take 1st place meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
库卡很聪明，会记住获胜次数多的玩家喵。
获得第一名时会有更多礼物喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Flag Game is way harder than ChamChamCham game meow.
Really~ Really~ Really~
hard mind game meow.
It's 1,000 times harder meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
旗子游戏比ChamChamCham难得多喵。
真的~真的~真的~
是非常烧脑的心理博弈喵。
难度是它的1000倍喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You get 5 Flag Point when starting meow.
1 point goes away when you wave the flag once meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
开始时你有5点旗子点数喵。
每挥动一次旗子，就会失去1点喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You win the game when no other cats are waving flags meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
当没有其他猫在挥动旗子时，你就赢了喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You can predict if other cats will wave their flags or not meow.
By looking at their actions meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
你可以通过观察其他猫的动作，
来预测它们是否会挥动旗子喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You must win to get presents meow.
You will get more presents since this is hard game meow~
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
必须获胜才能获得礼物喵。
因为这是高难度游戏，所以礼物会更多喵~

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
If you want to play Flag Game meow~
Go find the other manager cat who is trying to get the Referee Certificate meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员猫]
如果你想玩旗子游戏喵~
去找那只正在尝试获取裁判证书的另一只管理员猫喵。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 您的负重太重，无法继续。请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 您的背包已满，无法继续。请整理背包后再来。

scripts.text: You found Eryu the cat, and start talking.
scripts.translation: 你找到了猫埃留，并开始交谈。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Umm... Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
嗯...你是谁？

scripts.text: The Games Director sent me.
scripts.translation: 游戏总监派我来的。

scripts.text: I am a writer for the 'Human' magazine.
scripts.translation: 我是《人类》杂志的记者。

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Arrgg. Go away...
I don't know who you're talking about.
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
啊...走开...
我不知道你在说谁。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Umm? 'Human' magazine?
Is there such a thing?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
嗯？《人类》杂志？
有这种东西吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We've been publishing for 10 years.
But, I guess it is possible for cats to not know who we are.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们已经出版10年了。
不过，猫不知道我们是谁，也是有可能的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We are a really famous magazine throughout the World!
Don't you believe me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们是全世界都非常有名的杂志！
你不相信我吗？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Hmm... ok. But, what can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
嗯...好吧。不过，我能为你做什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am in the middle of writing an article named 'Game Playing Cats'...'
It is a special piece for me.
And some team named umm... do... umm... wal... not sure...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我正在写一篇名为《游戏玩家猫》的文章...
这是对我来说非常特别的一篇。
还有一个队伍，名字是...嗯...多...嗯...华尔...不确定...

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
'Dog n Waltz'?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
“狗与华尔兹”？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! Yes!
One of players there 'Dog n Waltz' has recommended Eryu for an interview.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦！是的！
“狗与华尔兹”的一名玩家推荐了埃留接受采访。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He says you are a really good player who can help me with the article.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他说你是一位非常优秀的玩家，可以帮我完成这篇文章。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
I don't remember anyone from 'Dog n Waltz' that much.
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
我不太记得“狗与华尔兹”的任何人了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The person isn't important.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那个人不重要。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Just answer a few questions for me, ok?
Be yourself and you'll do just fine.
Ok, first question: How much do you practice a day?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
只要回答我几个问题就好，好吗？
做你自己，你会做得很好的。
好，第一个问题：你每天练习多久？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Usually for about 8 hours, but I have to tell you that I'm not on the team anymore...
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
通常大约8个小时，但我必须告诉你，我不在那个队伍了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, what?
You are not with the team now? How come...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，什么？
你现在不在队伍里了？怎么会...？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Well...
The Director Cat was too scary...
I was very sick and had to take a day off...
Just one freaking day...
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
嗯...
总监猫太可怕了...
我病得很重，不得不请了一天假...
就一天而已...

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
And then the Director Cat was raging at me!
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
然后总监猫对我大发雷霆！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm, sounds pretty rough.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，听起来挺糟糕的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
'Cat Gamers' has lost another great player.
I'm sorry to hear that you're not on the team anymore.
I guess this is the end of the interview.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
“猫玩家”又失去了一位优秀的玩家。
很遗憾听到你不在队伍里了。
我想采访到此为止了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Because this is for current players only.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
因为这是只针对现役玩家的。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Oh...
Sorry to make you waste your time.
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
哦...
抱歉让你浪费了时间。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, don't worry.
I should say sorry for taking up your precious time.
Have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，别担心。
应该说抱歉占用你宝贵的时间。
祝你有美好的一天。

scripts.text:
You found out the reason why Eryu left the team.
Time to go find the other cats.
scripts.translation:
你发现了埃留离开队伍的原因。
是时候去找其他猫了。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Yes, I am Eryu! What do you want, huh, meow~
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
是的，我是埃留！
你想干什么，喵~

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Aren't you the magazine writer?
What brings you here again...?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
你不是那个杂志记者吗？
怎么又来这里了...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah!
Sorry, I was trying to interview another cat...
And came back to you by mistake.
I'm sorry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊！

You can always get a loan!!
This a like 100 times result for sure!!
How can you loose a chance like this?
You should do whatever it takes!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你总是可以贷款的！！
这肯定是100倍的回报！！
你怎么能错过这样的机会？
你应该不惜一切代价去做！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know what..? They say some careers like pro gamers can get solid loans.
Like about 1,000 can loan at once.
Without a high interest rate!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道吗？据说像职业游戏玩家这样的职业可以获得稳定的贷款。
比如一次性贷款1,000罐。
而且没有高利率！

scripts.text:
[Eff]
Meow!! 1... 1,000...
Moew~ I am a Pro Gamer.
Meow~ But, I quit~ Meow~
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
喵！！1...1,000...
喵~我是职业游戏玩家。
喵~但是，我辞职了~喵~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What!! Why would you quit such good a gig!! Are you crazy?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么！！为什么要放弃这么好的工作！！你疯了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's say we invest 1,000 cans after getting that loan.
One, Ten, Hundred, Tousand. Woot!
I can't believe this.
The result will be 100,000 cans, 100,000!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
假设我们在拿到那笔贷款后，投入1,000罐。
一、十、百、千。哇哦！
我不敢相信。
结果将是100,000罐，100,000！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So tell me... Why did you quit such a great job?
Why?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么告诉我... 你为什么放弃这么棒的工作？
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Eff]
I was afraid of the Director Cat there...
Meow~ This one time, I had to take a sick day.
Meow~ And I haven't seen such scary cat my entire life...
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
我害怕那里的猫玩家总监...
喵~ 有一次，我不得不请病假。
喵~ 我这一生都没见过那么可怕的猫...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So you quit because Cat Gamers Director was so scary. Hmm, sorry but I can't let you in on this investment...
I guess... What a waste of time!
Good bye!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以你是因为猫玩家总监太可怕才辞职的。嗯，抱歉，我不能让你参与这个投资...
我想... 真是浪费时间！
再见！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh and don't tell anyone what I just told you!
Bye~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，还有，别把刚才告诉你的事说给别人听！
再见~

scripts.text:
You found out why Eff has left the team.
Now, let's find the other cats.
scripts.translation:
你发现了埃夫离开团队的原因。
现在，让我们去找其他的猫。

scripts.text:
[Eff]
Yes. I am a cat.
Meow~ Do you think I am a dog?
Meow~ You are a strange human. Meow~
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
是的。我是一只猫。
喵~ 你觉得我是一只狗吗？
喵~ 你是个奇怪的人类。喵~

scripts.text:
[Eff]
Seeing as this is like the first time I met you.
I'll forgive you today. Meow.
Meow~ Don't even think about bringing up that name to me again...
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
既然这就像是我们第一次见面。
我今天原谅你了。喵。
喵~ 别再在我面前提起那个名字了...

scripts.text:
[Eff]
You are--!!
Meow~ I want to invest. Meow~
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
你是--！！
喵~ 我想投资。喵~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not without the cans you can't!!
You didn't tell anyone about this deal, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没有罐子你不行！！
你没有把这笔交易告诉别人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Eff]
I didn't. Meow~
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
我没有。喵~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok, good cat! Never!!
Tell this to other cats!~
Bye Bye~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，好猫！绝对不要！！
把这个告诉其他的猫！~
再见~

scripts.text:
[Eff]
This is not possible. Please contact an administrator.
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
这是不可能的。请联系管理员。

scripts.text:
[Eff]
Who are you, meow?
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
你是谁，喵？

scripts.text: What do you want to say?
scripts.translation: 你想说什么？

scripts.text:
[Eff]
What is this? What do you mean by '{0}'? Meow...
Meow...? Meow! You! Investor meow?
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
这是什么？你说'{0}'是什么意思？喵...
喵...？喵！你！投资者喵？

scripts.text:
Eff seems to recognize you.
{0}
scripts.translation:
埃夫似乎认识你。
{0}

scripts.text:
[Eff]
You are--!!
Meow~ I want to invest. Meow~
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
你是--！！
喵~ 我想投资。喵~

scripts.text: Eff seems to recognize you, so let's get away.
scripts.translation: 埃夫似乎认识你，所以我们快离开吧。

scripts.text:
[Eff]
Meow Meow~ 'Cat Gamers' can say good bye to me, meow.
Meow... Who are you meow?
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
喵喵~ “猫玩家”可以跟我道别了，喵。
喵...你是谁喵？

scripts.text: This cat might hit you. Let's get away.
scripts.translation: 这只猫可能会攻击你。快逃吧。

scripts.text:
[Eff]
Meow~ I want to invest. Meow~
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
喵~ 我想投资。喵~

scripts.text: Eff seems to recognize you, so let's get away.
scripts.translation: 埃夫似乎认识你，所以我们快离开吧。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 您的负重太重，无法继续。请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 您的背包已满，无法继续。请整理背包后再来。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Hey, ^0000FF{0}^000000. You haven't done what we asked you for. A promise is a promise, you know.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
嘿，^0000FF{0}^000000。你还没完成我们拜托你的事呢。答应过的事情就要做到，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Ah!! When you are done, please get checked by the Cat Gamers Director over there.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
啊！！完成后，请去那边找猫玩家总监检查一下。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You seem like a first timer! Where did you get the certificate? Someone lost it, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
你看起来像是第一次来！证书是从哪里弄来的？大概是有人弄丢了吧。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Rock Paper Scissors is a serious game. When will our practicing partner come?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
猜拳是一项严肃的游戏。我们的练习搭档什么时候来呢？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000? Want to play the Rock Paper Scissors game?

[Ser]
Where is your Cat Gamers Certificate? It seems like nothing, but you can't play this game without it!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
你的猫玩家证书呢？虽然看起来没什么，但没有它你是不能玩这个游戏的！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Please go get the certificate.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
请去把证书拿来。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Is it tomorrow already? I don't think so! Can't you read the time?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
已经明天了吗？我不觉得！你难道不会看时间吗？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000? Want to play the Rock Paper Scissors game?
Play the game.
scripts.translation: 玩游戏

scripts.text: Say hi.
scripts.translation: 打招呼

scripts.text: Ask about the game rules.
scripts.translation: 询问游戏规则

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Good idea.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
好主意。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! Ok, hi? But, why now?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
哦！好的，你好？但是，为什么是现在？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Ah... You are bored? Why don't you play a game with me?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
啊...你是无聊了吗？不如跟我玩个游戏吧？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Hey, you! Don't neglect the Rock Paper Scissors game!!
I've seen many people getting their butts kicked in this game!!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
嘿，你！不要轻视猜拳游戏！！
我见过很多人在这个游戏中被打得落花流水！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You better mark my words, if you don't want to end up like them!~
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
你最好记住我的话，如果你不想像他们一样惨的话！~

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You don't even know how to play this game?
Let me kindly teach you.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
你连这个游戏怎么玩都不知道吗？
让我好好教你吧。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Scissors beats Paper,
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
剪刀胜纸张，

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Paper beats Rock,
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
纸张胜岩石，

scripts.text:
[Ser]
And Rock beats Scissors.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
而岩石胜剪刀。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Ok? Got it now?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
明白了吗？懂了吗？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You must play 5 matches with me.
We go again if the game is even!!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
你必须和我玩5局。
如果是平局，我们就再玩一次！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I will give you a present if you beat me 3 times. Ok?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
如果你赢我3次，我会送你一份礼物。好吗？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Ok, then. Go away.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
好了，就这样。快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
{0} match ~~
Result is even, so we play again.
Try your best!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
第{0}局 ~~
结果是平局，所以我们要再玩一次。
加油哦！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
{0} match ~~
Try your best!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
第{0}局 ~~
加油哦！

scripts.text:
[Ser & {0}]
Rock! Paper! Scissors!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔与{0}]
石头！剪刀！布！

scripts.text: Rock
scripts.translation: 石头

scripts.text: Paper
scripts.translation: 布

scripts.text: Scissors
scripts.translation: 剪刀

scripts.text:
[Ser]
All 5 matches are over!!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
5局全部结束了！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Hmm... Let me see...
I won {0} times, and you, {1}, won {2} times, right?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
嗯...让我看看...
我赢了{0}次，而你，{1}，赢了{2}次，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
{0} has won the game.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
{0}赢得了比赛。

scripts.text: Ser became polite all of a sudden.
scripts.translation: 塞尔突然变得很有礼貌。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Great game it was. I admire your enthusiasm for the game. So, I want to give you my precious Can as a present.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
真是场精彩的比赛。我很欣赏你对游戏的热爱。所以，我想把我珍贵的罐头作为礼物送给你。

scripts.text: I don't need it!
scripts.translation: 我不需要！

scripts.text: Thank you.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Just take it!! Do as I say~
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
拿着吧！！照我说的做~

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You are polite. But, sadly this is all I can give you.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
你很礼貌。但遗憾的是，我只能给你这些了。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Good bye~ Come back tomorrow for more practice~
Oh! You won all 5 matches. Here are some more extra Cans.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
再见~ 明天再来练习吧~
哦！你赢了全部5局。这里还有一些额外的罐头。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Good bye~ Come back tomorrow for more practice~
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
再见~ 明天再来练习吧~

scripts.text:
[Ser]
{0} has lost. Ha... Ha...
Ser became very arrogant.
scripts.translation: 塞尔变得非常傲慢。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You want to play with me? Ser? With that skill of yours? Meow?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
你想跟我玩？塞尔？就凭你那点本事？喵？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
What? Present? How can you ask for such a thing when you lose? Go practice more!! Work!! Yes, I should make you do this!!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
什么？礼物？输了还想要礼物？去多练习！！努力！！没错，我应该让你这么做！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Hmm. Do you know a fish named Phen? Do you? Isn't it a delicious looking fish?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
嗯。你知道一种叫剑鱼的鱼吗？知道吧？看起来很好吃吧？

scripts.text:
- Chrub -
Ser wipes the drool from his mouth.
scripts.translation:
- 咕噜 -
塞尔擦掉了嘴边的口水。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Go catch 30 Phens. And also get me 10 Fish Tails. Get them to our Director cat, and he will make a delicious dish with them.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
去抓30条剑鱼。再给我弄10个鱼尾。把它们交给我们的猫玩家总监，他会用它们做一道美味佳肴。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Lately, I've felt powerless and that there's too much weight on me. I should take care of my health.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
最近，我感到力不从心，肩上的担子太重了。我应该好好保养一下身体。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Now it's time for some healthy food.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
现在是吃点健康食物的时候了。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Get 50 Marse and 25 Milk to our Cat Gamers Director. He has excellent knowledge on healthy foods.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
去抓50只乌贼和25瓶牛奶，交给我们的猫玩家总监。他对健康食品很有研究。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Well... we do have a rival, you know. They are 'Dog n Waltz', and everything goes wrong when they come around.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
嗯...我们有个对手，你知道吗。他们是“狗与华尔兹”，只要他们出现，一切都会变得一团糟。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I would ask you to bully them, but I suppose that's illegal... So, please at least harass similar looking monsters. What would be a good target?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
我想让你去欺负他们，但我想那可能违法...所以，请至少去骚扰一下长得像他们的魔物。什么目标比较合适？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh, that archer among Kobolds!! I hate those the most. Go harass 30 Kobold Archers, and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
哦，就是刺锤犬妖里的弓箭手！！我最讨厌那种了。去骚扰30只犬妖弓箭手，然后向我们的猫玩家总监汇报。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
What is most important for winning the game? It is quickness. What should we do to get faster?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
赢得比赛最重要的是什么？是速度。我们要怎么做才能变得更快？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I've been thinking... The best way for us cats is obviously catching rats.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
我一直在想...对我们猫来说，最好的方法显然是抓老鼠。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You know Cramp, right? That blue chubby creature... Please go catch 10 of them, and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
你知道蓝鼠吗？那种蓝色的胖家伙...请去抓10只，然后向我们的猫玩家总监汇报。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Ah... I want some bird cuisine. Which one would be most delicious?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
啊...我想吃些鸟类料理。哪一种最好吃呢？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Picky? Ah! It's too small. How about Condor? I am not sure... Peco Peco?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
小鸡？啊！太小了。秃鹰呢？我不太确定...大嘴鸟？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Alright! Please catch 50 Peco Pecos and get them to our Cat Gamers Director. We shall have a party with bird cuisine tonight.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
好！请去抓50只大嘴鸟，交给我们的猫玩家总监。今晚我们要举办一场鸟类料理派对。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I get too nervous before the game. And I don't play well when I'm nervous. I need something to calm down before the game starts.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
我在比赛前总是太紧张了。一紧张就发挥不好。我需要找点东西，在比赛开始前让自己冷静下来。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! That's right! Yarn! I used to play with Yarn when I was young. Wasn't able to have that kind of relaxation after joining the 'Cat Gamers'.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
哦！对了！毛线球！我小时候经常玩毛线球。加入“猫玩家”之后，就没再享受过那种放松的感觉了。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Please get 20 Yarns for me. Why 20? There are many other cats with the same issue. Our Director should take care of this for you.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
请帮我拿20个毛线球。为什么是20个？因为有很多只猫都有同样的困扰。我们的总监应该会为你处理这件事的。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Recently, our Director seems to have been trying to cut some expenses. Or is the manager taking advantage?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
最近，我们的总监似乎一直在试图削减开支。还是说管理员在趁机占便宜？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Regular snacks for our players have been reduced. You should go get 30 Rat Tails, and give them to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
我们选手的常规零食被削减了。你应该去拿30条鼠尾，然后交给我们的猫玩家总监。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Then, we shall find out if our manager is being greedy or not.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
这样，我们就能看看我们的管理员是不是在贪小便宜了。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I am having a slump these days. I can't give my 100% to the game.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
我最近状态很差。没办法在游戏中发挥100%的实力。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
It is the lemon we need in times like this.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
在这种时候，我们需要的是柠檬。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Please get 5 lemons for me. Don't forget, I need 5 Lemons... Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
请帮我拿5个柠檬。别忘了，我需要5个柠檬...我们的猫玩家总监应该知道该怎么处理它们。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Malangdo is a good place for a cat to live. But, it gets very hot when we play games.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
玛朗多是个适合猫咪居住的好地方。但是，当我们玩游戏的时候，会变得非常热。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
When we are playing a lot, it gets really crazy hot, hard for us to bear. You know how hysterical we cats can be, right?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
当我们玩得投入时，真的会变得热得发疯，让人难以忍受。你知道我们猫咪有多情绪化吧？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Please get us either 10 Ice Pieces or 10 Ice Creams. Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
请帮我们拿10个冰碎片或者10个冰淇淋。我们的猫玩家总监应该知道该怎么处理它们。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I can see that you also need some rest. Feel free to relax for a while. How about taking a walk around the village? I insist~!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
我看你也需要休息一下。不妨放松一会儿。要不要在村子里散散步？我强烈建议哦~！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village. Hmm... Right!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Eryu?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
但是，只是在村子里散步也没什么意思。嗯...对了！！你不妨去见见一只名叫埃留的猫？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back'. That is the password. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time!!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
哦！还有，当你见到那只猫时，一定要说“回来”。那是密码。别忘了告诉我们的总监，我一直都在你身边！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I can see that you also need some rest. Feel free to relax for a while. How about taking a walk around the village? I insist~!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
我看你也需要休息一下。不妨放松一会儿。要不要在村子里散散步？我强烈建议哦~！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village. Hmm... Right!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Stew?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
但是，只是在村子里散步也没什么意思。嗯...对了！！你不妨去见见一只名叫斯图的猫？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back'. That is the password. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time!!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
哦！还有，当你见到那只猫时，一定要说“回来”。那是密码。别忘了告诉我们的总监，我一直都在你身边！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I can see that you also need some rest. Feel free to relax for a while. How about taking a walk around the village? I insist~!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
我看你也需要休息一下。不妨放松一会儿。要不要在村子里散散步？我强烈建议哦~！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village. Hmm... Right!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Ketchup?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
但是，只是在村子里散步也没什么意思。嗯...对了！！你不妨去见见一只名叫番茄酱的猫？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back'. That is the password. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time!!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
哦！还有，当你见到那只猫时，一定要说“回来”。那是密码。别忘了告诉我们的总监，我一直都在你身边！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village. Hmm... Right!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Eff?

但是，只是在村子里散步也没什么意思。嗯...对了！！你不妨去见见一只名叫埃夫的猫？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back'. That is the password. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time!!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
哦！还有，当你见到那只猫时，一定要说“回来”。那是密码。别忘了告诉我们的总监，我一直都在你身边！！

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 您的负重太重，无法继续。请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 您的背包已满，无法继续。请整理背包后再来。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You haven't done what we asked you for meow. A promise is a promise, you know meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你还没有完成我们拜托你的事情喵。一诺千金，你懂的喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
When you are done meow, please get checked by the Cat Gamers Director over there meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
做完之后喵，请去那边找猫玩家总监检查一下喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You seem like a first timer meow! Where did you get the certificate meow? Someone lost it, I guess meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你看起来像是第一次来喵！你的证书是从哪里弄来的喵？大概是有人弄丢了吧喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
When is our practicing partner coming meow? I am bored meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我们的练习搭档什么时候来喵？我无聊死了喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000 meow? Want to play the Rock Paper Scissors game meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦，^0000FF{0}^000000喵？想玩猜拳游戏吗喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Where is your Cat Gamers Certificate meow? It seems like nothing, but you can't play this game without it meow!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你的猫玩家证书呢喵？虽然看起来没什么，但没有它可玩不了这个游戏喵！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Go get the certificate meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
去把证书拿来喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
We can only play the game once a day meow. Come tomorrow meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我们每天只能玩一次喵。明天再来喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000 meow? Want to play the Rock Paper Scissors game meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦，^0000FF{0}^000000喵？想玩猜拳游戏吗喵？

scripts.text: Play the game.
scripts.translation: 玩游戏

scripts.text: Say hi.
scripts.translation: 打招呼

scripts.text: Ask about the game rules.
scripts.translation: 询问游戏规则

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Good idea meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
好主意喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Hello meow~ Nice to see you meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你好喵~ 见到你真好喵~

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Other games have one cat player. But, we have two for Rock Paper Scissors. You want to know why meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
其他游戏只有一只猫玩家。但是，我们猜拳游戏有两只。你想知道为什么吗喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Paa is kind meow. So, I'll tell you story meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
帕阿很善良喵。所以，我要给你讲个故事喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Ser cat is my twin brother. I was born first, but he always says he is the elder meow. But, I don't fight with Ser meow. I am a good brother meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
塞尔猫是我的双胞胎哥哥。虽然我是先出生的，但他总说他是哥哥喵。不过，我不跟塞尔吵架喵。我是个好哥哥喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Anyways, me and Ser are well known as the pro gamer cat brothers meow. Everyone knows us meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
总之，我和塞尔是著名的职业游戏猫兄弟喵。大家都认识我们喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You are free to admire me, meow. I give you permission meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你可以随意崇拜我，喵。我允许你喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You want to know how to play this game meow? I'll teach you because I am a kind cat meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你想知道怎么玩这个游戏吗喵？我会教你的，因为我是只善良的猫喵~

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You don't seem that stupid meow. So, let's skip the part about what beats what meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你看起来不笨喵。所以，我们跳过“谁赢谁”的部分喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You must play 5 matches with me meow. We go again if the game is even meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你必须和我玩5局喵。如果平局，我们就再玩一次喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
If you win 3 times, I'll give you a present meow~ Cat Gamers Director said so meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
如果你赢了3次，我会给你一份礼物喵~ 猫玩家总监是这么说的喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
That is all meow~ But it is not an easy game meow. Respect the game meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
就这些喵~ 但这可不是个简单的游戏喵。请尊重游戏喵~

scripts.text:
[Paa]
{0} match ~~ meow.
Result is even, so we play again meow.
Try your best meow!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
第{0}局 ~~ 喵。
结果是平局，所以我们要再玩一次喵。
加油喵！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
{0} match ~~ meow.
Try your best meow!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
第{0}局 ~~ 喵。
加油喵！

scripts.text:
[Ser & {0}]
Rock! Paper! Scissors!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔与{0}]
石头！剪刀！布！

scripts.text: Rock
scripts.translation: 石头

scripts.text: Paper
scripts.translation: 布

scripts.text: Scissors
scripts.translation: 剪刀

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Meow!! All 5 matches are over meow!!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
喵！！5局全部结束了喵！！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Let me see meow...
I won {0} times meow, and you, {1}, won {2} times, right meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
让我看看喵...
我赢了{0}次喵，你，{1}，赢了{2}次，对吧喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You won meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你赢了喵。

scripts.text: Paa became polite all of a sudden.
scripts.translation: 帕阿突然变得很有礼貌。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Great game it was meow. I admire your enthusiasm for the game meow. So, I want to give you my precious Can as a present meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
真是精彩的一局喵。我很欣赏你对游戏的热爱喵。所以，我想把我珍贵的罐头作为礼物送给你喵。

scripts.text: I don't need it!
scripts.translation: 我不需要！

scripts.text: Thank you.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Just take it meow!! Do as I say meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
快拿去吧喵！！照我说的做喵~

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You are polite meow. But, sadly this is all I can give you meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你很礼貌喵。但是，很遗憾，这就是我能给你的全部了喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Good bye meow~ Come back tomorrow for more practice meow~
Oh! You won all 5 matches meow. Here are some more extra Cans meow!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
再见喵~ 明天再来练习喵~
哦！你赢了全部5局喵。这里有一些额外的罐头喵！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Good bye meow~ Come back tomorrow for more practice meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
再见喵~ 明天再来练习喵~

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You lost. Meow... Meow...
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你输了。喵... 喵...

scripts.text: Paa became very arrogant.
scripts.translation: 帕阿变得非常傲慢。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You want to play with me? Paa? With that skill of yours? Meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你想和我玩？帕阿？就凭你那点技术？喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
What? Present meow? How can you ask for such a thing meow? You lost meow! Go practice more!! Work!! Yes, I should make you do this meow!!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
什么？礼物喵？你怎么能提出这种要求喵？你输了喵！去多练习！！努力！！是的，我应该让你做这个喵！！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Hmm. Do you know a fish named Phen meow? Do you? Isn't it a delicious looking fish meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
嗯。你知道一种叫剑鱼的鱼吗喵？知道吧？那看起来是不是很好吃喵？

scripts.text:
- Chrub -
Paa wipes the drool from his mouth.
scripts.translation:
- 咕噜 -
帕阿擦掉了嘴边的口水。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Go catch 30 Phens meow. And also get me 10 Fish Tails meow. Get them to our Director cat, and he will make a delicious dish with them meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
去抓30条剑鱼喵。还要给我弄10个鱼尾喵。把它们交给我们的总监猫，他会用它们做一道美味佳肴喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Lately, I've felt powerless and that there's too much weight on me meow. I should take care of my health meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
最近，我觉得自己很无力，感觉肩上的担子太重了喵。我应该好好照顾一下我的健康喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Now it's time for some healthy food meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
现在是吃健康食物的时间了喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Get 50 Marse and 25 Milk to our Cat Gamers Director meow. He has excellent knowledge on healthy foods meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
去抓50只乌贼和25瓶牛奶，交给我们的猫玩家总监喵。他对健康食品很有研究喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
We do have a rival, you know meow. They are 'Dog n Waltz', and everything goes wrong when they come around meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你知道吧，我们有个对手喵。他们叫“狗与华尔兹”，只要他们一出现，事情就会变得一团糟喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I would ask you to bully them, but I suppose that's illegal meow... So, I will ask you to harass similar looking monsters meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我想让你去欺负他们，但这好像违法喵... 所以，我会让你去骚扰一些长得像他们的魔物喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh, that archer among Kobolds meow!! I hate those the most. Go harass 30 Kobold Archers, and report to our Cat Gamers Director meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦，就是刺锤犬妖里的那个弓箭手喵！！我最讨厌那种了。去骚扰30只犬妖弓箭手，然后向我们的猫玩家总监汇报喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
What is most important for winning the game meow? It is quickness. What should we do to get faster meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
赢得比赛最重要的是什么喵？是速度。那我们要怎么做才能变快呢喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I've been thinking meow... The best way for us cats is obviously catching rats meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我一直在想喵... 对我们猫来说，最好的方法显然是抓老鼠喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You know Cramp, right meow? That blue chubby creature meow... Please go catch 10 of them, and report to our Cat Gamers Director meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你知道蓝鼠吧喵？就是那种蓝色的胖乎乎的生物喵... 请去抓10只，然后向我们的猫玩家总监汇报喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Chrub... I want some bird cuisine meow. Which one would be most delicious meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
咕噜... 我想吃点鸟类料理喵。哪一种最好吃呢喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Picky? Ah! It's too small meow. How about Condor? I am not sure... Peco Peco meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
小鸡？啊！太小了喵。秃鹰怎么样？我不太确定... 大嘴鸟喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Alright meow! Please catch 50 Peco Pecos and get them to our Cat Gamers Director meow. We shall have a party with bird cuisine tonight meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
好喵！请抓50只大嘴鸟，交给我们的猫玩家总监喵。今晚我们要举办一场鸟类料理派对喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I get too nervous before the game meow. And I don't play well when I'm nervous meow. I need something to calm down before the game starts meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
比赛前我总是太紧张喵。而且我一紧张就发挥不好喵。我需要在比赛开始前吃点东西让自己冷静下来喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh! That's right meow! Yarn meow! I used to play with Yarn when I was young meow. Wasn't able to have that kind of relaxation after joining the 'Cat Gamers' meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦！对了喵！毛线喵！我小时候经常玩毛线喵。加入“猫玩家”之后，就没法享受那种放松了喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Please get 20 Yarns for me meow. Why 20? There are many other cats with the same issue meow. Our Director should take care of this for you meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
请帮我弄20个毛线球喵。为什么是20个？因为有很多猫都有同样的困扰喵。我们的总监应该会为你处理这件事喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Recently, our Director seems to have been trying to cut some expenses meow. Or is the manager taking advantage meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
最近，我们的总监似乎想削减一些开支喵。还是说管理员在占便宜喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Regular snacks for our players have been reduced meow. You should go get 30 Rat Tails, and give them to our Cat Gamers Director meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
给我们玩家的日常零食被减少了喵。你应该去弄30个鼠尾，交给我们的猫玩家总监喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Then, we shall find out if our manager is being greedy or not meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
然后，我们就能看看我们的管理员是不是在贪小便宜了喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I am having a slump these days meow. I can't give my 100% to the game meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
这些天我状态很差喵。没办法在赛场上发挥100%的实力喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
It is the lemon we need in times like this meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
在这种时候，我们需要的是柠檬喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Get 5 lemons for me meow. Don't forget, I need 5 Lemons meow... Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
帮我弄5个柠檬喵。别忘了，我要5个柠檬喵... 我们的猫玩家总监应该知道该怎么处理它们喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Malangdo is a good place for a cat to live meow. But, it gets very hot when we play games meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
玛朗多是个适合猫居住的好地方喵。但是，当我们玩游戏的时候，那里会变得非常热喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
When we are playing a lot, it gets really crazy hot, hard for us to bear meow. You know how hysterical we cats can be, right meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
当我们玩得兴起的时候，真的会变得超级热，让我们难以忍受喵。你知道我们猫有多疯狂吧，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Get me either 10 Ice Pieces or 10 Ice Creams. Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
给我弄10个冰碎片或者10个冰淇淋喵。我们的猫玩家总监应该知道该怎么处理它们喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I can see that you also need some rest meow. Feel free to relax for a while meow. How about taking a walk around the village meow? I insist meow~!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我看你也需要休息一下喵。不妨放松一会儿喵。去村里散散步怎么样喵？我强烈建议喵~！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village meow. Hmm... Right meow!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Eryu meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
但是，只是在村里散步也没什么意思喵。嗯...对了喵！！你不妨去见见一只名叫埃留的猫喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back' meow. That is the password meow. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time meow!!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦！见到那只猫的时候，记得说“回来”喵。那是密码喵。还有，别忘了告诉我们的总监，我一直都在你身边喵！！

但是，只是在村里散步也没什么意思喵。嗯...对了喵！！你不妨去见见一只名叫番茄酱的猫喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back' meow. That is the password meow. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time meow!!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦！见到那只猫的时候，记得说“回来”喵。那是密码喵。还有，别忘了告诉我们的总监，我一直都在你身边喵！！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I can see that you also need some rest meow. Feel free to relax for a while meow. How about taking a walk around the village meow? I insist meow~!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我看你也需要休息一下喵。不妨放松一会儿喵。去村里散散步怎么样喵？我强烈建议喵~！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village meow. Hmm... Right meow!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Eff meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
但是，只是在村里散步也没什么意思喵。嗯...对了喵！！你不妨去见见一只名叫埃夫的猫喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back' meow. That is the password meow. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time meow!!
scripts.translation:

哦！见到那只猫的时候，记得说“回来”喵。那是密码喵。还有，别忘了告诉我们的总监，我一直都在你身边喵！！

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
You haven't done what we asked you for yo~. A promise is a promise, you know yo~.
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
你还没做我们让你做的事哟~。答应过的事情就要做到哟~。

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
When you are done, please get checked by the Cat Gamers Director over there yo.~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
做完之后，请去那边找猫玩家总监检查一下哟~。

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
You seem like a first timer yo~ Where did you get the certificate yo~ You better give that back yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
你看起来像是第一次来哟~ 证书是从哪里弄来的哟~ 最好把它还回去哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
The Cat Gamers Director said a practicing partner is coming yo~ But, that human didn't show up yo~ I am bored yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
猫玩家总监说有个练习搭档要来哟~ 但是，那个人类没有出现哟~ 我好无聊哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Oh great member you, ^0000FF{0}^000000~ Let's play ChamChamCham yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
哦，伟大的成员，^0000FF{0}^000000~ 我们来玩ChamChamCham吧哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
But, you don't have the certificate yo~ Certificate helps you save the game record yo~ You must have it! yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
但是，你没有证书哟~ 证书可以帮你保存游戏记录哟~ 你必须要有它！哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Please go get the certificate yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
请去拿证书哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Is it not tomorrow yet yo~ You can play one game a day yo~ Come back tomorrow yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
现在还没到明天哟~ 你每天只能玩一局哟~ 明天再来哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Oh great member you, ^0000FF{0}^000000~ Let's play ChamChamCham yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
哦，伟大的成员，^0000FF{0}^000000~ 我们来玩ChamChamCham吧哟~

scripts.translation: 玩游戏

scripts.text: Ask who is 1st place.

scripts.text: Ask about the game rules.
scripts.translation: 询问游戏规则

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Good choice yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
不错的选择哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
No one holds a record for the ChamChamCham game yo~
You could be the first yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
目前还没有人保持ChamChamCham游戏的记录哟~
你可以成为第一个哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Current 1st place for the ChamChamCham game is
^0000FF{0}^000000 with ^DE2B21{1}^000000 winning streak yo~
Never know when someone else would break the record yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
目前ChamChamCham游戏的第一名是
^0000FF{0}^000000，连胜^DE2B21{1}^000000场哟~
不知道什么时候会有人打破纪录哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Current 1st place for the ChamChamCham game is
^0000FF{0}^000000 with ^DE2B21{1}^000000 winning streak yo~
I expect that you, {2}, can beat ^0000FF{3}^000000 sometime yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
目前ChamChamCham游戏的第一名是
^0000FF{0}^000000，连胜^DE2B21{1}^000000场哟~
我相信你，{2}，总有一天能打败^0000FF{3}^000000哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
ChamChamCham game rules are very simple yo~
Just direct your hand towards the direction where I direct my face yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
ChamChamCham游戏的规则很简单哟~
只要把手指向我脸朝向的方向就可以了哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Like this yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
就像这样哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Or like that yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
或者像那样哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
A present is available for 3 wins yo~
If you beat the previous record, you get a bigger present yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
连赢3局可以获得礼物哟~
如果打破之前的纪录，还能获得更大的礼物哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
See you at the practice yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
练习见哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka & {0}]
Cham!
scripts.translation:
[库卡与{0}]
Cham!

[Kuka & {0}]
Cham! Cham!

[库卡与{0}]
Cham! Cham!

scripts.text:

Cham! Cham! Cham!
scripts.translation:
[库卡与{0}]
Cham! Cham! Cham!

scripts.text: Hand towards left
