scripts.translation: 向右

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Hehe~ I won yo~ I feel good yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
嘿嘿~我赢了哟~感觉真不错哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Well~ I lost yo~ Let's practice more yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
哎呀~我输了哟~再练习一下吧哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
{0} has won {1} times yo~ Next game starts yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
{0}赢了{1}局哟~下一局开始哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
After the practice, {0} has won {1} in a row yo~
Present is for 3 wins or more yo~ Nothing for today yo~ But, come again tomorrow yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
练习结束后，{0}连胜了{1}局哟~
礼物需要连赢3局或以上哟~今天没有奖励哟~不过，明天再来哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Congrats yo~ You won ^DE2B21{0}^000000 in a row yo~
You won ^DE2B21{1}^000000 more than the recent ^DE2B21{2}^000000 record yo~ Congrats yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
恭喜哟~你连胜了^DE2B21{0}^000000局哟~
比最近的^DE2B21{2}^000000纪录多赢了^DE2B21{1}^000000局哟~恭喜哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Congrats yo~ You won ^DE2B21{0}^000000 in a row yo~
And you have won ^DE2B21{1}^000000 more than ^0000FF{2}^000000's ^DE2B21{3}^000000 winning streak yo~ New record yo~ Congrats yo~

[Kuka]
Congrats yo~ You won ^DE2B21{0}^000000 in a row yo~
A new record yo~ Congrats yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
恭喜哟~你连胜了^DE2B21{0}^000000局哟~
新纪录哟~恭喜哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
I'll give you 1 random coin pocket as a special present yo~ Well done yo~ Come back tomorrow yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
我会给你1个随机硬币袋作为特别礼物哟~做得好哟~明天再来哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Congrats yo~ For winning {0} times I'll give you {1} cans yo~ Well done yo~ Come back tomorrow yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
恭喜哟~你赢了{0}局哟~
我会给你{1}罐饮料哟~做得好哟~明天再来哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
{0} didn't win at all yo~ You must work it out yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
{0}一局都没赢哟~
你得好好练习一下哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Kuka wants you to catch delicious Phens yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
库卡想让你抓美味的剑鱼哟~

scripts.text:
- Chrub -
Kuka wipes the drool from his mouth.
scripts.translation:
- 咕噜 -
库卡擦掉了嘴边的口水。

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Catch 30 Phens yo~ And also get me 10 Fish Tails yo~ Get them to our Director Cat, and he will make a delicious dish with them yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
抓30只剑鱼哟~
还要给我10个鱼尾哟~
把它们交给我们的猫玩家总监，他会用它们做一道美味佳肴哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Lately, I've felt powerless and that there's too much weight on me yo~ I should take care of my health yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
最近我觉得自己很无力，感觉压力好大哟~
我应该好好保养一下身体哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Now it's time for some healthy food yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
现在是吃健康食物的时间了哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Get 50 Marse and 25 Milk to our Cat Gamers Director yo~. He has excellent knowledge on healthy foods yo~.
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
去抓50只乌贼和25瓶牛奶，交给我们的猫玩家总监哟~
他对健康饮食很有研究哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
We have a rival yo~ 'Dog n Waltz' yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
我们有个对手哟~
叫“狗与华尔兹”哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
I want to harass similar goons yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
我想去骚扰一下那些类似的家伙哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
There is an archer among Kobolds yo~ Harass 30 Kobold Archers and report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
刺锤犬妖里有个弓箭手哟~
去骚扰30只犬妖弓箭手，然后向我们的猫玩家总监汇报哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Quickness is very important for winning the game yo~ Work on quickness yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
敏捷对于赢得比赛非常重要哟~
要练习敏捷哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Mouse catching is the best work out for quickness training yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
抓老鼠是锻炼敏捷最好的运动哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Catch 10 blue and chubby Cramps, and report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
抓10只蓝色胖乎乎的蓝鼠，然后向我们的猫玩家总监汇报哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
I crave bird cuisine yo~ Bird cuisine is so delicious yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
我好想吃鸟肉料理哟~
鸟肉料理真的很好吃哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Picky is too small and Condor is not tasty yo~ How about Peco Peco yo~?
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
小鸡太小了，秃鹰又不好吃哟~
大嘴鸟怎么样哟~？

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Ok yo~ Catch 50 Peco Pecos and report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~ Tonight, we will have a bird cuisine party yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
好哟~
抓50只大嘴鸟，然后向我们的猫玩家总监汇报哟~
今晚我们要举办鸟肉料理派对哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
I get too nervous before the game yo~. And I don't play well when I am nervous yo~. I need something to calm down before the game starts yo~.
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
比赛前我总是太紧张哟~
一紧张就发挥不好哟~
我需要在比赛开始前吃点东西让自己冷静下来哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Yarn is very useful for relaxing yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
毛线对放松很有帮助哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Get 20 Yarns yo~ There are many other cats with the same issue yo~ The Cat Gamers Director will take care of them yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
去抓20个毛线球哟~
还有很多其他猫也有同样的问题哟~
猫玩家总监会照顾它们的哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Recently, our Director seems to have been trying to cut some expenses yo~ Or maybe the Manager Cat is taking advantage yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
最近，我们的总监似乎想削减一些开支哟~
或者可能是管理员猫在占便宜哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Regular snacks for our players have been reduced yo~ {0} should go get 30 Rat Tails, and report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
给玩家的常规零食被削减了哟~
{0} 应该去收集30个鼠尾，然后向我们的猫玩家总监汇报哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Then, we shall find out if our manager is being greedy or not yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
这样，我们就能查明我们的管理员是不是在贪小便宜了哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
I am having a slump these days yo~ I can't give my 100% to the game.
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
我最近状态很差哟~
没办法在游戏中发挥100%的实力。

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
It is the lemon we need in times like this yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
在这种时候，我们需要柠檬哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Get 5 lemons for me yo~ Don't forget, I need 5 Lemons yo~ Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
帮我拿5个柠檬来哟~
别忘了，我需要5个柠檬哟~
我们的猫玩家总监应该知道该怎么处理它们哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Malangdo is a good place for a cat to live yo~ But, it gets very hot when we play games yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
马拉多是个适合猫居住的好地方哟~
但是，当我们玩游戏的时候，会变得非常热哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
When we are playing a lot, it gets really crazy hot yo~ Crazy cats are scary yo~ We need Ice Pieces or Ice Cream yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
当我们玩得很投入时，会变得超级热哟~
疯狂的猫很可怕哟~
我们需要冰碎片或者冰淇淋哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Get us either 10 Ice Pieces or 10 Ice Creams, and report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
给我们拿10个冰碎片或者10个冰淇淋，然后向我们的猫玩家总监汇报哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Cat Gamers Director's order yo~ Find Eryu who is afraid of the Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
猫玩家总监的命令哟~
找到害怕总监的埃留哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
You must find Eryu, and tell him 'Come back' yo~ report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
你必须找到埃留，并告诉他“回来”哟~
然后向我们的猫玩家总监汇报哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Cat Gamers Director's order yo~ Find Stew who is afraid of the Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
猫玩家总监的命令哟~
找到害怕总监的斯图哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
You must find Stew, and tell him 'Come back' yo~ report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
你必须找到斯图，并告诉他“回来”哟~
然后向我们的猫玩家总监汇报哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Cat Gamers Director's order yo~ Find Ketchup who is afraid of the Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
猫玩家总监的命令哟~
找到害怕总监的番茄酱哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
You must find Ketchup, and tell him 'Come back' yo~ report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
你必须找到番茄酱，并告诉他“回来”哟~
然后向我们的猫玩家总监汇报哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Cat Gamers Director's order yo~ Find Eff who is afraid of the Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
猫玩家总监的命令哟~
找到害怕总监的埃夫哟~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
You must find Eff, and tell him 'Come back' yo~ report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
你必须找到埃夫，并告诉他“回来”哟~
然后向我们的猫玩家总监汇报哟~

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 您的负重太重，无法继续。请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 您的背包已满，无法继续。请整理背包后再来。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
You didn't keep your promise. I have no business with you.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你没有遵守承诺。我与你没有任何关系。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
You are not qualified. Hmm... I am not sure how you got this, but we cannot practice with you. Go back.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你没有资格。嗯...我不确定你是怎么拿到这个的，但我们不能和你一起练习。回去吧。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Do not bother me. I am waiting for my practicing partner.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
别打扰我。我在等我的练习搭档。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Are you the practice partner? You are late. Let's start right away.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你是练习搭档吗？你迟到了。我们马上开始。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
... ... ...

[KungKung]
Where is your certificate? You cannot practice with us unless you have that certificate. Go get it.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你的证书呢？没有证书不能和我们练习。去拿回来。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
You don't have a watch? Or can't read the time? It's not the time yet.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你没带表吗？还是不会看时间？现在还没到时间。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Are you the practice partner? You are late. Let's start right away.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你是练习搭档吗？你迟到了。我们马上开始。

scripts.text: Play the game.
scripts.translation: 玩游戏

scripts.text: Ask current 1st place.
scripts.translation: 询问当前第一名

scripts.text: Ask about the game rules.
scripts.translation: 询问游戏规则

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Before the game, we will decide the turn by rolling a dice.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
比赛开始前，我们要通过掷骰子来决定先后手。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Why do you want to know the 1st place? KongNyangKong is a brutal and tough match game. Kuka should know such thing!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你为什么想知道第一名？孔羊孔是一场残酷且激烈的比赛。库卡应该知道这一点！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
You want to learn the game rules?
You seem to have a polite way of asking things.
Listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你想学习游戏规则？
你提问的方式很有礼貌。
请仔细听。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
KongNyangKong has different play rules when attacking and defending.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
孔羊孔在进攻和防守时有不同的规则。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
When attacking, you must turn your hand to the same side as your opponent in order to complete the attack.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
进攻时，你必须将手转向与对手相同的方向，才能完成进攻。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
If we turn our hands the same way like this, then your attack is successful.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
如果我们像这样把手转向同一方向，那么你的进攻就成功了。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
For defending, you must turn your hand to the opposite side of your opponent in order to defend yourself.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
防守时，你必须将手转向与对手相反的方向，才能进行防守。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Yes! If you turn your hand opposite to mine like that, you have succeeded defending yourself.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
没错！如果你像那样把手转向与我相反的方向，你就成功防守了。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
If you are clever enough, you should know that the bottom hand is the attacker's hand.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
如果你足够聪明，你应该知道下面的手是进攻方的手。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Last!! Most important rule.
Once you succeed attacking, you can continue attacking your opponent.
When you fail, then you are on the defending side.
Do not forget this!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
最后！！最重要的规则。
一旦你进攻成功，就可以继续进攻对手。
如果你失败了，你就转为防守方。
别忘了这一点！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
You can ask about the KongNyangKong rules anytime you want!
Our Manager Cat also knows all about the KongNyangKong rules.
That is all!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你可以随时询问孔羊孔的规则！
我们的管理员猫也精通孔羊孔的规则。
就这些了！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Your dice roll number is higher. You can attack first.
scripts.translation:

你的骰子点数更高。你可以先进攻。

scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我的骰子点数更高。我先进攻。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I lost. It was good game indeed.
A win would have been better, but I am too busy to look back at the past.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我输了。这确实是一场好游戏。
虽然赢了会更好，但我太忙了，没空回头看过去。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Sob...

[KungKung]
Hmm... That wasn't necessary, I guess.
This is for you, Human!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
嗯...我想这也没必要。
这是给你的，人类！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Come again tomorrow. I will beat you next time.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
明天再来吧。下次我会打败你的。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I won. It was a boring match.
You need to practice more. Maybe some extra work will help.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我赢了。这是一场无聊的比赛。
你需要多练习。也许做些额外的工作会有帮助。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Catch the delicious fish Phen.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去抓美味的剑鱼吧。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Go catch 30 Phens. And also get me 10 Fish Tails. Give them to our Director cat, and he will make a delicious dish with them.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去抓30条剑鱼。还要给我弄10个鱼尾。把它们交给我们的猫总监，他会用它们做一道美味的菜肴。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I may have worked out too much... I feel powerless and that there's too much weight on me. I should take care of my health.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我可能锻炼过头了...我觉得浑身无力，身上好像压着很重的东西。我应该注意一下健康。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I am already 10 years old, so it's time for some healthy food.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我已经10岁了，是时候吃点健康的食物了。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Get 50 Marse and 30 Milk to our Cat Gamers Director. He has excellent knowledge on healthy foods.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去给猫玩家总监弄50个乌贼和30瓶牛奶。他对健康食品有着丰富的知识。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
We have a rival. The 'Dog n Waltz' team... Everything goes wrong when they come around.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我们有个对手，就是“狗与华尔兹”队...每次他们一来，事情就会变得一团糟。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I want to ask you to bully them, but that's illegal...
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我想让你去欺负他们，但那是违法的...

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Go harass 30 Kobold Archers instead of 'Dog n Waltz', and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去骚扰30个犬妖弓箭手代替“狗与华尔兹”，然后向我们的猫玩家总监汇报。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Quickness is most important for winning the game. For better quickness...
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
敏捷是赢得比赛的关键。为了提升敏捷...

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Catching mice is best. It's Cramp hunting time.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
抓老鼠是最好的办法。现在是猎杀蓝鼠的时间了。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Catch 10 Cramps, and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
抓10只蓝鼠，然后向我们的猫玩家总监汇报。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I want some bird cuisine. Have you tasted any before?
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我想吃些鸟类料理。你以前尝过吗？

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Peco Peco sounds delicious to me. I don't like eating alone, so...
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
大嘴鸟听起来很美味。我不喜欢一个人吃，所以...

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Catch 50 Peco Pecos, and report to our Cat Gamers Director. We all can have a dinner party with Peco Peco cuisine.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
抓50只大嘴鸟，然后向我们的猫玩家总监汇报。我们可以一起享用大嘴鸟料理的晚宴。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Being calm is the key to winning important matches.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
保持冷静是赢得重要比赛的关键。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
There's not a single cat who hasn't played with Yarn when they were young.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
没有哪只猫小时候没玩过毛线球。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Get 20 Yarns, and report to our Cat Gamers Director. It will help improve our team's ability.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
弄20个毛线球，然后向我们的猫玩家总监汇报。这有助于提升我们队伍的能力。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I have a strong belief that our Manager Cat is taking advantage of our snacks.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我坚信我们的管理员猫在偷吃我们的零食。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
All we need is evidence... Get 30 Rat Tails, and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我们只需要证据...弄30个鼠尾，然后向我们的猫玩家总监汇报。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Then, we shall find out whether or not Manager Cat was doing something wrong.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
这样，我们就能查明管理员猫是否做了坏事。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Practice was ok, but I seem to be having a slump these days.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
练习还过得去，但我最近似乎陷入了低谷。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
We need to have some Lemon in times like this.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
在这种时候，我们需要一些柠檬。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Get 5 Lemons to our Cat Gamers Director. He'll know what to do.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
弄5个柠檬给我们的猫玩家总监。他会知道该怎么做。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Malangdo is a good place for a cat to live. But, it gets hot easily.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
马拉多是个适合猫居住的好地方。但是，那里很容易变热。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
On a hot days like this, we could use some Ice Pieces or Ice Cream.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
在这样炎热的日子里，我们需要一些冰碎片或冰淇淋。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Get either 10 Ice Pieces or 10 Ice Creams. Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
弄10个冰碎片或10个冰淇淋。我们的猫玩家总监应该知道该怎么处理它们。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Our Cat Gamers Director asked this. I should make you do this errand.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我们的猫玩家总监提出了这个要求。我应该让你去办这个差事。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Find Eryu the cat from Malangdo, and say 'Come back' loud and clear.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去马拉多找到猫埃留，大声清楚地对他说“回来”。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Afterwards, you can report to our Cat Gamers Director. Off you go!!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
之后，你可以向我们的猫玩家总监汇报。快去吧！！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]

You cannot challenge this Flag Game unless you are done with your assigned work.

[首领]
除非你完成了分配的工作，否则你不能挑战这场旗帜涂鸦游戏。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Not everyone can challenge just because they have the certificate.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
不是每个人只要有证书就可以挑战的。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Ok, let's practice until a challenger comes!!
scripts.translation:
[首领]
好的，让我们练习，直到有挑战者到来！！

scripts.translation:
[首领]
你想挑战吗？

scripts.text:
[Leader]

scripts.translation:
[首领]
除非你佩戴了我们的证书物品，否则你不能挑战这场旗帜涂鸦游戏。请稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
The Flag Game is only available once a day.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
旗帜涂鸦游戏每天只能进行一次。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Do you want to challege?
scripts.translation:
[首领]
你想挑战吗？

scripts.text: Challenge.
scripts.translation: 挑战

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text: Ask about the rules.
scripts.translation: 询问规则

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Let's challenge the Flag Game. Please wait while our cats get prepared.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
让我们来挑战旗帜涂鸦游戏。请等待，我们的猫正在准备。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Oh! I retired from 'Cat Gamers', and am working on a national game referee license. Licenses are the new trend these days.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
哦！我从“猫玩家”退役了，正在考取国家级游戏裁判执照。执照是现在的趋势。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
A referee must use standard language... So it was very hard for me to stop crying meow meow~ like other cats.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
裁判必须使用标准语言... 所以对我来说，停止像其他猫那样喵喵叫是非常困难的。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
I know the game rules for players for sure, but refereeing the game is a lot harder than it seems.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
我肯定知道玩家的游戏规则，但裁判比赛比看起来要难得多。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Sometimes I do make mistakes, and people go crazy like it's the end of world. What a hard job this is.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
有时候我确实会犯错，然后大家就像世界末日一样发疯。这工作真难啊。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
But, I want to finish this course, and be the world's best referee ever.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
但是，我想完成这个课程，成为有史以来最伟大的裁判。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You can bet on it!!
scripts.translation:
[首领]
你可以相信我！！

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Allow me to explain the rule for the Flag-Waving Game.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
请允许我解释一下旗帜涂鸦游戏的规则。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You play with 5 other cats.
Wait and wave the flag when no others are waving it.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
你和另外5只猫一起玩。
等待，并在没有其他猫挥动旗帜时挥动你的旗帜。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You start with 5 Flag Points, and each time you wave the flag 1 point vanishes.
When your points hit 0, the game ends.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
你从5点旗帜点数开始，每次挥动旗帜会减少1点。
当点数归零时，游戏结束。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
There's a special rule for this Flag Game. For more thrill, we reduce 1 point if you do not wave your flag for 10 games.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
这个旗帜游戏有一条特殊规则。为了增加刺激感，如果你连续10局没有挥动旗帜，将扣除1点。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You will get bigger presents as you win with less Flag Points used.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
你获胜时使用的旗帜点数越少，获得的礼物就越大。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Come back anytime if you need more help with the game rules. Our Manager Cat is also available for some help with the game rules.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
如果你需要更多关于游戏规则的帮助，随时回来。我们的管理员猫也可以提供游戏规则方面的帮助。

经过 {0} 局比赛，{1} 还剩 {2} 点旗帜点数。

Congratulations. You have won the Flag-Waving Game.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
恭喜。你赢得了挥旗游戏。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
But, only 3 Canned Foods will be given as the present since you didn't take a big part through the game.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
不过，由于你在游戏中参与度不高，只赠送3罐罐头食品作为奖品。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Congratulations. You have won the Flag-Waving Game. {0} Canned Foods will be given as the present.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
恭喜。你赢得了挥旗游戏。将赠送 {0} 罐罐头食品作为奖品。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Hope you win some more Canned Foods tomorrow.
scripts.translation:

希望明天你能赢得更多罐头食品。

Flag waving failed...

Leader gives you a note without hesitation. You must follow the order now.

scripts.text:
[Seichi]
Ah~ I'm hungry. Any rats wandering around?
scripts.translation:
[诚一]
啊~我饿了。有没有老鼠在附近游荡？

scripts.text:
[Seichi]
Ah~ I think I could eat 100 cramps at once.
scripts.translation:
[诚一]
啊~我觉得我一次能吃100只蓝鼠。

scripts.text:
[Seichi]
Hey, why don't you look around? Who knows? Maybe we can find a delicious canned food~
scripts.translation:
[诚一]
嘿，你为什么不四处看看呢？说不定能找到美味的罐头食品~

scripts.text:
[Seichi]
Then, you can give me one. Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[诚一]
然后，你可以给我一罐。嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Seichi]
I am hungry~ Any leftover canned food there?
scripts.translation:
[诚一]
我饿了~有没有剩下的罐头食品？

scripts.text:
[Row]
Hut! Human, you came to see me, Row the Great? What? No?
scripts.translation:
[罗]
嘿！人类，你是来看伟大的罗的吗？什么？不是？

scripts.text:
[Row]
What do want then? Get lost. Ah...!!
scripts.translation:
[罗]
那你想要什么？滚开。啊...!!

scripts.text:
[Row]
You want to play the Flag Game? I see. Show me what you've got.
scripts.translation:
[罗]
你想玩旗子游戏？我明白了。让我看看你的本事。

scripts.text:
[Row]
But, you know you can never beat me, the great Row.
scripts.translation:
[罗]
但是，你知道你永远赢不了伟大的罗。

scripts.text:
[Row]
Flag waving is a serious game. Only special cats like me can compete. Meow~
scripts.translation:
[罗]
挥舞旗子是一项严肃的游戏。只有像我这样的特殊猫才能参加。喵~

scripts.text:
[Debong]
Hair picking is my best hobby meow.
scripts.translation:
[德邦]
拔毛是我最喜欢的爱好喵。

scripts.text:
[Debong]
When picking hair meow~
Time really flies meow~
scripts.translation:
[德邦]
拔毛的时候喵~
时间过得真快喵~

scripts.text:
[Debong]
Come here, you, meow. I'll pick your hair meow.
scripts.translation:
[德邦]
过来，你，喵。我要拔你的毛喵。

scripts.text: The cat is picking your hair.
scripts.translation: 猫正在拔你的毛。

scripts.text:
[Libs]
Arrgg!! Why should I play this stupid flag waving game here?
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
啊...!! 为什么我要在这里玩这种愚蠢的挥旗游戏？

scripts.text:
[Libs]
Hey you. What do you think? I know you've hearing me!
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
嘿，你。你在想什么？我知道你在听！

scripts.text:
[Libs]
Well, I'm sure you won't have a clue why this is happening. I forgive you.
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
好吧，我确信你根本不知道这是怎么回事。我原谅你了。

scripts.text:
[Libs]
How can a human understand the overwhelming heart of cats.
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
人类怎么可能理解猫那压倒性的心意呢。

scripts.text:
[Libs]
A human? What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
人类？你在这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[Libs]
Oh! I see. Our director is looking a practicing partner, why don't you apply?
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
哦！我明白了。我们的总监正在寻找练习伙伴，你为什么不申请一下呢？

scripts.text:
[YongYong]
Meow~ I'm annoyed meow~
scripts.translation:
[勇勇]
喵~ 我很烦喵~

scripts.text:
[YongYong]
Annoying meow~
scripts.translation:
[勇勇]
真烦喵~

scripts.text:
[YongYong]
You're annoying meow~
scripts.translation:
[勇勇]
你让我很烦喵~

scripts.text:
[YongYong]
What are you, a dog? Meow~!
scripts.translation:
[勇勇]
你是什么，狗吗？喵~！

scripts.text:
[YongYong]
Do not mess with the drooping cat.
Or you will regret it.
scripts.translation:
[勇勇]
不要惹懒洋洋的猫。
否则你会后悔的。

scripts.text:
z..Z..z..Z
The cat is sleeping.
scripts.translation:
呼...呼...呼...
猫在睡觉。

scripts.translation: 一块小牌子。

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
Wow Wot~ What a busy day~
Oh, you are the one who won the honorable certificate?
scripts.translation:
[乌尼特]
哇哦~ 真是忙碌的一天~
哦，你就是那位获得荣誉证书的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
There are more orders coming every day. Ahh!! Give me some more manpower!!
scripts.translation:
[乌尼特]
每天的订单都越来越多。啊啊！！给我多派点人手！！

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
Nyah~ Ong~ Certificate complete!!
scripts.translation:
[乌尼特]
喵~ 哦~ 证书完成！！

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
I already gave your certificate to the Cat Gamers Director! Go check it out~
scripts.translation:
[乌尼特]
我已经把你的证书交给猫玩家总监了！去看看吧~

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
Please... Keep this wherever you go.
scripts.translation:
[乌尼特]
请...无论去哪里都带着它。

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
I am a cat. Nyah~ Ong~
I look like a sheep because I was so busy I didn't have time to shave.
It is not my fault...
scripts.translation:
[乌尼特]
我是一只猫。喵~ 哦~
我看起来像只羊，是因为太忙了没时间刮毛。
这不是我的错...

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
Nyah~ Ong~ Do not interrupt my resting.
Usually, I am very busy...
Don't touch me.
scripts.translation:
[乌尼特]
喵~ 哦~ 不要打扰我休息。
平时，我非常忙碌...
别碰我。

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
I'm a bit fat now, but you should look at yourself too. Haha...
scripts.translation:
[乌尼特]
我现在有点胖了，但你也要看看你自己。哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Interview Cat]
I want join 'Cat Gamers'.
But it seems the Cat Gamers Director is busy now. Should I just leave?
scripts.translation:
[面试猫]
我想加入“猫玩家”。
但看起来猫玩家总监现在很忙。我该直接离开吗？

scripts.text:
[Interview Cat]
What? You also want join this group?
scripts.translation:
[面试猫]
什么？你也想加入这个组织？

scripts.text:
[Waiting Cat]
Why did someone put that vase inside of a glass?
The Cat Gamers Director did that?
scripts.translation:
[等待的猫]
为什么有人把花瓶放在玻璃杯里？
是猫玩家总监干的吗？

scripts.text:
[Waiting Cat]
What strange taste.
Maybe I should rethink joining 'Cat Gamers', huh?
scripts.translation:
[等待的猫]
味道好奇怪。
也许我应该重新考虑加入“猫玩家”了，嗯？

scripts.text: ^0000FFThere's a hastily written message on this bulletin board.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF公告板上有一条匆忙写下的留言。^000000

scripts.text: A fallen angel within will unlock a hidden enchantment to Archangel Wings.
scripts.translation: 内部有一位堕天使，将解锁永恒之翼的隐藏附魔。

scripts.text: You are carrying too many items, please reduce them and come back!
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品太多了，请减少一些后再来！

scripts.text: You have overweight, please reduce it and come back!
scripts.translation: 你超重了，请减轻重量后再来！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
You seem like a poor guy!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
你看起来好穷啊！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
If you have an Archangel Wing, I will enchant my capability into the useless 4th slot. Would you like me to do so?
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
如果你有天使之翼，我可以将我的能力附魔到那个无用的第4个槽位上。你愿意让我这么做吗？

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么？

scripts.text: Enchant Initialization
scripts.translation: 附魔初始化

scripts.text: Stop speaking
scripts.translation: 闭嘴

scripts.text: What are you going to do?
scripts.translation: 你要做什么？

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
你说什么？

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
I can enchant my capability into your Archangel Wing if you pay 1,000,000 zeny. But you can't enchant it again without resetting it.
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
如果你支付1,000,000 Zeny，我可以将我的能力附魔到你的天使之翼上。但如果不重置，就无法再次附魔。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
The enchantment is dangerous, so ^ff0000the wing might be damaged^000000! Nevertheless, my good blessing will retain the ^0000ffcard and refine level^0000ff!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
附魔很危险，所以^ff0000翅膀可能会损坏^000000！不过，我的祝福会保留^0000ff卡片和精炼等级^0000ff！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
I can't do it if you can't pay!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
如果你付不起钱，我就不能做！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
There are 2 important notices. First, the enchantment requires ^0000ff1,000,000 zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
有两点重要通知。首先，附魔需要^0000ff1,000,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Second, ^ff0000although the rate is not high, the Archangel Wing might be damaged^000000! This is very unlucky!
If you can accept these conditions, I will enchant the wing for you.
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
其次，^ff0000虽然概率不高，但天使之翼可能会损坏^000000！这非常不幸！
如果你能接受这些条件，我就为你附魔。

scripts.text: Let me consider...
scripts.translation: 让我考虑一下...

scripts.text: I accept, let's enchant!
scripts.translation: 我接受，开始附魔吧！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Ok! Take your time to consider!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
好的！请慢慢考虑！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
The Archangel Wing has been taken out!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
天使之翼已经取出来了！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Don't take off the item!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
不要取下物品！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
This Archangel Wing is enchanted! Please initialize it or bring another Archangel Wing for me!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
这个天使之翼已经附魔了！请初始化它，或者带另一个天使之翼来给我！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Be merciful to the survivor,
Send flowers to the dead.
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
善待幸存者，
为逝者献花。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Help for justice,
Elimination of evil.
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
伸张正义，
铲除邪恶。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
But the important point is... the Archangel Wing is damaged!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
但重要的是...天使之翼损坏了！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Take it!
I believe that you will become the dominator of the new world!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
拿着吧！
我相信你会成为新世界的统治者！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Initialization requires ^0000ff3 units of Silvervine Fruit^000000. The wing will not be damaged except for the enchanted capability.
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
初始化需要^0000ff3个猕猴桃果实^000000。除了附魔效果外，翅膀不会受到损坏。

scripts.text: Let me consider...
scripts.translation: 让我考虑一下...

scripts.text: Ok, I want initialize it.
scripts.translation: 好的，我要初始化它。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Ok! Take your time to consider!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
好的！请慢慢考虑！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
The Archangel Wing has been taken out!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
天使之翼已经取出来了！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Oh... you have unequipped the Archangel Wing!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
哦...你已卸下天使之翼！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
I can't do it if you can't pay!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
如果你付不起钱，我就不能做！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
This equipment has not been enchanted, please check it again!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
这件装备没有附魔，请再次确认！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Take it!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
拿着吧！
